Title: Manager, Operational Excellence, Microsoft Licensing Operations
Description:
**Why You’ll Love Softchoice**
At Softchoice, a World Wide Technology (WWT) company, we work together to make a new world happen. As an IT solutions provider serving U.S. commercial and SMB organizations, as well as the entire Canadian market, we help organizations turn ambition into real‑world outcomes. We do this through the delivery of secure cloud, AI, software and digital workplace solutions that enable agility, innovation and growth.
  
  
With a highly engaged, high-performing team, we are certified as a Great Place to Work® in both Canada and the United States, and have been recognized as a Best Workplace in Canada for more than 20 years. We stand proudly for our people and their success through career development and advancement, and continuously strive to do what’s good for our people and communities.
  
  
As part of WWT, we connect customers to the global scale, advanced innovation, world-class partnerships, and deep expertise of a leader in AI and digital transformation. This includes access to WWT’s Advanced Technology Center (ATC), a collaborative ecosystem featuring state-of-the-art hardware and software that enables customers and partners to conceptualize, test, and validate innovative solutions before deploying them at scale.
  
  
**The Impact You Will Have**
The Manager, Operational Excellence is responsible for leading the operational execution of Microsoft's licensing business and ensuring customer transactions are completed accurately, efficiently, and in alignment with Microsoft program requirements and internal business standards.
  
  
This role provides people leadership and operational oversight across the full licensing transaction lifecycle, including quoting, contract creation and maintenance, ordering, amendments, renewals, and other related licensing activities. The Manager will work closely with Microsoft and internal stakeholders to translate program requirements into clear, practical, and sustainable operating processes. The role supports customers across commercial, public sector, and education segments and must understand how customer-specific requirements can affect licensing execution, documentation, compliance, and service delivery.
  
  
A key focus of the role is establishing and maintaining strong operational controls. This includes partnering with Microsoft and internal compliance teams, monitoring adherence to program and contractual requirements, maintaining audit readiness, and ensuring compliance requirements are consistently applied throughout each transaction.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring strong operational judgment, licensing knowledge, and a continuous-improvement mindset. They will strengthen the business through disciplined execution, clear accountability, effective controls, and thoughtful improvements to processes and tools.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* People Leadership and Team Development
* Lead, coach, develop, and retain a high-performing Microsoft Operations team.
* Establish clear objectives, expectations, and accountabilities aligned with department and business priorities.
* Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, performance discussions, development planning, and objective monitoring.
* Build team capability through coaching, cross-training, knowledge sharing, and succession planning.
* Ensure employees understand the Microsoft program requirements and internal controls applicable to their work.
* Manage staffing, workload allocation, scheduling, and coverage to support business volumes and service commitments.
* Foster a collaborative environment grounded in ownership, accuracy, continuous learning, and customer focus.
* Act as an escalation point for complex operational, customer, compliance, and people-related matters.
* Operational Leadership and Execution
* Lead the day-to-day execution of Microsoft licensing operations across quoting, contracting, ordering, amendments, renewals, and ongoing agreement maintenance.
* Ensure transactions are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with Microsoft requirements, customer commitments, and internal standards.
* Establish clear priorities, workflows, ownership, and escalation paths across the business.
* Monitor operational performance through scorecards, service levels, productivity measures, quality results, and other relevant indicators.
* Identify trends, capacity risks, process gaps, and recurring issues, and ensure appropriate corrective action is taken.
* Provide leadership and direction during complex licensing scenarios, high-volume periods, and customer-impacting escalations.
* Maintain effective business rhythms that give leadership and stakeholders appropriate visibility into performance, risk, and required decisions.
* Microsoft Program and Transaction Compliance
* Partner with Microsoft to understand changes to licensing programs, operational requirements, transaction rules, and partner obligations.
* Translate Microsoft requirements into clear internal procedures, controls, training, and operational practices.
* Ensure Microsoft compliance requirements are maintained throughout the transaction lifecycle.
* Partner with internal Compliance, Legal, Finance, Sales, and other teams to establish and manage controls that support both partner and organizational obligations.
* Maintain appropriate transaction documentation and evidence to support internal reviews, Microsoft assessments, audits, and other compliance activities.
* Conduct or oversee periodic reviews of transactions, processes, and controls to identify gaps and confirm adherence to established requirements.
* Ensure compliance findings, transaction exceptions, and control failures are documented, escalated, remediated, and monitored through completion.
* Promote a culture in which compliance is embedded into daily operations rather than treated as a separate review after the transaction is complete.
* Maintain current knowledge of Microsoft program requirements, contractual obligations, and relevant internal policies.
* Operational Excellence and Continuous Improvement
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, eliminate unnecessary steps, improve quality, and reduce operational risk.
* Lead practical improvements to workflows, documentation, controls, reporting, and supporting tools.
* Use operational data, quality findings, audit results, and employee and stakeholder feedback to prioritize improvements.
* Partner with IT and operational improvement teams to define business requirements and support changes to systems and tools.
* Ensure process or system changes are tested, documented, communicated, and adopted effectively.
* Support automation where it improves accuracy, control, capacity, or customer experience without weakening operational oversight.
* Establish sustainable standard operating procedures and ensure they remain current as Microsoft requirements and internal business needs evolve.
* Measure the effectiveness of implemented improvements and adjust when expected outcomes are not achieved.
* Cross-Functional Partnership and Stakeholder Management
* Build effective working relationships with Microsoft and internal stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT, Enablement, and other business areas.
* Serve as a key operational contact for Microsoft on volume licensing execution, program changes, compliance matters, and escalations.
* Develop and maintain an understanding of the operational, contractual, documentation, and compliance considerations that may apply when supporting public sector and education business.
* Ensure new Microsoft requirements and internal business changes are evaluated for operational impact before implementation.
* Clarify roles, responsibilities, handoffs, and escalation paths across teams involved in the licensing transaction lifecycle.
* Provide clear, fact-based updates to senior leaders regarding operational performance, business risks, compliance matters, and improvement priorities.
* Educate internal stakeholders on operational requirements and the information needed to support accurate and compliant execution.
* Balance customer and business needs with Microsoft program requirements, contractual obligations, and operational controls, including the distinct requirements that may apply to public sector and education customers.
* Governance, Risk, and Business Management
* Identify operational, compliance, financial, and customer risks within the processes managed by Microsoft Licensing Operations.
* Establish mitigation plans, monitor corrective actions, and escalate material risks appropriately.
* Maintain operational scorecards and reporting that provide visibility into service levels, quality, productivity, compliance, and improvement progress.
* Oversee process documentation, control ownership, decision records, and audit evidence within the team's scope.
* Contribute to operational planning, capacity planning, technology roadmaps, and business cases for process or system investment.
* Ensure changes to programs, processes, or systems have clear ownership, documentation, controls, training, and implementation plans.
* Provide functional guidance to internal teams on how Microsoft Licensing Operations integrates with their business processes and customer responsibilities.

**What You Will Bring To The Table**

* At least three years of progressive experience in licensing operations, customer operations, sales operations, or a related technology environment.
* Demonstrated people-leadership experience, including coaching, performance management, talent development, and workload planning.
* Strong experience managing complex, high-volume, transaction-based operations.
* Practical knowledge of software licensing, contract processing, quoting, ordering, renewals, and agreement maintenance.
* Experience interpreting external program or partner requirements and translating them into internal processes and controls.
* Experience supporting compliance reviews, audits, operational controls, or risk-management activities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive issues through resolution.
* Proven ability to work cross-functionally with Sales, Finance, Legal, Compliance, IT, Customer Success, and external partners.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to communicate operational risks and requirements to senior stakeholders.
* A strong customer focus balanced with appropriate attention to compliance, accuracy, financial risk, and contractual obligations.
* Post-secondary education in business, operations, technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.
* Business improvement, project management, risk, compliance, or process-management certification is considered an asset.
* Microsoft licensing or comparable software-vendor program experience is strongly preferred. Experience supporting public sector or education customers, licensing transactions, contracts, or operational requirements is considered an asset.

**Compensation**
A reasonable estimate of the current base pay range for this position in Canada is $95,000 to $110,000, annually + 12% as target incentives.
  
  
Actual salary will be based on a variety of factors, including location, experience, skill set, education, and related certification. The range for this position in other geographic locations may differ.

* Paid Time Off: Vacation and Sick Leave, Holidays, Parental Leave, Volunteer Days, Bereavement Leave

Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.

Critically, we're looking for someone who is actively curious about how AI tools can make program management faster, more thorough, and more scalable and who can put that curiosity to practical use.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Project, Program, & Portfolio Execution
  
  

* Own, shape, and drive complex, cross-functional technology programs through the full technology development lifecycle (scope, schedule, change, risk, procurement, vendor, and closure)
* Assess and recommend the right delivery approach (Agile, Waterfall, hybrid, SAFe) based on program needs

* Proactively identify and resolve blockers at the program level, including issues that cut across teams or organizations
* Lead effort estimation, resource planning, and capacity alignment with senior stakeholders
* Conduct structured retrospectives and translate learnings into lasting process improvements

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Build working relationships with senior leaders, directors, and VP-level stakeholders across technical and business functions ensuring alignment and business readiness
* Define and publish communication plans, facilitate decision making and resolve cross-team conflicts before they become program risks
* Lead or support steering committees, program reviews, and executive briefings
* Leverage concise, sharp, and executive-ready content to convey current state of affairs and drive required outcomes

Governance & Reporting
  
  

* Effectively and proactively monitor and report program progress and health, milestones, risks and mitigation, scope changes, resource needs and decisions
* Create and use JIRA or other tool-based dashboards to visualize program related data
* Ensure compliance with internal controls, standards, and documentation practices
* Support vendor management and third-party integrations, where applicable
* Track and report financial data, program metrics, and operational effectiveness

Agile Delivery & Facilitation
  
  

* Use your strong command over multiple PM methodologies (Agile, Scrum, SAFe, Waterfall, Kanban) to determine the best approach for a given program and apply them correctly
* Lead 3-5 agile teams as an RTE (release train engineer)
* Coach teams on Agile best practices and metrics (velocity, burndown, backlog health,) using Jira/Confluence
* Facilitate scrum of scrums and structure work delivery across Agile Release Trains (ARTs) through ART ceremonies (PI Planning, ART Sync, PO Sync, System Demo)
* Use data analysis and modelling to uncover insights and support decision-making

AI Enablement and PM Innovation
  
  

* Actively use AI tools to accelerate program work status reporting, risk synthesis, documentation, meeting prep, and more
* Able to evaluate practical opportunities and apply lightweight AI-powered solutions to day to day program management workflows without requiring engineering support
* Help scale program management bandwidth by mentoring and enabling other PMs and teams to leverage AI effectively
* Stay current on relevant AI and other tooling improvements and share what's working with the broader TPM community
* Define and document PM standards, templates, and processes that others can use and build on

**Qualifications**
Experience
  
  

* 12+ years of technical program or project management experience with a demonstrated track record running large, complex programs with multiple teams and external dependencies
* Previous data center experience highly preferred
* Specific exposure to following in an enterprise environment is highly desirable
* Engineering excellence domains: SRE, developer experience, building and scaling engineering platforms, DevSecOps, software quality management practices
* Data center operations domains: Energy and sustainability, design and construction, digital twins, infrastructure monitoring, capacity planning
* Skilled at navigating ambiguity and driving clarity in complex, matrixed environments
* Excellent communicator (both written and verbal) and collaborator with a practical, outcomes-driven mindset that appeals to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Practical, hands-on experience with tools such as Miro, Jira, Confluence, MS 365 suite, Smartsheet, or equivalent

Education and Certifications
  
  

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in a STEM, Computer science, other technical or related fields
* One or more relevant certifications required: PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, CSM, SAFe RTE, SAFe Program Consultant, or equivalent
* Additional certifications in AI/ML fundamentals or digital transformation are a plus

This role partners closely with local and global leaders across Product, Technology, and Operations to drive execution excellence, strengthen portfolio governance, and accelerate business outcomes through effective project delivery and organizational change.

  
  

**What you'll do**

  

**Strategic Leadership, Governance & Portfolio Management**

  

* **Enterprise Methodologies & Frameworks** : Develop and implement enterprise-wide project management methodologies aligned with industry best practices (e.g., PMBOK, Agile, Lean), alongside robust Organizational Change Management (OCM) frameworks, tools, and standardized templates.
* **Portfolio Governance & Intake** : Establish and manage a standardized project intake, business case evaluation, prioritization, and portfolio management framework aligned with strategic business outcomes.
* **Executive Reporting & Metrics** : Develop, track, and report on key performance indicators (KPIs), scorecards, financial forecasts, and status summaries for senior leadership, steering committees, and C-Suite.
  

  

* **Continuous Improvement** : Evaluate the ongoing effectiveness of current projects and change plans, driving continuous process enhancements and organizational learning

**Project Intake, Planning & Execution**

* **Scope & Capacity Planning** : Collaborate with stakeholders to define project scope, deliverables, timelines, budgets, and portfolio resource capacity allocation.
  

  

* **Execution & Quality Oversight:** Oversee projects execution, ensuring projects adhere to timelines, quality standards, budget limits, and formal scope change controls.
  

  

* **Risk Mitigation & Issue Resolution** : Conduct risk assessments, implement mitigation plans, and provide direct guidance to project managers to remove operational roadblocks.
  

  

* **Kickoffs & Retrospectives** : Lead project kickoffs and retrospectives to capture learnings and optimize future project execution.
  

  

**Organizational Change Management & Adoption**

* **Change Strategy** : Drive end-to-end change management strategies for Canada across corporate, client, supplier, and employee programs. Define clear success metrics (e.g., speed and proficiency of adoption, employee feedback pulse surveys, project ROI, and reduction in rework), leverage structured frameworks such as Prosci/ADKAR or Kotter, and conduct targeted stakeholder engagement activities including impact assessments, executive sponsorship alignment, workshops, and feedback retrospective loops.
  

  

* **OCM Capability Building** : Own the design, development, and delivery of enterprise OCM education programs, toolkits, and knowledge transfer across internal teams and external partners
  

  

**Team Leadership & Development**

* **Team Building & Mentorship** : Build, inspire, and lead high-performing EPMO and OCM teams, fostering a collaborative, team-based environment.
  

  

* **Coaching & Performance Management** : Establish clear performance expectations, conduct execution assessments, provide continuous feedback, and deliver professional development opportunities.

**What experience you need**

  

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Organizational Development, or a related field.

.

* Professional Experience: 10+ years of experience in project management and/or change management, including 5+ years in leadership roles overseeing large-scale enterprise projects, multi-faceted change management, or program portfolios.
  

  

* Executive Presence: Exceptional communication, conflict resolution, and stakeholder management skills with demonstrated gravitas to engage and influence C-Suite leadership.
  

  

* Industry Experience: Financial Services or Fintech industry experience is required.
  

  

* EPMO & OCM Scaling: Proven track record of establishing and scaling an enterprise PMO or OCM capability within a rapid-paced, high-growth environment
* Technical Implementation Background: Hands-on experience with advanced technology implementations, enterprise consulting, cloud-based services, and PM tools such as Jira and MS Project.
* Project Management Certifications: PMP (Project Management Professional) or PgMP (Program Management Professional) certification
* Change Management Certifications: PROSCI or CCMP™ (Certified Change Management Professional) designation.
  

  

**What could set you apart**

  

* Advanced Education: Master’s degree (MBA or relevant advanced field) preferred.

This role has a base salary range of $139,008 - $182,448 The final salary selected from this range is dependent on the location of the role as well as the experiences & capabilities of the candidate selected. Title: IT Operations Lead
Description:
***About SJC***

*SJC*
stands as Canada’s largest privately owned communications company, distinguished by its portfolio of leading media brands, including Toronto Life, Chatelaine, and Maclean’s. At SJC, creativity, technology and journalism intersect to deliver content that resonates and performs. From integrated creative studios and advanced ad-tech to a portfolio of iconic media brands, we craft and distribute award-winning stories for audiences and advertisers alike. Partnering with organizations across North America, we build marketing solutions that inform, inspire and empower on every platform—from print to emerging digital channels. Our influence—and a 22-year streak on Canada’s Best Managed Companies list—reflects a culture committed to excellence and constant evolution. To learn more about our organization, please visit www.stjoseph.com

***About the Role***

Our IT team is seeking an IT Operations Lead to manage the people and systems that keep our infrastructure, network, and endpoints secure, reliable, and well maintained. This is a player-coach role: you'll manage and grow a small IT team while remaining hands-on as our Tier 3 escalation point for the more complex issues that come up day to day. The role touches on-prem server administration, networking, cloud infrastructure, and endpoint management, with a strong emphasis on cybersecurity readiness—including planning and running tabletop exercises that stress-test our incident response. We're also looking for someone who brings an automation-first mindset, encouraging the use of AI tools and scripting to reduce manual toil across on-prem and cloud environments. You'll work closely with the Director, Engineering & Technology and other stakeholders across the business to set IT priorities, develop your team, and keep our people prepared for whatever comes next.

***What You'll Do in this Role:***

* Lead, mentor, and develop a small IT team, setting priorities, running performance and growth conversations, and building the team's on-call and incident response capabilities.
* Own Tier 3 escalations: stepping in on the trickier infrastructure, networking, and security issues that Tier 1/2 support can't resolve.
* Oversee on-prem server infrastructure, corporate networking, cloud infrastructure and identity, and endpoint management, ensuring these are reliable, secure, and well maintained (working with vendors or MSPs where deep specialist support is needed).
* Champion the organization's cybersecurity posture, including access management, patching cadence, and backup/recovery practices.
* Plan and facilitate cybersecurity tabletop exercises to test and improve incident response readiness across IT and the broader business.
* Enforce support standards and processes and hold the team accountable to them.
* Assist the Director in evaluating external vendors and managed service providers.
* Encourage and guide the adoption of AI tools and automation/scripting to streamline IT operations, user management, and security monitoring.
* Collaborate with production, facilities, and business stakeholders to support office and infrastructure needs.
* Ensure documentation, systems, and runbooks are kept current to support consistency and knowledge sharing across the team.
* Other duties as assigned.

***Our ideal candidate:***

* Experienced IT generalist with solid working knowledge of on-prem server environments and enterprise networks, and a genuine interest in staying hands-on with day-to-day technical problems.
* Proven team-lead experience coaching and developing IT staff; 1-2+ years management experience. 4+ years contributing consistently on modern IT teams.
* Some hands-on exposure to cybersecurity practices, and comfortable planning or facilitating tabletop exercises and incident response discussions.
* Working familiarity with cloud infrastructure and identity/access management concepts (provisioning/deprovisioning, access reviews, conditional access).
* Comfortable overseeing endpoint fleets (Windows/MacOS) with the help of standard endpoint management tools.
* Enthusiastic about using AI tools and automation/scripting to make IT operations more efficient, even if not a deep scripting expert.
* Clear communicator who can explain technical risk and tradeoffs to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
* Comfortable with balancing hands-on Tier 3 work with people management, planning, and strategic responsibilities.

***Your Skills Include:***

* On-prem & networking: General comfort administering Windows Server and/or Linux environments and troubleshooting LAN/WAN, VPN, and firewall issues.
* Cloud & identity: Working knowledge of a major cloud provider (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP) and identity/access tools (e.g., Active Directory/Entra ID, SSO).
* Endpoint management: Familiarity with common endpoint management tools (e.g., Microsoft Intune, JAMF, SCCM) for provisioning and securing devices.
* Cybersecurity: General understanding of incident response planning, tabletop exercise facilitation, and security best practices.
* AI & automation: Interest and some experience in using AI tools or scripting/automation platforms to streamline IT operations.
* Service management: Experience with ticketing/ITSM tools, SLA design, and Tier 1–3 support structures.
* People leadership: Demonstrated experience managing, mentoring, or leading IT staff, including performance management and team development.
* Education: A bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

***Benefits at SJC:***

SJC is committed to the well-being and professional development of its employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:

**Health and Dental Benefits**

* Employee & Family Assistance Program (EFAP) and access to online health & wellness resources through Homewood Health.
* Scholarship program available for employees’ children.
* Exclusive employee subscription rates for SJC publications.
* A complimentary 1-year Toronto Life Insider membership.
* Discounted annual GoodLife membership.
* Participation in the Perkopolis Perk Program, offering employee pricing at a wide range of retailers.

A Workplace Built for Everyone:

***SJC Values***

* Amaze our customers: We put our customers’ evolving needs at the heart of the business and inspire through our ideas, quality and service.
* Be relentlessly curious: We take the initiative to learn, try new things and brainstorm the next big idea.
* Respect every individual as equal: We value diversity as the means to creativity and cultivate a collaborative environment where everyone belongs.
* Innovate and adapt with urgency: Forward-thinking and flexible, we react quickly and boldly to change.
* Contribute to our community: We apply our resources and passions to make a difference – for people and our planet

***Accommodations at SJC***

SJC i
s proud to be an equal-opportunity employer, where everyone feels welcome and has the opportunity to thrive. We're committed to creating inclusive and barrier-free recruitment processes and work environments. If you're contacted for an interview and require any accommodations to ensure a fair and equitable experience, please let our Human Resources team know. We'll handle any information you share with complete confidentiality.

*Inclusion at SJC*

Equality and respect for all is one of our founding values and core beliefs at SJC. We are a diverse group with associates of all ages, orientations, races and talents. We celebrate this diversity and we draw strength from it. Inclusivity at SJC means fostering a culture that welcomes and respects each individual as equal – both inside our walls and within the larger community.

Title: Senior Delivery Manager - Enterprise Workflow & AI Transformation (PL6441)
Description:
### **Role Summary**

Paralucent is seeking a Senior Delivery Manager to lead a multi-workstream enterprise modernization program in financial services. You will turn an established future-state vision into an executable roadmap, coordinate business and technology teams, manage dependencies and controls, and guide incremental releases through testing, approval, deployment and stabilization.

This role is for a hands-on leader who creates clarity, raises risks early and keeps teams focused on measurable outcomes.

### **What You'll Do**

* Own the integrated delivery plan across business process, user experience, workflow/case management, integrations, AI/document intelligence, security, testing and release workstreams.
* Translate program outcomes into increments, milestones, release plans, dependencies, decision points and acceptance evidence.
* Operate within an Agile or hybrid enterprise delivery model, including backlog readiness, sprint/release planning, demonstrations, retrospectives and production governance.
* Maintain disciplined RAID, decision, change, action and dependency management; surface material issues early with options and recommendations.
* Coordinate architecture, cybersecurity, privacy, records management, Responsible AI, operations and production-readiness reviews.
* Manage client and Paralucent governance, status reporting, financial tracking, forecasting, resource planning and milestone acceptance.
* Ensure requirements-to-test-to-evidence traceability and that no prototype is represented as production-ready.
* Plan cutover, pilot, hypercare, transition-to-support and progressive knowledge transfer.
* Create a high-accountability team environment with clear owners, due dates and escalation paths.

### **What Success Looks Like**

* A credible integrated plan, governance cadence and decision model are operating early.
* Milestones are achieved with transparent scope, budget, quality and risk reporting.
* Dependencies on enterprise teams and legacy-system owners are identified before they block delivery.
* Working end-to-end increments reach pilot and production with complete approval and test evidence.
* Operational teams are prepared to adopt, support and improve the solution after launch.

* 8+ years leading enterprise software, digital transformation or workflow/case-management delivery, including several years in senior delivery or program leadership.
* Demonstrated success delivering complex solutions into production in banking, financial services or another highly regulated industry.
* Strong command of Agile delivery, release planning, dependency management, change control, financial management and executive reporting.
* Experience coordinating architecture, security, privacy, records, compliance, operations and technology stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple vendors, distributed teams and cross-functional workstreams without losing end-to-end accountability.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including concise executive reporting and difficult escalation conversations.
* Practical understanding of cloud applications, enterprise integration, workflow, AI governance and production-readiness controls.

### **Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Canadian banking environments and enterprise risk/governance processes.
* Experience delivering high-volume operational workflow, document-processing or regulated case-management solutions.
* PMP, PMI-ACP, Scrum, SAFe or comparable delivery certification.
* Experience using EOS-style scorecards, clear seat accountability and issue-solving disciplines.

### **Role Scorecard: Illustrative Measures**

*Final targets and cadence will be confirmed for the specific assignment. Typical measures include:*

* Milestone predictability and release readiness
* Budget and capacity variance
* Age and closure rate of critical RAID items
* Decision and dependency turnaround
* Defect escape and production-stability trends
* Stakeholder confidence and acceptance timeliness
* Knowledge-transfer and operational-readiness completion

### **How You Demonstrate Our Core Values**

**Driven:** Moves important work forward, recovers quickly from blockers and focuses on meaningful outcomes.

**Takes Ownership:** Closes loops, communicates risks early and remains accountable across handoffs.

**Creative Problem Solver:** Clarifies the real problem and proposes practical options with trade-offs.

**Humbly Confident:** Brings sound judgment, explains reasoning and actively invites challenge and feedback.

**Customer Centric:** Understands operational reality, success measures and the impact of decisions on users and the institution.

Title: Senior Project Manager

Are you ready to lead the programs that power a global technology transformation?
  
  
  
  
We are looking for a Senior Project Manager to join our CIO Strategy & Operations team. CIO Strategy & Operations brings together CIO Strategy, PMO and Business Operations to align priorities, govern execution, and provide the platforms and insights that enable the CIO organisation to deliver outcomes at scale. In this role, you will personally own the delivery of high-impact programs that span multiple business domains and technologies, combining deep subject matter expertise with hands on execution. Operating at the intersection of technology strategy and operational delivery, you will work closely with senior stakeholders across the organization, driving complex, cross-functional initiatives from conception through to completion.
  
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
  
  
In this opportunity as a Senior Project Manager, you will:
  
  

* Lead strategic programs and projects of significant complexity, risk, and visibility from initiation through execution, exercising a high degree of autonomy to ensure alignment with enterprise-wide goals and measurable outcomes.
* Translate business strategy into actionable project plans, owning scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and benefits realization across multiple concurrent projects or a program.
* Apply and help evolve governance structures, operating rhythms, PMO standards, tooling, and methodologies, including AI-enabled approaches, to ensure consistency, rigour, and continuous improvement across the portfolio.
* Proactively identify and manage risks, issues, and dependencies that could impact delivery, providing specialist advice to middle and senior management to resolve complex, high-visibility issues.
* Drive cross-functional collaboration across a wide range of business functions, negotiating and engaging senior stakeholders to secure alignment on complex, sometimes competing priorities.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for senior and executive stakeholders on your projects, translating complex project detail into clear, executive-ready updates, and applying AI tools to strengthen reporting, analysis, and stakeholder communications.
* Act as a recognized subject matter expert, mentoring and guiding other project managers, and staying current with industry trends and evolving PM/PMO practices.

  
  
**Required Qualifications:**

* Proven experience negotiating and engaging directly with senior and executive stakeholders.
* Deep understanding of project management methodologies (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, hybrid) and the judgment to adapt them to complex, ambiguous situations.

* PMP, PgMP, or equivalent program/project management certification.
* Experience with software development life cycles and technology-enabled process design.
* Technical fluency across modern enterprise systems and architectures (e.g., cloud, APIs, data integration), with the ability to engage credibly with engineering and architecture teams on technical trade-offs.

Title: Program Manager
Location: Dubai, Dubai, United Arab Emirates | Dubai, DU, United Arab Emirates
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting and Software Development
Description:
**Be the one building AI-powered experiences where they matter most.**
At Genesys, we help organizations create better customer experiences through AI-powered experience orchestration. Our platform connects people, systems, data and AI to help organizations deliver more personalized service, improve operational efficiency and build stronger customer relationships.
  
  
Help build, support and operate technology used by more than 8,000 organizations in over 100 countries – moving AI from possibility to production in real-world enterprise environments every day.
  
  
**This role is open to candidates based in either Dubai or Riyadh.**
**Role Summary**
The Program Manager is responsible for leading Genesys’ largest, most complex and strategically important customer engagements while providing governance and delivery oversight across the regional project portfolio.
  
  
The Program Manager serves as the senior point of accountability and escalation for project delivery within the region. The role ensures that engagements are delivered to consistent Genesys standards, achieve the customer’s intended business outcomes, maintain strong customer and executive confidence, and meet Genesys revenue, margin and financial-performance objectives.
  
  
Working across Professional Services, Sales, Customer Success, Solution Engineering, Product, Support, partners and customer leadership teams, the Program Manager creates the alignment, governance and executive focus required to deliver complex transformation programs successfully.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic and Mega-Engagement Leadership**

* Lead Genesys’ largest and most complex customer programs from initiation through deployment, adoption, value realization and transition to ongoing Customer Success.
* Establish the overall program vision, governance model, delivery strategy, integrated roadmap and measurable success criteria.
* Coordinate multiple projects, workstreams, countries, partners and stakeholder groups as one integrated program.
* Ensure that scope, solution design, delivery plans and priorities remain aligned with the customer’s strategic and operational objectives.
* Maintain executive-level relationships with customer sponsors and provide clear, outcome-oriented program reporting.
* Drive timely decisions, remove cross-functional obstacles and maintain momentum across the entire engagement.
* Ensure effective transition from sales to delivery and from implementation to adoption and ongoing success.

**Regional Delivery Governance**

* Provide oversight of the regional project portfolio, with particular focus on strategic, high-value, high-risk or escalated engagements.
* Establish and enforce consistent delivery standards, governance practices, project controls and quality expectations.
* Conduct regular portfolio and project-health reviews covering scope, schedule, financials, staffing, dependencies, risks, customer sentiment and business outcomes.
* Ensure project teams maintain effective governance artifacts, including integrated plans, RAID logs, decision records, financial forecasts, status reports and escalation plans.
* Identify systemic delivery risks, capability gaps and recurring project issues, and lead regional improvement initiatives.
* Promote the consistent application and continuous improvement of Genesys delivery methodologies and best practices.
* Coach Project Managers, Delivery Managers and project leads on program governance, executive communication, risk management and customer engagement.

**Escalation and Risk Management**

* Act as the senior point of escalation for project-delivery issues across the region.
* Establish clear escalation paths, ownership, decision rights and recovery actions.
* Intervene early when project conditions could affect customer objectives, delivery commitments, revenue, margin or customer confidence.
* Lead recovery planning for critical projects, bringing together the appropriate Genesys, partner and customer stakeholders.
* Escalate product, support, resource or commercial dependencies to the relevant leadership teams and drive them through resolution.
* Ensure material risks and issues are communicated transparently, with clearly defined business impact, accountable owners and target resolution dates.
* Balance immediate issue resolution with protection of the long-term customer relationship.

**Customer Business-Value Realization**

* Translate customer strategic priorities into measurable program objectives, operational KPIs and value-realization plans.
* Ensure every strategic engagement has clearly defined success measures covering business outcomes, customer experience, operational performance, adoption and financial value.
* Maintain traceability between contracted deliverables, implementation outcomes and the customer’s business case.
* Work with Customer Success and account teams to monitor adoption, benefits realization and achievement of agreed outcomes following deployment.
* Facilitate periodic executive value reviews to demonstrate progress, validate realized benefits and agree corrective or expansion actions.
* Ensure delivery decisions prioritize time-to-value and sustainable customer outcomes—not simply technical completion.
* Identify opportunities to expand adoption and deepen the customer’s strategic use of Genesys capabilities where this supports genuine customer value.

**Revenue and Financial Accountability**

* Own the consolidated financial performance of assigned strategic programs and provide governance over the regional project portfolio.
* Ensure accurate forecasting of revenue, backlog conversion, delivery velocity, resource demand and project completion.
* Monitor revenue realization, project margin, effort consumption, change requests, milestone achievement and financial risks.
* Work with delivery and resource leaders to align staffing with project priorities, skills requirements, utilization and profitability objectives.
* Identify and resolve conditions that could delay revenue recognition or negatively affect margin.
* Ensure changes in scope are governed effectively and translated into appropriate commercial change controls.
* Partner with Sales and account leadership to identify follow-on services opportunities while maintaining clear separation between delivery commitments and new scope.
* Contribute directly to achievement of regional Genesys revenue and professional-services performance targets.

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Create alignment among Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, Solution Engineering, Product, Support, Finance, partners and customer teams.
* Establish an effective cadence for program leadership, workstream coordination, account-team alignment and executive steering.
* Ensure decisions, actions and dependencies are documented, communicated and tracked to completion.
* Build a culture of ownership, transparency, constructive challenge and continuous improvement.
* Represent regional delivery in strategic account planning, executive reviews and pre-sales discussions for complex opportunities.
* Provide delivery insight during opportunity qualification, solution planning and commercial development to ensure commitments are achievable.
* Capture and share lessons learned, reusable assets and delivery best practices across the region.

**Required Experience And Qualifications**

* Typically 15 or more years of relevant experience with a bachelor’s degree, 12 or more years with a master’s degree, or 8 or more years with a PhD; equivalent combinations of education and substantial professional experience will also be considered.
* Recognized expertise in enterprise program management, professional-services delivery, customer transformation or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated success leading large, complex and strategically important programs involving multiple projects, functions, partners and geographies.
* Proven ability to serve as a principal adviser to senior leaders, helping shape critical decisions and resolve issues that materially affect customer outcomes, program success and organizational objectives.
* Extensive experience establishing governance structures, delivery standards, operating plans and controls for complex enterprise programs.
* Strong track record of solving ambiguous and high-impact problems where information may be incomplete, considerable judgment is required and decisions have long-term implications.
* Demonstrated ability to assess risks and develop solutions that account for dependencies and impacts across multiple functions, business units or geographies.
* Proven accountability for program financial performance, including revenue forecasting, backlog conversion, delivery velocity, margin management, resource planning and commercial change control.
* Demonstrated experience connecting technology delivery to measurable customer business outcomes, adoption goals and value-realization objectives.
* Strong executive presence, with experience establishing trusted relationships and formal networks with senior internal leaders, customer executives, partners and other external decision-makers.
* Ability to serve as a Genesys expert and external spokesperson on strategic program delivery, governance and transformation matters.
* Demonstrated ability to influence decisions and drive action across organizational boundaries without relying on direct reporting authority.
* Experience providing guidance, coaching and professional development to Project Managers, Program Managers, Delivery Managers and other delivery professionals.
* Proven ability to lead large cross-functional initiatives of strategic importance. Direct people-management experience is beneficial but is not a prerequisite for the role.
* Deep understanding of enterprise cloud transformation, customer-experience technology and professional-services delivery. Experience with Genesys Cloud or large-scale contact-center transformation is strongly preferred.
* Exceptional executive communication, negotiation, facilitation, conflict-resolution and escalation-management capabilities.
* Project or program management certification—such as PgMP, PMP, PRINCE2 or an equivalent—is preferred.

**Leadership Capabilities**
The successful candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Executive presence and credibility.
* Strong ownership and accountability.
* Customer- and outcome-first decision-making.
* Commercial and financial acumen.
* Structured problem-solving and sound judgment.
* The ability to see both program-level detail and the broader strategic picture.
* Confidence operating in ambiguity and managing competing priorities.
* Empathy combined with the willingness to address difficult issues directly.
* The ability to influence without relying on formal authority.

Title: Cybersecurity Manager
Description:
**JOB OVERVIEW**

The Cyber Security Manager is responsible for the day-to-day operation and continuous improvement of information security controls across Daman Securities and Daman Investments. The role manages the relationship with the Group's managed security service provider, runs vulnerability management and incident response, maintains security policies and the risk register, and supports regulatory and audit requests. The Cyber Security Manager reports to the Group CIO and executes the Group's information security program rather than setting Group strategy.

**KEY DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Security Operations & Incident Response**

* Manage the day-to-day relationship with the managed SOC / MSSP, including alert triage, escalation, and tracking performance against SLA.
* Execute incident response playbooks, coordinate containment and recovery, and support post-incident review and regulatory notification under the Group CIO's direction.
* Run the vulnerability management programme and coordinate penetration testing, tracking findings through to remediation.

**Policy, Risk & Compliance Support**

* Maintain and update information security policies, standards, and procedures within the framework set by the Group CIO.
* Maintain the information security risk register and produce regular reporting on risk position and remediation status.
* Prepare evidence and coordinate responses for internal audit, external audit, and CMA regulatory requests on information security matters.
* Support responses to institutional due diligence reviews and client security questionnaires for Daman Securities and Daman Investments clients.

**Identity, Access & Data Security**

* Administer identity and access management processes, including joiner-mover-leaver workflows, privileged access, and periodic access recertification.
* Support data classification, data loss prevention, and encryption standards, and test backup and recovery restorability.
* Provide security input on change requests — new systems, integrations, and vendor onboarding — ahead of go-live.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent demonstrable experience.

**Technical Competencies**

* Working knowledge of security operations, incident response, vulnerability management, identity and access management, and data protection.
* Familiarity with Microsoft 365 security tooling (Defender, Entra ID, Purview) and cloud security fundamentals.
* Experience working with a managed SOC or MSSP provider.
* Working knowledge of UAE information security expectations relevant to financial services (CMA, PDPL) is an advantage.

**Skills/Personal Attributes**

* Structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to execute consistently against an established control framework.
* Good communicator, comfortable working across IT, trading, wealth management, and HR/EOS teams.
* High level of integrity and discretion in handling sensitive and confidential information.
* Arabic language skills are an advantage.

**Work Experience**

* 5–8 years of experience in information security or IT risk, with hands-on exposure to SOC operations, vulnerability management, or identity and access management.
* Experience in financial services is preferred but not required.
* A relevant certification (e.g. CISSP, CISM, CISA, Security+) is preferred, or a willingness to obtain one.

* Own end-to-end programme leadership as the single point of accountability for Adobe delivery across complex, multi-workstream transformation programmes, co-leading with the customer's programme lead and establishing clear decision rights and one escalation path.

* Coach project and programme managers across UKI and the Middle East, contribute reusable programme practices and lessons learned, and raise the standard of complex programme leadership across the region.

What you'll need to succeed
  
  

* Extensive experience leading large, strategic, multi-workstream transformation programmes in consulting, enterprise technology or professional services, typically gained over 12+ years in programme delivery and leadership roles.
* Demonstrable experience delivering successfully in Saudi Arabia and the wider Middle East, with a strong understanding of regional business culture, stakeholder expectations, relationship-led ways of working and the practical realities of mobilising teams in the region. An established local network is highly advantageous.
* A strong record of owning customer outcomes, programme health, predictable revenue, financial milestones, delivery forecasts and commercial performance across complex enterprise engagements.
* Exceptional executive presence and the ability to build trusted relationships with customer directors, VPs and C-level stakeholders, including during major decisions, escalations and programme recovery.
* Proven ability to lead multidisciplinary, geographically distributed and cross-functional teams across CX, Creative & Production, Professional Services, Customer Success, Sales, product, engineering and strategic partners, often through influence rather than direct authority.
* Deep programme management and commercial capability across mobilisation, integrated planning, governance, financial control, forecasting, resourcing, RAID, change control, milestone acceptance and executive reporting.
* Experience connecting enterprise technology delivery to adoption, operating-model change, measurable business outcomes and sustained value realisation. Familiarity with Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, Adobe Firefly, Firefly Foundry or comparable enterprise platforms is advantageous.
* A calm, inclusive and decisive leadership style, with excellent written, verbal and presentation skills in English. Arabic language capability would be advantageous.
* A recognised programme or project management qualification such as MSP, PMI PgMP/PMP, PRINCE2 or equivalent is desirable, together with substantial experience of Agile and hybrid delivery methods.

You'll help shape how AI opportunities are discovered, evaluated, prioritized, built, and deployed—working with a multidisciplinary engineering team, institutional leaders, and technology partners to move ideas from concept to production.

Imagine helping bring to life an AI-powered student concierge that supports students throughout their academic journey, intelligent service agents that transform how employees access support, or AI-enabled workflows that eliminate friction and create new possibilities across the institution. These are the kinds of opportunities the AI Incubator is being established to pursue.

Reporting directly to the Associate Vice President, Strategy, Innovation and Assurance, who establishes the College's institutional AI strategy and direction, you will lead the Incubator's product and delivery activities. You'll translate approved strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps, coordinate technical delivery, manage the Incubator's portfolio and budget, and work with functional-area product owners to ensure solutions deliver meaningful business value.

This isn't a role focused on producing AI strategy documents. It's about turning strategy into working solutions—and ensuring those solutions make a difference.

  

**Responsibilities**  
  
Shape the AI Opportunity Pipeline and Product Roadmap

* Lead the AI Incubator's opportunity intake, assessment, and prioritization processes across academic, student-service, and administrative areas.
* Partner with institutional leaders, faculty, staff, and service owners to identify high-value opportunities for AI Agents, generative AI, intelligent automation, and emerging technologies.
* Facilitate discovery sessions that translate real-world challenges into compelling product concepts, clear requirements, and measurable success criteria.
* Evaluate opportunities against strategic alignment, technical feasibility, data readiness, cost, risk, and anticipated value.
* Develop business cases, product roadmaps, delivery recommendations, and benefits hypotheses that support informed institutional decision-making.

  

Turn AI Concepts into Real-World Solutions

* Lead cross-functional delivery planning, translating approved initiatives into coordinated work plans, milestones, dependencies, and release schedules.
* Work closely with AI Development, Data, and Platform Engineers to assess technical approaches and coordinate the delivery of secure, scalable, production-ready solutions.
* Facilitate product discovery, backlog refinement, prototype reviews, pilot planning, and release readiness activities.
* Evaluate engineering recommendations involving AI Agent architecture, large language models, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), enterprise integrations, and platform capabilities.
* Coordinate testing, business acceptance, deployment readiness, and operational transition with functional-area product owners and IT teams.
* Identify delivery risks, competing priorities, and resource constraints, recommending practical solutions and escalating decisions where necessary.

  

Drive Adoption, Impact, and Continuous Improvement

* Partner with functional-area product owners to establish measurable outcomes, adoption targets, and benefits realization approaches.
* Coordinate demonstrations, pilots, user feedback, and change enablement activities to support successful adoption.
* Monitor product performance, adoption, task completion, service improvements, cost avoidance, and other indicators of realized value.
* Translate delivery progress and performance insights into executive-ready reports and recommendations.
* Help establish repeatable approaches for AI product discovery, evaluation, delivery, and continuous improvement

  

Champion Responsible and Sustainable AI

* Collaborate with cybersecurity, privacy, enterprise architecture, and data governance specialists to embed responsible AI principles throughout the delivery lifecycle.
* Ensure appropriate consideration of AI accuracy, groundedness, reliability, accessibility, human oversight, security, and operational readiness.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and delivery approaches, balancing innovation with institutional risk, cost, and sustainability.
* Manage the AI Incubator's approved budget and coordinate the work of external vendors and technology partners.
* Foster a collaborative, delivery-focused environment where experimentation, learning, accountability, and measurable results go hand in hand.

  

**Qualifications/Experience**

* A four-year degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
* Seven-years of progressive experience in digital product management, technology delivery, business transformation, or cross-functional program management, ideally involving AI, automation, cloud technologies, or enterprise applications.
* Strong understanding of generative AI, AI Agents, large language models, RAG, enterprise integration, data architecture, and cloud-based AI platforms.
* Experience translating complex business challenges into product requirements, delivery roadmaps, prioritized backlogs, and measurable outcomes.
* Demonstrated ability to evaluate technical recommendations and trade-offs involving feasibility, security, scalability, performance, cost, and supportability.
* Experience coordinating multidisciplinary technical teams, business stakeholders, external vendors, and complex delivery dependencies.
* Knowledge of agile delivery, product lifecycle management, user acceptance testing, change enablement, and benefits realization.
* Strong financial, analytical, and organizational skills, including budget oversight, business case development, and executive reporting.
* Exceptional communication, facilitation, stakeholder engagement, and relationship management skills.
* Experience with Microsoft Azure, Microsoft Foundry, Copilot Studio, Microsoft Fabric, or comparable enterprise AI platforms is an asset.
* Experience in higher education, the public sector, or another complex service-oriented organization is an asset.

  

**What will set you apart?**  
You're equally comfortable discussing business outcomes with senior executives and challenging technical assumptions with engineers. You understand that a successful AI initiative isn't measured by how impressive the demonstration looks, but by whether the solution works, is adopted, and delivers lasting value.  
  
You're curious, pragmatic, collaborative, and energized by the opportunity to build something new.  
Most importantly, you're ready to help move AI from possibility to production.

Title: CIAM Operations Support Lead
Description:
Requisition ID: 278669
  
  
Join a purpose driven winning team, committed to results, in an inclusive and high-performing culture.
  
  
If you are passionate about Site Reliability Engineering and Software Operations Management with a strong technical mindset, keen interest in authentication and security, and thrive in a fast-moving environment - this is the position for you!
  
  
**Is this role right for you? In this role you will:**

* Lead CIAM SecDevOps and Operations, ensuring secure, consistent, automated, resilient, and scalable deployment and production support models.
* Lead the development, orchestration, security integration, and continuous improvement of CI/CD pipelines and SecDevOps automation frameworks.
* Embed security-by-design and shift-left security practices across the CI/CD lifecycle, including automated code, dependency, vulnerability, configuration, and security scanning.
* Oversee the development and continuous improvement of CIAM observability, monitoring, alerting, and operational health frameworks.
* Manage the CIAM operations and production support team; optimise workflows and mentor direct reports to maximise business, security, and technical effectiveness.
* Manage escalations and production incidents, adapting established procedures and approaches to specific situations, including 24x7 production support, incident response, service restoration, and recovery coordination.
* Own and continuously enhance SecDevOps processes, engineering standards, automation, security controls, and operational practices.
* Build and maintain production monitoring and observability frameworks leveraging tools such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow.
* Drive proactive vulnerability remediation, software currency, security hardening, patching, and configuration compliance across CIAM platforms.
* Provide technical leadership for Linux-based environments, including RHEL, covering administration, troubleshooting, patching, security hardening, performance analysis, automation, and production support.
* Ensure compliance with all applicable Scotiabank IT risk, security, regulatory, governance, and compliance requirements.
* Lead by example to develop operational plans, engineering standards, and procedures that improve time-to-market, security posture, service availability, resilience, and system reliability.
* Measure and optimise system performance, availability, security, and operational health to continuously improve CIAM capabilities.
* Participate in defining and managing SLIs, SLOs and SLAs for enterprise CIAM services.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for CIAM SecDevOps, guiding teams through SecDevOps maturity, automation, cloud adoption, identity security, vulnerability management, and secure engineering best practices.
* Partner with application development and engineering teams to investigate production issues, identify root causes, remediate security vulnerabilities, and safely deploy fixes.
* Work closely with Scotiabank infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud, network, database, and platform teams to maintain CIAM infrastructure and deliver infrastructure upgrades, security remediation and software currency initiatives.
* Provide production support and escalation during business and off-hours. Apply sound and rapid judgement to incidents and security events, recommending workarounds or permanent resolutions that minimise service disruption and unplanned production outages.
* Perform risk assessments, security reviews, vulnerability assessments, and control reviews for CIAM implementations and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture diagrams, security designs, configuration guides, operational procedures, support playbooks, and recovery documentation.
* Establish effective working relationships across business, cybersecurity, infrastructure, architecture, application development, programme, and project management teams.
* Understand how the Bank’s risk appetite and risk culture apply to day-to-day engineering, security, operational, and technology decisions.
* Champion a customer-focused and security-first engineering culture, fostering collaboration across business, security, infrastructure, and technology teams.
* Champion a high-performance, accountable, collaborative, and inclusive work environment.

**Skills**
**Do you have the skills that will enable you to succeed in this role? We’d love to work with you if you have:**

* 7+ years of experience as an Operations lead, SecDevOps/DevOps Lead, SRE Lead, Engineering Lead, or equivalent role within a large enterprise product or platform team.
* 7+ years of experience in application engineering, deployments, security, and production support for large, complex, highly available enterprise systems.
* Strong experience with Linux/Unix platforms, preferably Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL), including system administration, troubleshooting, patching, security hardening, performance analysis, shell scripting, and production support.
* Strong understanding of Linux security concepts, including file permissions, service management, certificates, TLS configuration, system logs, vulnerability remediation, and operating-system hardening.
* Experience with cloud and container technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and PCF, particularly in building secure, automated, self-service platforms.
* Sound knowledge of networking concepts including TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, firewalls, load balancing, proxies, certificates, and the OSI model.
* Strong understanding of multi-tier applications, distributed systems, microservices architectures, containerised workloads, and cloud-hosted software stacks.
* 5+ years of hands-on experience creating and managing CI/CD or SecDevOps pipelines to build, scan, test, package, and deploy applications across production and pre-production environments.
* Hands-on experience integrating security controls and vulnerability scanning into CI/CD pipelines, supporting a shift-left security model.
* 5+ years of experience with configuration-management and Infrastructure-as-Code technologies such as Ansible, Terraform, Chef, or Puppet.
* Strong scripting and automation experience using technologies such as Python, Bash, Java, and Ansible.
* Experience with enterprise CI/CD and engineering toolchains such as Jenkins, Gradle, Bitbucket, Artifactory, and Jira.
* Strong experience with vulnerability management, security remediation, software currency, patch management, certificate/TLS management, and platform security hardening.
* Strong working knowledge of IAM/CIAM concepts, including authentication, authorisation, identity lifecycle management, privileged access, federation, and secure identity integrations.
* Strong experience with incident, problem, and change management, including implementation of monitoring, alerting, service recovery, root-cause analysis, and preventative remediation.
* Experience with observability and monitoring platforms such as Splunk, Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, PagerDuty, and ServiceNow.
* Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills for complex IAM, CIAM, Linux, infrastructure, security, and application integration issues.
* Strong understanding of security-by-design, least privilege, defence-in-depth, secure configuration, vulnerability remediation, and risk-based security principles.
* Excellent communication, leadership, organisational, and time-management skills, with a strong work ethic and reliability.
* Ability to develop high-quality technical documentation, including architecture and security diagrams, configuration guides, operational procedures, runbooks, and support documentation.
* Experience developing communications, briefings, technical recommendations, and presentations for senior executives and technology leadership.
* Proven success working within a matrix organisation and leading or influencing cross-functional engineering, infrastructure, cybersecurity, architecture, and business teams, including senior management.
* Strong prioritisation, planning, analytical, presentation, project/change management, stakeholder management, and relationship-building skills.

**What's in it for you?**

Scotiabank continues to locate, remove and prevent barriers so that we can build a diverse and inclusive environment while meeting accessibility requirements.

Title: Manager, Customer Success Technology
Description:
**Do you get energized by building the systems and AI-powered workflows that help a Customer Success team deliver exceptional service at scale?**
=================================================================================================================================================

Then Jobber might be the place for you! We're looking for a **Manager, Customer Success Technology** to be part of our **Success Operations** department.

Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!

Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500 lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.

**The team:**

The Success Operations team is the operational backbone of Jobber's Success organization, spanning three connected pillars: operations, technology, and workforce management. Together, the team equips Customer Success with the people, process, systems, and insights they need to make decisions, scale consistently, and deliver against their goals.

**The role:**

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Success Operations, the **Manager, Customer Success Technology** will own the technology that powers Customer Success teams. This is a hands-on people leader and problem solver who develops technical talent, balances competing priorities, and delivers scalable systems and AI-first solutions.

**The Manager, Customer Success Technology will:**

* Manage and develop a team of CS Tech Admins, building their skills and technical effectiveness.
* Champion automation and process improvement by identifying manual work to streamline and prioritizing changes that balance speed, experience, accuracy, and maintainability.
* Roll out and maintain AI tools and AI-enabled workflows, monitoring their performance and reliability and establishing governance and business continuity plans.
* Set the standard for intake, triage, and issue resolution, assessing requests for scope, priority, and business impact and resolving them quickly and effectively.
* Establish the KPIs and SLAs for CS Tech and hold the team accountable to clear, measurable outcomes.
* Guide the team's delivery, from configuration changes to minor builds to large transformations, in partnership with Success Operations, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Support complex technology projects from ideation to launch, surfacing technical risks, balancing business needs against technical constraints, and communicating trade-offs.
* Establish and maintain best practices for technical delivery that make the team's work repeatable and scalable.
* Own the health, performance, and roadmap of the Customer Success (CS) tech stack, and establish the frameworks and metrics to evaluate its ROI.
* Manage vendor relationships and licensing across the CS tech stack, making informed decisions that balance capability and cost.
* Build trusted partnerships with Success leaders, translating their needs into a coherent technology roadmap.

**To be successful, you should have:**

* Demonstrated people leadership experience, with a track record of developing technical talent and building high-performing teams.
* Experience working with or in a Customer Success organization, including a solid understanding of how Product Support and Onboarding teams operate and how technology helps them scale and deliver outcomes.
* Extensive experience with customer success tools such as Salesforce Service Cloud, Amazon Connect, Intercom, Assembled, ChiliPiper, Revenue.IO, or similar.
* Hands-on experience designing, building, and running AI-enabled workflows and agents, including monitoring their performance and reliability and establishing governance.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate with engineering teams on complex technology programs using Agile and Scrum methodologies, along with project and program best practices, tools, and techniques. Agile training and experience preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to build strong cross-functional partnerships.
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to turn data into clear, actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.
* The ability to work on multiple projects at once, including establishing new processes and streamlining existing ones.
* Comfort with ambiguity and change. We're growing fast, and what worked yesterday might not work today.
* A bias toward action, with the judgment to make informed decisions, move work forward, and adapt as new information emerges.

**Compensation:**

At Jobber, we believe that compensation should be transparent, fair, and reflective of your experience and growth. This role has a **minimum annual salary of $120,870, a midpoint of $142,200, and a maximum salary of $163,530**, designed to show the progression from learning the ropes to truly excelling.

We design our compensation to reflect each new hire's skills, experience against the complexity of the role, ensuring a fair and competitive salary. Our range is intentionally broad to support growth and long-term impact, with fully established hires typically starting around the midpoint. The higher end of the range is reserved for those who have demonstrated deep expertise and lasting contributions, while offers below the midpoint reflect strong potential with room to develop. This approach ensures that compensation aligns with both an individual's current capabilities and their opportunity for future growth.

Base salary is just one part of a total compensation package that will include equity rewards, annual stipends for health and wellness, retirement savings matching, and an extended health package with fully paid premiums for body and mind. Your professional growth matters to us too! You'll have access to a dedicated talent development program that includes career coaching and opportunities for career development.

We believe in transparency and open conversations about compensation. If you have any questions about our approach, we're happy to discuss them throughout the hiring process!

**Location:**

We believe great collaboration is intentional, and sometimes that means coming together in person to build, brainstorm, and connect. To support this, the role is open to candidates based in one of our hub cities: **Edmonton, Toronto, Vancouver, or Kitchener-Waterloo.**

**What you can expect from Jobber:**

* A total compensation package that includes an extended health benefits package with fully paid premiums for both body and mind, matching in RRSP, TFSA or FHSA, and stock options.
* A dedicated Talent Development team and access to coaching, learning, and leadership programs to help you grow your career, reach your goals, and unlock your full potential.
* A unique opportunity to build, grow, and leave your impact on a $400-billion industry that has no dominant player...yet.
* To work with a group of people who are humble, supportive, and give a sh\*t about our customers.

*We believe that diverse teams perform better and that fostering an inclusive work environment is a key part of growing a successful team. We welcome people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to working with applicants requesting accommodation at any stage of the hiring process.*

**A bit more about us:**

Job by job, we’re transforming the way service is delivered. Your lawn care provider, home cleaning service, plumber or painter could use Jobber to better connect with their customers, save time in the office, invoice faster, and get paid! We’re bringing tens of thousands of people together with technology to deliver billions of dollars a year in services to happy customers. Jobber exists to help make these small businesses successful, and when they’re successful we all win!

Title: Senior Project Manager

Description:
