**The Senior Project Manager**
is responsible to lead the end-to-end delivery of strategic software and IT services engagements for key customers in Saudi Arabia. The role combines delivery leadership, customer relationship management, commercial discipline, and governance. The Senior Project Manager will be accountable for managing complex, business-critical technology projects from initiation through successful delivery and closure, ensuring alignment with contractual commitments, customer expectations, quality standards, and organizational objectives.
  
  
The position requires to provide senior-level leadership to multidisciplinary delivery teams, proactively manage project risks and dependencies, and maintain clear, decision-oriented communication with customer executives and internal leadership.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**
**Project Delivery Management**

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex IT projects and programs
* Develop and manage integrated project plans covering scope, schedule, budget, resources, dependencies,

quality, and acceptance criteria.
  
  

* Monitor project performance and ensure delivery aligns with contractual commitments and business objectives
* Drive successful execution across all phases of the project lifecycle

**Financial & Commercial Management**

* Manage project budgets, cost controls (CPI monitoring[ME1] ), and financial performance
* Monitor resource utilization, project profitability, and delivery investments
* Track revenue milestones, customer acceptance, and contractual obligations
* Identify and manage commercial risks and contractual exposures

**Change Management**

* Govern project change requests and scope modifications
* Ensure all changes are evaluated, estimated, approved, and contractually aligned before implementation
* Manage project baselines and change control documentation
* Minimize scope creep through disciplined governance

**Resource & Capacity Management**

* Coordinate resource planning with PMO, engineering, operations, and supporting teams
* Manage project staffing requirements and allocation plans
* Identify resource constraints and implement mitigation strategies
* Optimize resource utilization across projects and workstreams

**Stakeholder & Customer Management**

* Build and maintain strong customer relationships
* Lead customer governance meetings, steering committees, executive reviews, and status discussions
* Manage customer expectations and ensure timely decision-making and approvals
* Act as the primary escalation point for project-related matters

**Leadership & Team Coordination**

* Coordinate activities across software engineering, QA, DevOps, architecture, infrastructure, security,

business analysis, and external vendors.
  
  

* Foster collaboration, accountability, and delivery excellence
* Support mentoring and guidance for Project Managers and delivery personnel

**Delivery Methodologies & SDLC Oversight**

* Apply Agile, Scrum, Waterfall, and Hybrid delivery methodologies as appropriate
* Ensure adherence to Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) processes
* Oversee release planning, deployment coordination, testing, and production readiness
* Support continuous delivery and operational excellence practices

**Vendor & Third-Party Management**

* Manage external vendors, partners, and subcontractors supporting project delivery
* Monitor vendor performance and contractual obligations

**Project Recovery & Performance Improvement**

* Develop and execute recovery plans for challenged projects

* Implement corrective actions to restore project performance
* Continuously monitor and improve delivery effectiveness

**Project Closure & Knowledge Management**

* Ensure successful project closure and operational handover
* Capture lessons learned and best practices

Title: Partner Portfolio Lead Architect
Description:
**THE ROLE: THE RIGHT PARTNER, ON THE RIGHT TERMS**
---------------------------------------------------

Reporting to the Head of Partner Strategy, you lead the decision on which partners are brought into Echelon’s portfolio and under what terms. Each recommendation goes to the leadership team after you apply four key tests: technology, industry, layer, and mutual fit. You collaborate with the CRO’s technical principal and our engineers for technical diligence, tap account teams for customer insight, and leverage Partner Sourcing and Intelligence to challenge and enhance recommendations. Then, you agree on the partnership model, contract framework, and commercial terms with Legal, Finance and the business, before handing each signed partner to Partner Development for activation.

**Your Mandate:**
-----------------

* **The right technology:** Collaborate with engineering leadership to assess candidates’ architecture, maturity, security, and deployability, considering engineering effort required.
* **The right industry:** Validate industry demand with account teams—sectors, use cases, and accounts—before committing.
* **The right layer:** Determine where the partner sits in the stack and if that layer needs filling, strengthening, or should remain open.
* **The right mutual fit:** Assess strategic intent, commercial ambition, ways of working, and appetite for joint investment, ensuring mutual commitment.
* **A portfolio that holds:** Evaluate each partner’s addition relative to our roadmap and signed partners, checking for gaps, overlaps, or competition, and ensuring a cohesive market offering.
* **The model and the terms:** Recommend a partnership model, negotiate terms—go-to-market, delivery, revenue share, exclusivity, liabilities, and exit—with leadership, Legal, Finance, and the business.
* **Build the recruitment model:** With leadership and Partner Sourcing and Intelligence, shape the partner profiles, assessment frameworks, recruitment process, and the operating model for smooth partner transition.

**WHERE WE ALIGN**
------------------

### **AI AND TECHNOLOGY FIRST**

* **Partnership record:** Experience assessing, structuring, and signing partnerships at a technology vendor, integrator, or in corporate development or consulting.
* **Technical judgement:** Comfortable engaging engineers on architecture, integration, and deployment; able to discern robust technology from demonstrations.
* **Industry sense:** Deep understanding of how sectors buy and run technology, with an ability to judge where value will (and won’t) be created.
* **Commercial structuring:** Designed channel/partnership models and negotiated revenue share or terms with larger counterparties.
* **Portfolio and fit judgement:** Credibility with founders, engineers, Legal, and Finance; able to assess how partners add to the whole.

### **STRONG ADVANTAGE**

* **Ecosystem background:** Experience in a technology vendor’s partner organisation or a cloud provider’s ecosystem team.
* **Deal experience:** Exposure to venture investment, M&A, or joint ventures, including diligence and documentation.
* **Sector knowledge:** Depth in sectors where Echelon leads (government, energy, financial services, healthcare).
* **Arabic:** Professional fluency in Arabic.

**OUR VALUES**
--------------

* **Customer first:** Measured by customer outcomes; prioritise accordingly.
* **Ownership mentality:** Own outcomes end-to-end; fix what breaks or stalls.
* **Clear communicator:** Simplify complex systems; make the value of your work visible.
* **Comfortable with ambiguity:** Progress with partial data and unclear environments.
* **Long-term builder:** Invest in Echelon’s success; bring insight back to strategy and operations.
* **Builds others:** Measure success by the people and capabilities you develop.

**THE SEAT**
------------

* **Location:** Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
* **Reports to:** Head of Partner Strategy
* **Travel:** Limited
* **Package:** Base salary plus housing, transport, education allowances, medical cover, and equity through our employee equity programme. Full terms shared at offer stage.

**HOW WE WORK**
---------------

You start from the problem, not the tool—and greet unclear briefs or broken environments with energy and a plan.

* **Curiosity:** Always learning how work really happens on site and how the stack evolves.
* **Speed:** Move quickly from brief to working result; don’t wait for perfect conditions.
* **Rigour:** Test all claims against data; explain every decision.
* **Confidence & humility:** Challenge and be challenged; change your view on evidence, without ego.
* **Autonomy:** Make decisions and organise work with incomplete information.
* **Resourcefulness:** Thrive with missing access, partial data, or unfamiliar organisations.
* **Situational leadership:** Lead or follow as the moment calls for it.
* **A force multiplier:** Your playbooks, reviews, and coaching make everyone faster.
* **AI-native depth:** AI tools are integral to how you research, assess, and negotiate—testing technology, markets, and deals faster than others.
* **Where you are:** A senior partnership builder, judging across technology, industry, and commerce—ready to shape Echelon’s partner portfolio and the model that supports it.

**What We Offer**

* Remote working environment
* An opportunity to make a significant impact in a fast-growing company

* Collaborative, creative, and supportive work environment

**Job Description:**
The Head of IT Data Governance reports to the Group Head of IT and Security and is accountable for the quality, consistency and usability of the data the IT function relies on to run and improve itself. The role involves leading the IT Data Programme and establishing and sustaining an IT data governance capability that keeps the data model accurate.
  
  
This is a governance role, not a data ownership role. The IT leader accountable for a service remains accountable for the data supporting that service (e.g. the Head of IT Infrastructure and Networks owns infrastructure and identity data, the Head of IT Platforms owns platform and application data, etc.). This role is responsible for implementing and operationalising data governance across IT, in accordance with the Enterprise Data Governance framework, policies and standards. It works closely with the Enterprise Data lead to ensure alignment with enterprise governance, data quality, metadata and information management requirements.
  
  
The role develops IT-specific controls within the enterprise framework, measures compliance, reports performance and escalates non-compliance through agreed arrangements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Lead the IT Data Programme
  

* Own delivery of the IT Data Programme end to end, including the traceability model, the roadmap and the implementation backlog that follows.
* Make sure the programme answers the business questions IT needs answered and doesn't become a documentation exercise. Every data requirement should be traced to a question and every gap to a prioritised action.
* Turn assessment findings into a sequenced backlog with named owners and see it through to completion.

Implement and operate the data governance framework
  

* Implement and operationalise the enterprise Data Governance Framework within IT. Support the nomination of named Data Owners, Stewards and Custodians across in-scope IT data domains, consistent with enterprise roles, responsibilities, standards and decision rights.
* Apply enterprise data governance decision rights, escalation pathways and dispute resolution processes to IT data domains, escalating cross-functional matters through the established enterprise governance arrangements.
* Set up and chair an IT Data Governance forum that makes decisions instead of reviewing status, aligned with the Enterprise Data Governance Framework and the governance arrangements led by the Enterprise Data team. Oversee IT data quality, stewardship, compliance and remediation through the forum.
* Support the identification of a network of data stewards in each IT function, and support their training, standards and ways of working.
* Hold Data Owners to account for the quality of their domains and report non-compliance through appropriate escalations.

Maintain IT data standards, definitions and authoritative sources
  

* Develop and maintain the IT domain-specific data definitions, metadata, reference data and lifecycle requirements in accordance with enterprise data standards established by the Enterprise Data team, working closely with Enterprise Architecture and relevant Data Owners.
* Maintain the catalogue of IT systems of record and their authoritative data sources, ensuring alignment with the enterprise data catalogue and metadata standards. Identify and resolve IT-specific source conflicts, escalating cross-domain ownership or authoritative source disputes through enterprise data governance.
* Ensure that IT data assets, ownership, classifications, definitions and lineage are maintained in the enterprise data catalogue, working with the Enterprise Data team to establish consistent metadata and assurance requirements.
* Govern alignment to the ServiceNow Common Service Data Model, ensuring the CMDB conforms to the enterprise IT data model rather than diverging from it.
* Apply the existing data standards that system integrations, platform changes and new tooling must meet before approval.

Data quality, measurement and remediation
  

* Implement the enterprise data quality framework across IT data domains, developing domain-specific rules, thresholds, controls and KPIs in collaboration with IT Data Owners and Stewards, consistent with enterprise data quality standards and reporting requirements.
* Establish ongoing data quality measurement and remediation across IT data domains, using enterprise-approved methodologies and integrating results into enterprise data quality reporting and assurance processes.
* Drive remediation of quality failures through the accountable Data Owner, escalating where remediation does not happen.
* Operate the IT data certification process, so users of the data know which data they can trust.
* Operate the information lifecycle for IT data, including retention, archiving and disposal, in line with Information Security policy.
* Build data literacy across IT leadership so Data Owners understand and can discharge their accountability.
* Publish and track an IT data maturity assessment, with a target state and a measurable trajectory.

Reporting and insight
  

* Lead the development of trusted IT management reporting and performance measures, ensuring alignment with enterprise data architecture, common definitions, semantic standards and approved reporting platforms, in collaboration with Enterprise Data and Enterprise Architecture. This should be the single agreed source of the metrics used in leadership reporting, scorecards and business impact reporting.
* Ensure that every metric reported to leadership has a defined calculation, a named owner and a known level of confidence.
* Reduce reporting duplication across the function, retiring competing versions of the same measure.
* Provide the data foundation that lets IT quantify its impact on business productivity in hours and cost.

Enable AI and automation
  

* Lead IT data readiness activities supporting enterprise AI and automation initiatives, working with the Enterprise Data team to assess data availability, quality, classification, accessibility and fitness for purpose against enterprise AI readiness and governance requirements.
* Maintain the data classification and sensitivity position for IT data sources feeding AI and automation tooling, to standards set by Information Security.
* Identify and prioritise the data gaps that currently prevent automation, agentic use cases and self-healing capability.
* Collaborate with the Enterprise Data team to prioritise IT data improvements that enable agreed AI analytics and automation use cases, ensuring alignment with the enterprise data strategy and roadmap.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* IT Data Programme milestones delivered to committed dates.
* Percentage of in-scope IT data domains with a named Data Owner and Data Steward.
* Percentage of core IT data entities with a defined authoritative source and no unresolved source conflict.
* Data quality scores by domain, trending against published thresholds.
* Number of data quality defects remediated after their committed date, trending down.
* CMDB completeness and accuracy against the CSDM-aligned target model.
* Percentage of leadership metrics with a defined calculation, named owner and stated confidence level.
* Reduction in duplicate or competing versions of the same reported measure.
* IT data maturity assessment score, trending against target.
* Number of business questions the function can answer reliably, against the agreed question set.

**Candidate Specification**

Title: Bid Manager
Description:
**About the Role**

Lead InfraX's end-to-end bid, solutioning and commercial development lifecycle, converting customer requirements into compliant, competitive and executable multi or single-vendor solutions. The role coordinates technical, commercial, financial, procurement, legal and delivery inputs across InfraX's connectivity, telecommunications, IoT, managed services and digital infrastructure portfolio. It owns bid strategy, business cases, pricing and governance from opportunity qualification and ideation through contract award, delivery handover, execution oversight, revenue recognition and collection readiness, ensuring commitments are profitable, deliverable and aligned with customer outcomes and InfraX objectives.

**Responsibilities**

* Lead bid lifecycle: Own qualification, bid planning, compliance, response development, reviews, approvals, submission, clarification, negotiation and handover for RFIs, RFPs, tenders and direct proposals.
* Establish governance: Create the bid plan, responsibility matrix, review gates, document controls, risk log and approval path; ensure adherence to customer instructions and InfraX governance.
* Shape the win strategy: Define customer value proposition, differentiators, competitive positioning, partners, commercial approach and executive messaging with the opportunity owner.
* Translate needs into solutions: Structure customer business, technical, operational, security, service-level and implementation requirements into a coherent solution and scope of work.
* Cover InfraX environment: Coordinate solutions spanning fiber and managed connectivity, MPLS and enterprise networks, IoT and sensor ecosystems, LoRaWAN/RF mesh, private LTE/5G, cloud/edge, platforms, systems integration, professional services, operations and support.
* Maintain traceability: Use compliance matrices, assumptions, exclusions, interfaces, dependencies and acceptance criteria to keep the solution complete and auditable.
* Architect one integrated offer: Combine InfraX capabilities with multiple OEMs, technology vendors, telecom operators, cloud providers, system integrators, subcontractors and affiliates into one end-to-end solution.
* Align responsibilities: Define work packages, bills of materials, partner scopes, interfaces, warranties, SLAs, support models, delivery obligations and a clear RACI.
* Validate third-party inputs: Obtain and challenge quotations, technical compliance, lead times, dependencies, licensing, support, validity and contractual flow-downs; remove gaps, overlaps and unpriced exposure, vendor price protection.
* Build the business case: Develop CAPEX/OPEX, one-time and recurring revenue models, total contract value, cost-to-serve, gross margin, cash flow, payback, NPV/IRR where applicable, sensitivity scenarios and funding requirements.
* Design commercial models: Structure outright purchase, subscription, managed service, lease, consumption-based, revenue-share, project-finance or public-private-partnership approaches where relevant.
* Protect profitability: Validate pricing, mark-ups, contingencies, taxes, foreign exchange, escalation, payment milestones, performance securities, penalties and working-capital exposure with Finance and Procurement.
* Produce quality submissions: Lead clear, persuasive and compliant technical and commercial proposals, executive summaries, implementation plans, pricing schedules, presentations and clarification responses.
* Coordinate reviews: Consolidate inputs from Sales, Technology, Operations, Project Delivery, Finance, Procurement, Legal, Risk and partners; close review comments before approval.
* Support negotiations: Manage clarifications, best-and-final offers and scope or price revisions while maintaining an approved negotiation position and complete decision record.
* Delivery Planning: Ideation to Execution
* Design for execution: Define delivery strategy, work breakdown, resources, milestones, dependencies, procurement lead times, testing, commissioning, migration, acceptance, training, transition and service commencement.
* Assure deliverability: Validate capacity, resources, permits, access, logistics, cybersecurity, safety, operational readiness and vendor commitments before submission.
* Handover to delivery: Conduct a formal post-award handover covering the baseline scope, contract, cost model, schedule, risks, assumptions, obligations, acceptance criteria and change-control process.
* Align commercial milestones: Structure contractual deliverables and customer acceptance evidence to enable accurate invoicing and revenue recognition in coordination with Finance.
* Track financial realization: Maintain visibility of purchase orders, supplier commitments, delivery and acceptance status, billing milestones, invoices, receivables and collection risks from award to closure.
* Resolve blockers: Coordinate with the customer and internal teams to close documentation, acceptance, dispute and dependency issues that delay billing, revenue recognition or collection.
* Manage bid security requirements: Identify bid bond, performance bond and advance payment guarantee requirements in each tender; confirm amounts, validity periods, issuing-bank conditions and required wording.
* Coordinate issuance: Work with Finance, Treasury, Legal and banks to request, issue, amend, extend and submit bonds and guarantees ahead of bid deadlines, within approved limits and delegated authority.
* Track and release: Maintain a bond register covering value, issuing bank, expiry, renewal and release status; follow up on return or release after award or non-award, and coordinate conversion to performance securities on award.
* Manage bid and delivery risk: Identify commercial, technical, contractual, regulatory, financial, schedule, dependency and supplier risks; define owners, mitigations, contingencies and escalation points.
* Maintain compliance: Coordinate required legal, regulatory, information-security, data, insurance, bonding and customer-specific compliance, with all commitments made within delegated authority.
* Improve performance: Maintain reusable content, solution and pricing references, vendor intelligence, lessons learned and bid metrics; conduct win/loss and post-bid reviews.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor degree in engineering, telecommunications, information technology, computer science, business, finance or a related discipline.
* Minimum Experience: 8 years or more in bid management, solutioning, presales, commercial management, project delivery or business development within telecommunications, ICT, IoT, managed services or infrastructure; experience leading complex multi-vendor bids is strongly preferred.
* Language Fluency: Fluent English. Arabic is preferred.
* Professional Certifications: APMP, PMP/PRINCE2, finance/business-case, contract management or relevant technical/vendor certifications are advantageous.

**Required Skills**

* Bid governance; technical and commercial writing; requirements analysis; multi-vendor solution integration; pricing and financial modelling; business cases; contract and risk review; project planning; executive presentations; negotiation; stakeholder management; revenue, billing and collection-cycle awareness.
* Customer focus, ownership, commercial judgment, structured problem solving, attention to detail, strategic thinking,

Title: VP, Global Customer Support
Industry: Software Development and IT Services and IT Consulting
Description:
Clio is the global leader in legal AI technology, empowering legal professionals and law firms of every size to work smarter, faster, and more securely.
  
  
We are transforming the legal experience for all by bettering the lives of legal professionals while increasing access to justice.
  
  
**Summary:**
Clio is the global leader in legal AI, trusted by hundreds of thousands of legal professionals across 130+ countries and having surpassed $500M ARR in 2026. As legal work is rebuilt around AI, the expectations customers hold for service are being rebuilt with it — and this role sits at the center of that shift.
  
  
We are seeking a
**Vice President of Global Customer Support**
to define and lead the multi-year strategy for how Clio serves its customers worldwide. You will own the end-to-end support experience across Clio's core practice management platform and Clio Work, our intelligent Legal AI assistant, leading a 150+ person global organization across five locations and a portfolio of AI agents operating alongside them.
  
  
This is an executive mandate to reimagine support, not optimize it. You will build a model where every Clion is focused on the complex, high-value interactions that require real expertise, judgment, and relationship depth — while AI agents handle the rest at scale. You'll own the P&L for global support, set the operating standard for service quality across the company, and establish support as a durable growth engine and competitive differentiator rather than a cost center.
  
  
You will report to the SVP, Customer Success, sit on the CX leadership team, and partner directly with Product, R&D, Revenue, and the executive team on the decisions that shape the customer experience. You'll present results and strategy to the C-suite and the board.
  
  
Who you are:
  
  
You are a seasoned support or CX executive who has built and scaled global service organizations in high-growth B2B SaaS — and who has genuinely operationalized AI, not just piloted it. You've led leaders across multiple geographies, owned a substantial budget with real ROI accountability, and navigated the tension between service quality, cost to serve, and growth without treating any of the three as negotiable.
  
  
You think in systems and see the whole board, not just the next move. You are energized by ambiguity and by building things that don't yet exist. You have informed opinions about where AI support technology is heading and you follow the space closely. You can translate complex AI and operational concepts credibly for a board audience and for a frontline agent in the same day, and you create environments where high performers thrive and everyone has a clear path to growth.
  
  
What you'll work on:
  
  
*Set Vision & Multi-Year Strategy*

* Define and execute the multi-year global support strategy, including the operating model, service architecture, geographic footprint, and AI roadmap.
* Own the P&L for global support, making deliberate trade-offs between cost to serve, service quality, and growth contribution — and defending them at the executive and board level.
* Align with the C-suite on company-wide priorities, representing the voice of the customer at the highest level of the organization.
* Set the standard for what world-class service means at Clio and hold the broader company accountable to it.

*Build & Scale the Global Support Organization*

* Lead, develop, and inspire a 150+ person global organization across five locations, building a bench of support leaders capable of scaling well beyond current size.
* Recruit and develop top-tier leadership talent with a specific lens on AI-native and AI-fluent professionals who are excited about redefining their roles alongside technology.
* Build a culture of continuous improvement, psychological safety, and AI curiosity — and lead the organization through significant role and workflow change with credibility and care.
* Design the career architecture, competency frameworks, and enablement systems required for a support organization whose work is fundamentally changing.

*Own the AI-First Support Architecture*

* Own the strategy and execution to evolve support into an AI-first model — elevating Clions to the complex, high-judgment work while AI agents handle routine inquiries at scale.
* Evaluate, select, and drive enterprise adoption of AI support platforms (e.g., Maven AI, Decagon, Sierra, Intercom Fin, or equivalent), owning the build-versus-buy decisions and vendor relationships.
* Deploy intelligent AI voice and chat agents capable of handling complex, multi-product workflows for legal professionals, and set the governance for escalation logic, confidence thresholds, knowledge curation, and human-in-the-loop design.
* Build AI-assisted agent tooling — agent assist, real-time suggestions, auto-summaries — that measurably improves time to resolution and first-contact resolution.
* Establish the accuracy, compliance, and quality standards that AI-delivered support must meet in a high-trust, regulated vertical, and own accountability for them.

*Drive Growth, Retention & Commercial Contribution*

* Own support's contribution to retention and expansion, including the identification and conversion of Customer Success Qualified Leads (CSQLs) at every touchpoint.
* Build PLG-integrated support motions — in-product nudges, proactive outreach triggers, self-service optimization — that reduce friction at critical conversion and adoption moments.
* Partner with Revenue, Marketing, and Post Sales to make support a measurable input to net revenue retention, not an adjacent function.

*Lead Multi-Product Support Excellence*

* Own the end-to-end support lifecycle for Clio's core practice management platform and for Clio Work (Legal AI drafting, research, and intelligence).
* Build differentiated support models tuned to each product's complexity, customer segment, and AI-sensitivity — recognizing that Clio Work customers have fundamentally different needs than core platform users.
* Design specialized routing and escalation frameworks for complex customer questions, and manage multi-channel environments (voice, live chat, email, AI chat, async messaging) with consistent service levels across all.

*Drive Cross-Functional & Product Alignment*

* Partner with Product, Engineering, and R&D to build a rigorous product feedback loop powered by support signal — influencing roadmap priorities, not just filing bugs.
* Build proactive partnerships across Post Sales (Onboarding, Professional Services, CSM) to deliver a seamless customer experience across the lifecycle.
* Serve as the escalation executive for critical customer and product incidents, owning resolution and the durability of the customer relationship afterward.

*Build Scalable Systems & Operational Rigor*

* Set and own the support KPI framework, including the AI-era metrics that don't yet have industry standards — deflection quality, containment, AI resolution accuracy, cost per resolution, and outcome-based CSAT.
* Own the Support Systems architecture across Salesforce Service Cloud, CCaaS platforms (e.g., Talkdesk), knowledge management, and AI support tooling.
* Lead Workforce Management to forecast demand across traditional and AI channels, enabling intelligent staffing decisions and intraday optimization in a rapidly shifting volume mix.
* Establish the operating cadence, data infrastructure, and reporting that allow support performance to be understood and trusted company-wide.

*Market Leadership*

* Serve as the executive face of Clio's support organization externally, representing Clio at industry events and thought leadership forums.
* Build Clio's reputation as the reference case for what AI-first support looks like in a high-trust vertical.

What you bring:
  
  

* 12+ years in customer support, service, or CX leadership, including 5+ years managing managers in high-growth B2B SaaS environments.
* Proven experience leading global support or CX organizations of 150+ people across multiple geographies, with full budget or P&L ownership.
* A demonstrated track record deploying AI support technologies at scale — you have actually done this and lived with the results, not advised on it.
* Direct, hands-on experience with modern AI support platforms such as Maven AI, Decagon, Sierra, Intercom Fin, or equivalent, including vendor selection and enterprise rollout.
* Deep understanding of AI agent architecture: escalation logic, confidence thresholds, knowledge base curation, and human-in-the-loop workflow design.

* Experience supporting complex, multi-product SaaS environments with distinct customer personas and varying technical depth requirements.
* Experience in hypergrowth environments where the business doubles while headcount grows far more slowly.

* A track record of building feedback loops between support signal and product roadmap — influencing priorities, not just reporting issues.
* Exceptional executive presence and communication, with the ability to influence at every level and present to the C-suite and board.
* A "Draw the Owl" mindset — comfort with ambiguity, a bias toward action, and the drive to build the structures, processes, and playbooks where the path isn't yet defined.

* Align staffing, supplies and service delivery with approved occupancy and business forecasts, working with Finance and relevant departments to protect profitability and maintain service standards.

Title: Head of AI & Agents
Description:
The Head of AI & Agents is responsible for leading the commercial growth and market development of Arabic AI and its agent-based solutions. Reporting to the COO, the role develops and executes the AI & Agents commercial strategy, including defining target markets, customer segments, value propositions, market positioning, and scalable routes to market, with accountability for revenue growth, new-customer acquisition, strategic market expansion, and the development and execution of effective go-to-market strategies across enterprise and government customers.

The role leads three complementary functions: Business Development, Partnerships, and Presales. It ensures that direct sales and partner-led opportunities are converted into qualified pipeline and revenue, while the Presales function translates customer needs into technically sound, secure, scalable, and commercially viable AI solutions. The Head establishes clear priorities, performance measures, and collaboration across these functions to strengthen the full commercial lifecycle from market identification and opportunity creation through solution design and deal closure.

Working closely with the COO, the Director of Commercial Shared Services, Product, Engineering, Delivery, and other stakeholders, the Head of AI & Agents ensures the AI commercial strategy is aligned with product capabilities, market demand, and delivery readiness, and that the business builds a repeatable, measurable, and sustainable AI revenue engine. The role drives the continuous optimization of go-to-market strategies to maximize market penetration and commercial growth.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

**AI & Agents Commercial Strategy and Growth**

* Develop and execute the commercial strategy and operating plan for AI & Agents in alignment with the company’s overall strategy and the commercial priorities.

* Translate business objectives into revenue plans, target markets, priority industries, customer segments, go-to-market motions, and measurable performance targets.

* Define and oversee the go-to-market (GTM) strategy for AI & Agents, including market positioning, customer segmentation, value propositions, solution positioning, and the selection of appropriate market-entry and growth strategies.

* Identify and prioritize go-to-market opportunities across enterprise and government markets, determining the most effective approaches to market penetration, customer acquisition, and revenue expansion.

* Own the AI & Agents vertical’s agreed commercial outcomes, including new-business revenue, qualified pipeline, conversion, forecast accuracy, and partner contribution.

* Assess market trends, customer needs, competitor offerings, and emerging AI use cases to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.

* Provide the management with regular reporting on commercial performance, pipeline health, forecast, key opportunities, risks, and resource requirements.

**Business Development and Market Expansion**

* Lead the Business Development function in identifying, qualifying, developing, negotiating, and closing new enterprise and government opportunities for AI & Agents.

* Ensure target-account plans, prospecting priorities, sales strategies, and opportunity qualification are aligned with the AI & Agents go-to-market strategy.

* Ensure the effective execution of GTM strategies through coordinated market development, customer acquisition initiatives, and targeted commercial activities across priority segments and industries.

* Guide the Business Development Manager on strategic opportunities, complex sales cycles, executive engagement, and deal strategy.

* Promote value-based and consultative selling by connecting customer business challenges to relevant AI solutions, measurable outcomes, and a clear value proposition.

* Build relationships with senior customer stakeholders and support critical negotiations and high-value opportunities as required.

* Coordinate with the Director of Commercial Shared Services to ensure effective SDR support, bidding resources, and Sales Operations support for AI opportunities.

**Partnerships and Ecosystem-Led Revenue**

* Lead the development of a partner-led growth strategy that turns strategic relationships into qualified pipeline, co-selling activity, and closed revenue.

* Oversee the Partnership Lead’s engagement with hyperscalers, technology partners, systems integrators, consultancies, and other relevant ecosystem partners.

* Ensure partnership plans include clear commercial objectives, target accounts, joint go-to-market activities, opportunity ownership, and measurable outcomes.

* Review partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, revenue contribution, conversion, and forecast accuracy, and take action to improve performance.

* Support strategic partner negotiations, joint account planning, co-selling initiatives, partner programs, and marketplace opportunities where they strengthen market access or accelerate growth.

* Ensure partner engagement complements direct business development and that opportunities are tracked consistently in the CRM with clear attribution.

**Presales, Solution Strategy and Commercial Readiness**

* Lead the Presales function to ensure customer requirements are translated into technically sound, secure, scalable, and commercially viable AI solutions.

* Work with the Presales Consulting Manager to align solution discovery, architecture, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, technical proposals, and solution validation with commercial priorities.

* Ensure proposed solutions address customer business needs and are aligned with product capabilities, technical standards, implementation feasibility, delivery capacity, and commercial objectives.

* Provide oversight of solution risks, assumptions, scope, effort estimates, dependencies, and customer success criteria before major proposals or commitments are submitted.

* Support executive-level customer discussions and strategic opportunities where senior commercial or technical alignment is required.

* Ensure a clear handover from Presales to Product, Engineering, and Delivery teams, including solution documentation, scope, assumptions, risks, and agreed success measures.

* Use customer and market feedback from presales engagements to inform product priorities, solution packaging, reusable assets, and future go-to-market opportunities.

**Pipeline, Forecasting and Commercial Governance**

* Establish a disciplined operating cadence for pipeline reviews, opportunity progression, revenue forecasting, partner performance reviews, and major-deal governance.

* Ensure accurate and timely recording of opportunities, activities, partner attribution, deal stages, forecasts, and commercial outcomes in Salesforce or other designated systems.

* Monitor pipeline coverage, win rates, deal cycle, conversion, average contract value, revenue contribution, and other relevant commercial KPIs.

* Review pricing, deal economics, commercial terms, and non-standard commitments within delegated authority, escalating material exceptions through the appropriate approval process.

* Work with the Director of Commercial Shared Services to maintain consistent reporting definitions, bid support, lead handovers, and sales-process discipline without duplicating ownership of shared functions.

* Use performance data and win/loss insights to refine go-to-market plans, improve forecast reliability, and strengthen commercial execution.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration and Customer Value**

* Work closely with Product, Engineering, Delivery, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and other relevant functions to align commercial plans with solution capabilities and business priorities.

* Ensure customer commitments, proposed timelines, technical scope, service levels, and implementation assumptions are validated with the relevant internal teams before being finalized.

* Build effective collaboration between Business Development, Partnerships, and Presales to ensure clear ownership and smooth progression of opportunities throughout the sales cycle.

* Collaborate with the Head of Services when customer opportunities span AI & Agents and Services, agreeing a coordinated client approach and clear commercial ownership.

* Represent the AI & Agents vertical in internal leadership forums and in strategic customer or partner engagements, as required.

**Leadership, Team Development and Continuous Improvement**

* Lead, coach, and develop the Partnership Lead, Business Development Manager – AI, and Presales Consulting Manager, setting clear objectives, accountability, and performance expectations.

* Ensure each function has clear responsibilities, decision rights, performance measures, and effective ways of working, while maintaining shared accountability for overall commercial outcomes.

* Assess team capability, capacity, and development needs; support succession planning and build a high-performing, collaborative, customer-focused team.

* Promote knowledge sharing across commercial, partner, and technical teams, and encourage the development of repeatable sales motions, solution assets, and best practices.

* Identify opportunities to improve sales effectiveness, partner contribution, presales quality, customer experience, and the efficiency of the commercial lifecycle.

* Carry out other duties necessary for the effective operation of the department.

  
  
**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field; a relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

* At least 15 years of relevant experience across enterprise technology sales, AI business development, strategic partnerships, presales, solution consulting, or commercial leadership, including substantial leadership experience.

* Demonstrated success in achieving enterprise B2B revenue targets, developing qualified pipeline, managing complex sales cycles, and converting strategic opportunities into closed business.

* Strong understanding of AI solutions, Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), agent-based solutions, cloud platforms, APIs, enterprise integrations, and technology-enabled business use cases.

* Experience developing strategic partnerships and partner-led sales motions, including co-selling and joint go-to-market activities with technology partners, hyperscalers, systems integrators, or consultancies.

* Experience overseeing presales and solution consulting activities, including technical discovery, solution design, demonstrations, proof-of-concepts, proposal development, and technical risk assessment.

* Strong commercial acumen, including pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, negotiation, deal economics, and revenue performance analysis.

* Experience engaging senior enterprise and government stakeholders and navigating complex procurement processes, RFPs, and multi-stakeholder decision-making.

* Demonstrated ability to lead multidisciplinary teams, set priorities, develop talent, and drive accountability across commercial and technical functions.

* Strong strategic thinking, analytical, decision-making, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

* Proficiency in CRM platforms such as Salesforce and Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

* Professional fluency in written and spoken English and Arabic.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Team Building & Management
* Conflict Management
* Time Management
* Results Orientation
* Influencing Others

**Technical Competencies**

* AI & Technology Commercial Strategy
* Enterprise Business Development
* Strategic Partnerships & Co-Selling
* AI Presales & Solution Governance
* Pipeline, Forecasting & Revenue Management
* Commercial Negotiation & Deal Management
* AI Solution Risk and Delivery Alignment

At Deloitte, our Purpose is to make an impact that matters. We exist to inspire and help our people, organizations, communities, and countries to thrive by building a better future. Our work underpins a prosperous society where people can find meaning and opportunity. It builds consumer and business confidence, empowers organizations to find imaginative ways of deploying capital, enables fair, trusted, and functioning social and economic institutions, and allows our friends, families, and communities to enjoy the quality of life that comes with a sustainable future. And as the largest 100% Canadian-owned and operated professional services firm in our country, we are proud to work alongside our clients to make a positive impact for all Canadians.

* Have many careers in one Firm.
* Enjoy flexible, proactive, and practical benefits that foster a culture of well-being and connectedness.
* Learn from deep subject matter experts through mentoring and on the job coaching

**What will your typical day look like?**
As a Senior Manager in our ServiceNow managed services business, you will lead the delivery of ongoing application management services for one or more of our clients. You will be accountable for building trusted client relationships, providing leadership to our delivery teams, and making sure we consistently deliver on our commitments.
  
  
You will work closely with client executives and operational leaders to understand their priorities, assess how their ServiceNow environment is performing, and identify opportunities to improve service quality, platform adoption and business outcomes. You will lead regular service reviews, communicate progress, manage issues and risks, and provide practical recommendations that help clients get more value from their investment in ServiceNow. Finding ways to innovate and bring additional value to your clients will be a key factor to your success.
  
  
You will manage Deloitte’s people, processes, and commercial performance of your engagements. This includes building effective teams, developing and coaching our personnel, ensuring high quality delivery practices, managing financial performance, and ensuring that contractual commitments are understood and met. When challenges arise, you will bring the right people together, help the team work through the problem and maintain clear, open communication with the client.
  
  
You will also play a meaningful role in growing our ServiceNow business. You will identify opportunities with existing and prospective clients, shape managed services solutions, lead proposals and presentations, and work with your colleagues to bring the best of Deloitte to the market.
  
  
Beyond individual client engagements, you will contribute to the development of our practice. This may include evolving our delivery methods and service offerings, developing reusable assets, supporting recruitment, building alliances and internal relationships, contributing to market perspectives, and strengthening our ServiceNow community across Canada and globally.
  
  
No two days will be exactly the same. You can expect a role that is highly collaborative, client-facing and commercially focused, with the opportunity to lead important services, develop talented teams and help shape a growing part of our business. Your role will include both managing service delivery, and pursuing sales opportunities.
  
  
**About The Team**
This is an opportunity to join Deloitte’s ServiceNow managed services practice. We help clients run, maintain and continually improve their ServiceNow platforms after implementation, combining deep platform knowledge with strong service management, industry and business experience.
  
  
Our work goes beyond keeping the platform operational. We work alongside our clients to improve how services are delivered, respond to changing business needs, introduce new capabilities and create sustained value from ServiceNow. Our teams bring together functional, technical, industry and service delivery skills to support complex organizations and their users.
  
  
You will be part of a collaborative Canadian practice connected to Deloitte’s broader national and global capabilities. You will work with leaders and specialists across service lines, industries and geographies to develop solutions that are practical, scalable and tailored to each client.

* Minimum 8 years of relevant work experience, managing, selling, architecting and delivering ServiceNow services.
* Experience leading ServiceNow managed services, application support. Experience across both ServiceNow implementation and ongoing support environments is a plus.
* Proven ability to lead teams, including resources working across multiple locations and delivery centers, with an ability to grow a high-performance team through coaching and development.
* Strong client relationship skills and experience working directly with senior business and technology clients. Ability to develop long-term trusted advisor relationships.
* Demonstrated success in business development and sales, including identifying opportunities, shaping solutions, developing proposals and statements of work, participating in RFP responses, and presenting managed services offerings to clients.

* Experience with artificial intelligence, particularly in ServiceNow, is a strong asset but is not required for this position.
* Bilingualism in English and French is considered a strong asset but is not required for this position.

Along with a competitive base salary and variable pay opportunities, we offer a wide array of initiatives that differentiate us as a people-first organization. On top of our regular paid vacation days, some examples include: $4,000 per year for mental health support benefits, a $1,300 flexible benefit spending account, firm-wide closures known as "Deloitte Days", dedicated days of for learning (known as Development and Innovation Days), flexible work arrangements and a hybrid work structure.

Senior Manager, PMO

Are you a hands-on delivery leader passionate about project management?

**Project Delivery and Quality Assurance**

  

* Ensure disciplined and effective project delivery by following the established PMO methodology and Project Management best practices.

**People Management**

* Manage all Project Managers and Project Coordinators within the IT Division (FTEs and contractors).
* Partner with Project Managers and PCs to develop annual goals and ensure team members are progressing as planned.
* Encourage a spirit of collaboration, commitment, and trust.
* Contribute to workforce capability planning and skills development within PMO. Support our Talent Acquisition team with PMO related recruiting efforts.

**Accountability and Commitments**

* Guide team members to ensure alignment on commitments made as part of project execution.
* Review and contribute to Procurement documents (RFx), Service Agreements, Statements of Work to establish project expectations and delivery baselines for system integrators and third-party vendors as applicable.
* Where required, hold project stakeholders – both internal and external to the organization – to their commitments.
* Work with team to make sure status reports are accurate, timely and suitable for presentation at the executive level.

* Minimum of 5 years of coaching/leadership experience
* Minimum of 7 years of project management experience
* Change Management experience
* Experience with PMI Project Management methodology and Agile delivery. Experience working in a hybrid and/or Product-centric environment.
* Program management skills and experience, and significant knowledge of project planning tools with evidence of practical application.
* Exceptional leadership and team building skills with the ability to inspire and motivate PM staff.
* Excellent analytical, strategic conceptual planning and execution skills.
* Effective influencing and negotiation skills, strong ability to gain cooperation, trust and support at the executive level (e.g., Project Steering Committees).

**Preferred Skills**

* MS Project and MS Project Server Experience
* Professional designation (CSM, PMP, SAFe Agilist or SAFe Lean Portfolio Manager) is preferred.
* Deep understanding of current and emerging technologies and how they may be applied to the enterprise to drive digital business.

Title: Director, Risk and Performance Technology
Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.
  
  
Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. Located in downtown Toronto, our vision is to be the partner of choice for Ontario’s public sector funds and to build a high-performing, value-driven asset management firm.
  
  
This job posting is for an existing vacancy. If you are ready to deliver best-in-class service and join a collaborative, motivated and fun team of professionals, IMCO offers the opportunity to do impactful work and broaden your expertise.
  
  
If you’re looking to use your expertise to drive strategic outcomes, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
‎
  
  
As IMCO continues to evolve its Target Operating Model, the importance of timely, trusted, and actionable risk and performance insights continues to grow. Technology plays a critical role in enabling investment decision-making, performance measurement, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, and enterprise risk oversight.
  
  
If you are looking to lead a strategic technology portfolio and help shape the future of Risk and Performance capabilities at IMCO, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**We are looking for a highly motivated Director, Risk & Performance Technology.**
Reporting to the Vice President, Investment Technology, the Director, Risk & Performance Technology is accountable for the strategy, delivery, operation, and evolution of IMCO's Risk and Performance technology capabilities.
  
  
This role provides technology leadership for the applications, analytical platforms, reporting capabilities, and integrations that support Risk and Performance. The Director will establish the roadmap for the Risk and Performance technology portfolio, lead key technology initiatives, and ensure technology capabilities remain scalable, reliable, and aligned with IMCO's future operating model.
  
  
The role partners closely with Risk, Performance, Investment Operations, Data & AI Enablement, Enterprise Technology, and Front Office stakeholders to improve analytical capabilities, enhance reporting and measurement processes, and deliver trusted insights across the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
Technology Strategy & Business Partnership
  
  

* Define and execute the multi-year technology roadmap for Risk and Performance capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IMCO's Target Operating Model.
* Serve as a trusted technology advisor to leaders across Risk and Performance.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify future capability needs, technology opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to Investment Technology planning activities and support the development of long-term technology strategies across the investment ecosystem.
* Support business case development, vendor evaluations, and technology investment decisions related to Risk and Performance platforms.

Risk & Performance Solution Delivery
  
  

* Lead the delivery and enhancement of technology solutions supporting portfolio risk measurement, factor analytics, exposure analysis, performance measurement, attribution, benchmark management, and investment reporting.
* Oversee the design, implementation, integration, and support of business-critical applications and analytical platforms.
* Ensure solutions are designed to support scalability, automation, operational efficiency, and future business growth.
* Partner with Architecture, Data Platform & AI Engineering, Enterprise Technology, and Cyber Security teams to ensure alignment with enterprise standards and target architectures.
* Promote effective delivery practices and ensure technology solutions are implemented in a disciplined and sustainable manner.

**Application Portfolio Ownership**

* Provide overall ownership and oversight of Risk and Performance technology platforms and application portfolios.
* Establish application roadmaps, lifecycle management plans, and support strategies that align with business objectives.
* Lead application upgrades, enhancements, integrations, modernization initiatives, and platform rationalization activities.
* Evaluate emerging vendor solutions and analytical capabilities to support evolving business requirements.
* Manage strategic relationships with software vendors, implementation partners, and service providers.

Data, Analytics & Reporting Enablement
  
  

* Partner with the Data Platform & AI Engineering team and business stakeholders to ensure Risk and Performance solutions leverage trusted, governed, and reconciled investment data.
* Support the development and consumption of analytical data products, calculation engines, and reporting-ready datasets.
* Drive improvements in measurement processes, reporting workflows, calculation transparency, and analytical consistency.
* Promote the adoption of common data standards and integrated analytical capabilities across investment teams.
* Enable modern analytics, reporting, and decision-support capabilities that improve investment insight and business outcomes.

Governance & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Ensure Risk and Performance technology solutions operate in accordance with IMCO policies, architecture standards, security requirements, and governance frameworks.
* Establish operational processes that support stable, secure, and sustainable application services.
* Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and service management activities across the portfolio.
* Support audits, risk assessments, compliance reviews, and control testing activities.
* Ensure appropriate documentation, training materials, support procedures, and operational controls are maintained.

People Leadership
  
  

* Build and lead a high-performing team of business analysts, application specialists, technical leads, and technology professionals.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support career growth and organizational capability development.
* Establish clear objectives, performance expectations, and development plans aligned with business and technology goals.

**What you need to succeed:**

* 12+ years of progressive experience delivering and supporting investment technology solutions within asset management, investment management, or financial services environments.
* Demonstrated success leading technology teams supporting Risk, Performance, Analytics, or related investment functions.
* Strong understanding of portfolio risk management, performance measurement and attribution, benchmark management, investment reporting, and portfolio analytics.
* Experience developing technology roadmaps and delivering complex application and platform initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of investment data, analytical platforms, reporting solutions, and application integration patterns.
* Experience managing software vendors, implementation partners, and managed service providers.
* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.
* Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, service management, governance, and operational support practices.
* Excellent communication, relationship management, and stakeholder engagement skills.
* Experience with industry-leading Risk and Performance platforms such as MSCI RiskManager, BarraOne, Axioma, FactSet, Bloomberg PORT, Eagle Performance, or similar solutions is highly desirable.
* Undergraduate degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Finance, Mathematics, or a related field. Advanced education and professional certifications are considered an asset.

Title: Director, IT Business Unit
Industry: IT Services and IT Consulting and Engineering Services
Description:
**Director, IT Business Unit – Toronto**

**The mandate**

As Director of the IT Business Unit in Toronto, you will have end-to-end responsibility for building and scaling ALTEN Canada’s IT services business in Ontario.

This is a hands-on leadership role combining
**business strategy, client development, P&L ownership, consultant management and delivery development**
. You will define the market approach, grow strategic accounts, build new client relationships and help expand ALTEN Canada’s IT delivery capabilities in Toronto.

The role is designed for a commercially driven leader who can think strategically, build from the ground up and personally drive execution.

**What you will lead**

* Define and execute the
  **Ontario IT services strategy**
  and 2027–2030 commercial roadmap.
* Build and own the business plan for the Toronto IT Business Unit, including market priorities, growth targets, revenue, gross margin and profitability.
* Identify priority industries, strategic accounts, technology disciplines and service offerings with the strongest potential for growth.
* Develop a balanced services portfolio spanning
  **staff augmentation, project-based and turnkey solutions, and local, onshore and offshore delivery models**
  .
* Grow existing Canadian and global accounts through structured account planning, cross-selling and senior stakeholder engagement.
* Generate new business through targeted market development, executive-level prospecting, consultative selling, proposal leadership and contract negotiation.
* Own the full
  **P&L and commercial performance**
  of the portfolio, including revenue, gross margin, pricing, forecasting and budget discipline.
* Oversee consultants assigned to client engagements, maintaining strong performance, engagement, retention and client satisfaction.
* Partner closely with recruitment, technical, delivery, HR and finance teams to align client demand, talent capacity, pricing and delivery feasibility.
* Lead the expansion of ALTEN Canada’s IT delivery capabilities from Montreal into Toronto, identifying opportunities to move from individual consulting mandates toward higher-value project and solution-based engagements.
* Establish and monitor clear KPIs across pipeline, sales conversion, account growth, consultant utilization, delivery performance and profitability.
* Over time,
  **build, structure and lead the Toronto IT business team**
  in line with the growth of the portfolio.

**What you bring**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in
  **IT consulting, technology services or professional services**
  , with significant responsibility for business development and account growth.
* Proven experience building or scaling a
  **business unit, market, practice or strategic portfolio**
  , with measurable commercial results.
* Strong knowledge of the Ontario IT services market, enterprise buying processes and competitive landscape.
* A demonstrated ability to develop senior client relationships and open new enterprise accounts.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including
  **pricing, forecasting, gross-margin management, budgeting and P&L accountability**
  .
* Experience leading complex sales cycles involving technical/delivery teams, recruitment, procurement, legal and senior client stakeholders.
* The ability to translate business challenges into relevant IT services, delivery models and commercial solutions.
* Experience managing consultants and/or commercial teams in a professional-services environment.
* Executive-level communication, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* A structured but entrepreneurial leadership style:
  **you can define the strategy, build internal alignment and personally drive execution.**

**Assets / Nice to have**

* Technical education or previous hands-on exposure to software development, cloud, infrastructure, data, cybersecurity, ERP, automation or related disciplines.
* Experience building or managing a
  **delivery centre, managed-services practice or project-based delivery capability**
  .
* Experience working with global, nearshore and offshore delivery models.
* An established network within the
  **Greater Toronto Area and Ontario enterprise IT market**
  .
* Experience building and developing business managers, account executives or sales teams.

Title: Regional Director
Description:
****ABOUT US****
**JOB DESCRIPTION**
BGIS is a leading provider of customized facility management and real estate services. With a combined team of over 10,000 professionals worldwide, we relentlessly focus on enabling innovation through the services we deliver. We actively seek new opportunities that drive innovation for our clients’ businesses. Globally, we manager over 320 million square feet of client portfolios across 30,000+ locations in North America, Europe, Middle East, Australia, and Asia. For further information, visit www.bgis.com .
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
At BGIS, our culture is built on three foundational pillars:
  
  

* Culture of Care: We deeply care for each other, our clients, partners, and the communities we serve.
* High Performing Teams: We go Above and Beyond to deliver exceptional services. INTEGRITY, OWNERSHIP, RESPONSIVENESS, INITIATION, VISIBILITY, DRIVE, and INTEGRATION are core to high performance.
* Unwavering Commitment to Sustainability: We conduct every action with a focus on preserving our earth.

****SUMMARY****
For the assigned region(s), the
**Regional Director**
is accountable for operations, financial management and meeting service delivery obligations in a specified Geographical region that includes several facilities, employees and clients.  This role is expected to understand, coach and train the team in all regulatory and client requirements.  In addition, this role is also responsible for contributing to strategic and account management plans and objectives and people leadership.
  
  
This role will work in collaboration with all key BGIS departments to ensure full support of all activities and play a key role in our INTEGRATED approach to operating buildings.
  
  
**Opportunities for Development:**
  
  
At BGIS we are committed to the development of our people – offering them opportunities to learn and grow into various roles.  Success in the role offers Team Members the opportunity to explore various roles – some include:
  
  

* On Account and expanded Operational Leadership
* Facility Management Office roles to support accounts,
* Project Management leadership roles to lead and execute projects

****KEY DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES****
**Health, Safety, Environment & Security**
  
  

* Follow and apply all Health and Safety and Emergency Response, aligned with both BGIS and Client expectations.to ensure safety of all employees and building occupants.
* Work in collaboration with BGIS Health Safety and Environment Teams for support and direction on key programs to emphasize Safety Culture
* Accountable for meeting all internal and external health, safety, environment and security-related requirements
* Accountable for the safe delivery of all work performed

**Account Management**
  
  

* Continuously engages clients in discussions to understand and anticipate needs, identify and recommend additional services
* Provides input and contributes to the development and execution of strategic account expansion plans
* Recommends additional pull-through services
* Participates in and contributes to quarterly business reviews
* Contributes to contract renewal and business development activities
* Contributes to account governance
* Adherence to Contract Specific MSA (Master Service Agreement)
* Manages the BGIS ECE Program for the specific client group
* Responsible for results and action plans related to the Likely to Recommend Survey.

**Client Relationship Management**
  
  

* Accountable for achieving client satisfaction objectives for the assigned region(s)
* Accountable for developing and maintaining effective relationships with clients, managing client expectations
* Position level of client representatives with whom this position typically interacts with include those at the senior management level
* Acts as the focal point of escalation for issues pertaining to facilities within assigned region(s)

**Region/Portfolio Budget Development & Management**
  
  

* Assume financial responsibility for facility operations, including budget management.
* In partnership with finance, responsible for the development of budgets (O&M, Transaction, capital projects and rent), and be able to support and explain approach to the client and the account team.
* Using financial reports, perform monthly budget, analyze and re-forecast allocations as necessary.
* Meet annual targets as per contractual performance and client financial targets / indicators.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and develop strategies to maximize financial resources.
* Track and report on budget positive or negative trends performance regularly
* Participates in, provides recommendations, and contributes to continuous improvement projects to achieve efficiency gains and cost savings

**Portfolio Management**
  
  

* Accountable for operations management for the portfolio of facilities within the assigned region(s)
* Leads the operations and maintenance activities of a portfolio of facilities along with the execution of the portfolio’s programs
* Oversees the completion and submission of capital plans
* Creates and implements short to mid-term plans for the assigned region(s)
* Provides input into strategic plans
* Collaborates with relevant stakeholders to optimize facilities within assigned region(s) and continuously create value for the client.

**Service Delivery Management**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with Central Work Order Management Team to ensure all work is being completed as outlined in the MSA
* Monitor work order progress and ensure tasks are completed within established timelines.
* Work with Account Governance Teams to maintain accurate records of work orders and associated costs.
* Streamline and manage work order processes to optimize efficiency.
* Prioritize and assign work orders based on urgency and impact on facility operations.
* Accountable for meeting all service obligations for the assigned region(s)
* Oversees the delivery of all service obligations
* Accountable for meeting established metrics/key performance indicators.  Leads the operations team in the development and implementation of action plans to remediate gaps, where applicable, to ensure objectives are met.
* Accountable for ensuring compliance to all legislated, corporate and industry-related requirements and guidelines including but not limited to environmental, health and safety, and building standard requirements

**Risk Management, Emergency Preparedness and Business Continuity Planning and Execution**
  
  

* Accountable for safeguarding the client against emergencies and risks by ensuring emergency preparedness, risk management, disaster recovery and business continuity plans are developed and that relevant stakeholders are trained to ensure proper execution
* Oversight and engagement in Emergency Management

**Regulatory Compliance**
  
  

* Accountable for ensuring all regulatory compliance requirements have been met and all related documentation are created and maintained
* Ensure compliance with corporate and legislated policies, procedures, practices and guidelines related to environmental, building code and issues by applying cursory knowledge of legislation related to these areas

**Project Management**
  
  

* Accountable for on-time, on-budget and quality delivery of facility management projects for the assigned region(s)
* Collaborates with clients and internal stakeholders to identify project opportunities and priorities, develop and implement projects
* Oversees the development and execution of project plans for portfolios within assigned region(s)

**Procurement**
  
  

* With Support from BGIS Strategic Sourcing and Vendor Management Leadership – follow BGIS Vendor Performance and Relationship Management Program protocols
* Collaborates with Procurement and Supply Chain Administration teams to source and qualify vendors, source and procure goods and services.

**Continuous Improvement**
  
  

* Collaborates with stakeholders and contributes to efficiency gains   through activities including but not limited to identifying and implementing best practices; reviewing, refining and/or developing, implementing processes, technologies and sustainable practices, and leveraging self-perform wherever possible.  Implements related enhancements for the assigned region(s)

**Leadership and Recognition**
  
  

* Accountable for employee-oriented activities including but not limited to employee engagement, development and performance management, hiring and retention, compensation recommendations
* Employee Satisfaction Scores and employee recognition (development and implementation of action plans to improve ESAT scores)
* Day to day support and team oversight/management

**Collaboration with BGIS Self Perform Teams delivering Best Quality Services to Buildings**
  
  

* Work in collaboration with BGIS teams in Janitorial, Project Management and TechnicalServices or any other areas where work is directly performed by BGIS to maximize efficiency and the best customer service in the buildings / portfolios
* Work together with these teams to ensure work is completed

**Technology to Support your Success.**
  
  

* Leverage technology such as work order system, vendor monitoring tools, BAS and CMMS scheduling tools to deliver effective service to clients.
* Mentor staff in vendor management and the effective use of technology for vendor relationships.
* Provide guidance to team members on the effective use of technology for financial management and career progression.
* Other duties as assigned

****KNOWLEDGE & SKILLS****

* Community college diploma preferably in business administration
* More than 10 years of facility management work experience
* Highly skilled at account management
* Highly skilled at facility operations management
* Highly skilled at client relationship management with demonstrated ability in building and managing relationships with client representatives at the senior management level
* Highly skilled at managing service delivery and meeting service delivery obligations
* Skilled at managing budgets
* Fully developed communication, influence, persuasion and negotiation skills
* High degree of client service orientation and sense of urgency
* Highly skilled at leading and engaging a team of individuals
* Skilled at vendor management
* Highly skilled at emergency management, emergency preparedness and business continuity planning and execution
* Possesses a sustainability mindset and seeks to incorporate sustainable practices within assigned portfolio where possible
* Expert level knowledge of health and safety requirements. Possesses a high degree of safety mindset
* Maintains current knowledge of and highly skilled at implementing facility management services best practices
* Expert level knowledge of current building standards and requirements
* Possesses a continuous improvement and quality mindset along with a desire to continuously seek and incorporate innovative practices and technologies in order to deliver value to the client

**Licenses and/or Professional Accreditation**
One or more of the following would be considered an asset:
  
  

* Certified Facility Manager from International Facility Management Association
* Certified Property Manager from Institute of Real Estate Management
* Facility Management Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute
* Real Property Administrator Designation from Building Owners and Managers Institute

This is a regular, full-time position with a salary range of $110,000 - $138,000 per annum. The starting salary will be based on the successful candidate’s competencies, including but not limited to experience, education and performance related to this role.
