Title: Data Strategy & Data Enabled Solutions - Senior Manager or Associate Director - Toronto
Description:
Location: Toronto

Other locations: Primary Location Only

Salary: Competitive

Date: Nov 9, 2026

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1759846

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

  

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

  

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

  

**The opportunity**

  

EY’s Canada Tax & Law Technology Group (CTTG) is seeking an experienced Associate Director / Senior Manager, Data Strategy & Data-Enabled Solutions to help define and scale our data strategy, capabilities, offerings, and solutions.

  

This is a strategic and hands-on role that will play a pivotal part in shaping how data is leveraged as a strategic asset across Tax & Law. The role will focus on identifying new opportunities, enabling data-driven insights and decision-making, developing new solutions and services, strengthening existing offerings, and enabling smarter and more scalable service delivery.

We are looking for a senior data professional who can move comfortably between strategy and execution. The successful candidate will be expected to help set direction while also working directly with data to explore opportunities, develop analyses, test hypotheses, prototype solutions, and evaluate new approaches and technologies. They will leverage CTTG development and delivery resources to help engineer, productionize, and scale solutions where needed.

  

This job posting relates to an existing vacancy within our organization.

  

**Your key responsibilities**

* Partner with Tax & Law leadership to define and execute a data strategy that advances service delivery, managed services, growth, and new market offerings, including opportunities to connect data and insights across competencies and services.
* Identify, prioritize, and shape data-enabled opportunities, use cases, and solutions aligned with business priorities, client needs, and the long-term technology and platform strategy.
* Lead discovery with business teams to understand business problems, processes, available data, information gaps, and opportunities, and articulate the art of the possible through data.
* Work hands-on with data to explore opportunities, perform analysis, test hypotheses, identify patterns and insights, develop prototypes, and demonstrate potential solutions.
* Experiment with new data sources, data models, analytical approaches, tools, and technologies to quickly assess feasibility, validate ideas, and determine potential business value.
* Design and prototype end-to-end data-enabled solutions, including data extraction, preparation, transformation, integration, modeling, analytics, visualization, and consumption.
* Define data architectures and solution approaches that enable information to be securely, effectively, and consistently used and reused across solutions, services, and teams.
* Apply and leverage technologies such as Microsoft Power BI, Microsoft Dataverse, Azure data services, Alteryx, APIs, ETL/ELT tools, and related data and analytics technologies.
* Work across structured and unstructured data sources and develop approaches for ingesting, connecting, transforming, and deriving value from disparate sources of information.
* Partner with developers, architects, and agile delivery teams to evolve successful prototypes and experiments into secure, scalable, supportable, and reusable solutions.
* Provide technical direction and hands-on support throughout solution development, helping teams address complex data, architecture, analytics, and integration challenges.
* Translate successful approaches into repeatable data assets, solutions, services, and market offerings that can be leveraged more broadly across Tax & Law.
* Collaborate with technology, risk, security, privacy, and enablement teams to ensure solutions align with EY standards, data governance, and compliance requirements.
* Help strengthen data capability and maturity across service line by establishing reusable approaches, sharing leading practices, and helping teams understand how data can be more effectively leveraged.

  

**Skills and attributes for success**

  

The successful candidate will bring a strong background in data strategy, analytics, data architecture, and hands-on solution development, and will operate as a connector between business leadership, data and technology teams, and solution delivery. They’ll combine the mindset of a strategist, problem solver, and builder: someone who can identify where data can create value, determine how to solve the problem, prove what is possible, and work with a broader team to turn successful ideas into scalable solutions, services, and market offerings.

  

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Demonstrated experience defining or contributing to data strategies, data architectures, analytics roadmaps, data products, or data-enabled service offerings.
* Experience taking ambiguous business opportunities or problems from discovery and exploration through prototyping, solution design, and implementation.
* Experience designing and delivering solutions involving data ingestion, extraction, transformation, integration, modeling, analysis, and visualization.
* Hands-on experience with data preparation, transformation, and integration technologies such as Alteryx or comparable ETL/ELT tools.
* Hands-on experience with data visualization, analytics, or business intelligence platforms such as Power BI.
* Experience working with diverse data platforms, data models, and both structured and unstructured data sources.

Description:
At IMCO, our talent is among the best! IMCO offers a uniquely stimulating and rewarding environment where you can help build and drive organizational transformation, all while seeking to challenge yourself, learn, and grow your career.

Our culture is built on collaboration and passion, with a shared commitment to delivering lasting value to the clients we serve. As IMCO continues to evolve its Target Operating Model, the importance of timely, trusted, and actionable risk and performance insights continues to grow. Technology plays a critical role in enabling investment decision-making, performance measurement, portfolio analytics, regulatory reporting, and enterprise risk oversight.

If you are looking to lead a strategic technology portfolio and help shape the future of Risk and Performance capabilities at IMCO, we would love to hear from you.

**We are looking for a highly motivated Director, Risk & Performance Technology.**

Reporting to the Vice President, Investment Technology, the Director, Risk & Performance Technology is accountable for the strategy, delivery, operation, and evolution of IMCO's Risk and Performance technology capabilities.

This role provides technology leadership for the applications, analytical platforms, reporting capabilities, and integrations that support Risk and Performance. The Director will establish the roadmap for the Risk and Performance technology portfolio, lead key technology initiatives, and ensure technology capabilities remain scalable, reliable, and aligned with IMCO's future operating model.

The role partners closely with Risk, Performance, Investment Operations, Data & AI Enablement, Enterprise Technology, and Front Office stakeholders to improve analytical capabilities, enhance reporting and measurement processes, and deliver trusted insights across the organization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Technology Strategy & Business Partnership**
----------------------------------------------

* Define and execute the multi-year technology roadmap for Risk and Performance capabilities, ensuring alignment with business priorities and IMCO's Target Operating Model.
* Serve as a trusted technology advisor to leaders across Risk and Performance.
* Partner with business stakeholders to identify future capability needs, technology opportunities, and process improvement initiatives.
* Contribute to Investment Technology planning activities and support the development of long-term technology strategies across the investment ecosystem.
* Support business case development, vendor evaluations, and technology investment decisions related to Risk and Performance platforms.

**Risk & Performance Solution Delivery**
----------------------------------------

* Lead the delivery and enhancement of technology solutions supporting portfolio risk measurement, factor analytics, exposure analysis, performance measurement, attribution, benchmark management, and investment reporting.

------------------------------------------

* Drive improvements in measurement processes, reporting workflows, calculation transparency, and analytical consistency.
* Promote the adoption of common data standards and integrated analytical capabilities across investment teams.
* Enable modern analytics, reporting, and decision-support capabilities that improve investment insight and business outcomes.

---------------------------------------

* Ensure Risk and Performance technology solutions operate in accordance with IMCO policies, architecture standards, security requirements, and governance frameworks.

* Oversee incident, problem, change, release, and service management activities across the portfolio.

---------------------

* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Coach, mentor, and develop team members to support career growth and organizational capability development.

* Strong understanding of portfolio risk management, performance measurement and attribution, benchmark management, investment reporting, and portfolio analytics.
* Experience developing technology roadmaps and delivering complex application and platform initiatives.

* Familiarity with Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid delivery methodologies.

Title: Head of BFSI
Description:
**Who we are**  
  
ML arteka is one of the fastest-growing IT Services and Consulting companies in Canada and serves some of the most iconic brands, including Google, Loblaws, Staples, Telus, Bell, Rogers, CIBC, BMO, CMLS, Fossil, Fitbit and more.  
  
Over the last decade, we have achieved 100% client retention and earned more than 20 notable industry recognition. This reflects our reliability in delivering what we promise and the quality we bring to every engagement.  
  
Join our growth-driven culture and help us lead, innovate, and simplify. We are looking for a team members who embody our values:

* Empathetic - we listen, we understand, and are considerate of everyone
* Persevering - we don't give up on challenges or people and go all the way
* Inclusive - we value everyone and their perspectives
* Reliable - we deliver what we promise, and more
* Innovative - we make things better than they were yesterday

  

**The role**  
  
We are seeking a Head of BFSI to **originate and grow** our Banking, Financial Services, and Insurance business across Canada and the United States. This is a **consultative business development leadership** role designed for a senior professional who combines deep BFSI domain expertise with strong technology acumen and the ability to build trusted executive relationships.  
  
You will create a pipeline by engaging BFSI executives on their modernization agenda, shaping opportunities into structured offers (**POV/assessment MVP scale**), and converting those into multi-year programs. You will partner closely with Sales for commercial execution and with internal practice leaders (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) for solution depth and delivery confidence.  
  
This is not transactional selling. Revenue is generated through credibility, insight, and advisory-led origination—not volume outreach or RFP chasing.

  
**Why** **ML arteka****?**  
  
**Most senior BFSI leaders don’t lack ideas—they lack room to act.**

* Room to move faster than RFP cycles and internal red tape. Room to turn executive conversations into funded modernization programs. Room to own outcomes, not activity.

**At** **ML arteka****, this role is built for people who think:**

* “I can build more pipeline if I’m not boxed into bureaucracy.”
* “BFSI buyers need a modernization partner, not another vendor.”
* “I want accountability for conversion—assessment MVP scale—not just meetings.”
* “I want to build a durable BFSI portfolio, not manage accounts.”

**Originate, Don’t Just Network**

* This isn’t about collecting contacts. It’s about creating demand—shaping modernization triggers into structured offers and multi-year programs.

**Operate Like an Owner**

* You’ll have autonomy to build the BFSI growth motion: target accounts, executive coverage, positioning, and deal shaping—partnering with practices and Sales to make programs defensible and repeatable.

**Move Fast, Keep Rigor**

* BFSI modernization demands speed and discipline (risk, compliance, security, resilience). If slow decision cycles frustrate you, you’ll find this environment refreshing and demanding—in the right way.

**A Place for Builders**

* Not for narrow lanes or comfort-first roles. If you want to build a BFSI growth engine and leave a mark, ML arteka is the platform.

**Why This Role Exists**  
  
BFSI enterprises are under unprecedented pressure to modernize:

* Core platforms and legacy applications
* Data estates and analytics foundations
* Risk, compliance, and regulatory capabilities
* Cloud and infrastructure operating models
* AI adoption across fraud, risk, operations, and customer experience

Despite heavy investment, many initiatives stall due to lack of clarity, fragmented execution, and misalignment between business and technology.  
Our firm exists to help BFSI organizations modernize with clarity, control, and measurable outcomes. The Head of BFSI will translate this mission into a sustainable, repeatable **growth engine**.  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**1) Consultative Origination & Pipeline Ownership**

* Own BFSI growth by building pipeline through **executive discovery** and problem-led conversations.
* Develop and maintain a **target account plan** (named accounts, buying centers, modernization triggers, stakeholder maps).
* Identify high-impact BFSI challenges and translate them into structured engagements:
  + POVs and executive workshops
  + Assessments and roadmaps
  + MVPs / pilots
  + Multi-year modernization programs
* Sponsor the progression of clients from **assessment MVP scale**, ensuring opportunities are capability-led and repeatable—not opportunistic.
* Act as executive sponsor on strategic deals and long-term programs; partner with Sales on pursuit orchestration and commercial closure.
* Maintain pipeline hygiene: stage quality, next steps, close plans, and predictable coverage.

**2) Executive Coverage & Relationship Development**

* Serve as the outward-facing BFSI leader and build trusted relationships with:
  + CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CISOs
  + Heads of Risk, Compliance, Operations, Digital, and Data
* Engage clients as a thought partner and modernization advisor; convert executive alignment into funded programs.
* Represent the firm at BFSI events, conferences, and executive forums.
* Lead and contribute to BFSI thought leadership (POVs, whitepapers, panels, roundtables).

**3) Territory/Account Strategy & Growth Plays**

* Define and own the BFSI market strategy for your region/territory.
* Identify priority lines of business, such as:
  + Retail & Commercial Banking
  + Payments & Cards
  + Capital Markets
  + Wealth & Asset Management
  + Insurance
  + Risk, Compliance, and Financial Crime
* Develop BFSI-specific value propositions and use cases aligned to enterprise modernization priorities.
* Shape a BFSI-focused, capability-led GTM model in partnership with practice leaders and Sales.

**4) Deal Shaping (Assessment MVP Scale)**

* Lead discovery with BFSI clients; translate business and regulatory challenges into technology-enabled modernization programs.
* Sponsor and guide solution shaping across:
  + Modernization assessments and roadmaps
  + Data and AI readiness initiatives
  + Platform, cloud, and infrastructure transformation programs
* Partner closely with internal practices (Data & AI, Cloud, App Innovation) to ensure solutions are outcome-driven, realistic, and defensible.
* Ensure pricing and estimation are disciplined; protect margin integrity by validating assumptions, scope, and delivery approach.

**5) Offering Influence & Differentiation**

* Influence the development of BFSI offerings and accelerators that improve repeatability, win-rate, and conversion to multi-year programs.
* Ensure solutions reflect BFSI expectations:
  + Regulatory rigor
  + Enterprise-scale complexity
  + Risk, governance, security, and resilience
* Stay current on BFSI modernization drivers, regulatory trends, and AI adoption challenges.

**6) Ecosystem & Partner Engagement**

* Leverage technology and platform partners selectively to accelerate credible wins.
* Participate in joint GTM and co-sell motions where they support BFSI growth goals.
* Maintain independence and objectivity—partner-aware, not partner-led.

**Measures of Success (What “Good” Looks Like)**

* Predictable BFSI pipeline sourced through executive discovery and modernization triggers
* Strong conversion from **POV/assessment MVP multi-year program**
* Growing average deal size and increased share of multi-year modernization engagements
* Deep executive coverage within priority accounts (multiple senior stakeholders)
* Clear differentiation from implementation-only firms through insight, repeatability, and defensible programs

  
**Who You Are**  
  
**Experience**

* 15+ years in Banking, Financial Services, and/or Insurance
* Proven record **originating** revenue through advisory relationships and consultative engagement
* Strong background in enterprise technology modernization (data, cloud, platforms, security, AI)
* Demonstrated ability to influence and sell to senior BFSI executives
* Track record of converting executive conversations into structured, funded programs

**Attributes (Non-Negotiable)**

* Hybrid consultant + technologist + commercial leader
* Naturally curious and deeply informed about BFSI challenges
* Comfortable owning growth without transactional selling
* Strong executive presence and storytelling ability
* Well-respected in the BFSI ecosystem
* Entrepreneurial mindset; comfortable with ambiguity
* Outward-facing personality—people enjoy engaging with and learning from you

**What You Won’t Be Doing**

* Not a transactional sales role focused on volume outreach
* Not primarily RFP-response driven
* Not a delivery management role (delivery execution is owned by practice and delivery leaders)

**Travel & Location**  
  
Based in Canada (or the United States). Willingness to travel for client engagements, industry events, and executive meetings.  
  
**Why Join Us**

* Opportunity to build and own a BFSI growth engine through consultative origination
* Platform to establish your industry voice and thought leadership
* Strong alignment with AI-era enterprise modernization
* Entrepreneurial environment with executive influence
* Ability to shape offerings, solutions, and market narrative

  
**What to expect**  
  
Besides Competitive Salary and working for one of Canadas Best Managed and Top 50 Technology Companies, you should expect:

* Purposeful Work: autonomy, resources, and time you need to do what matters for our clients and most importantly - you
* Positive Environment: recognition coupled with a flexible environment that celebrates diversity, inclusivity and encourages everyone to achieve their best
* Growth & Development: opportunities to grow professionally and personally through mentorship, training, and development programs
* Transparency & Trust: direction, purpose, mission, and expectations are never a secret; you will always know where you stand as well as where you are going
* Exclusive Perks: discounts on shopping, the gym, insurance, mobile phone plans, not to mention an office smoothie bar and enough coffee to make you vibrate
* Meaningful Benefits: life happens. You will get health, dental, vision, disability, travel insurance, and much more all covered by us
* Unforgettable Events: team bonding, BBQs, office lunches (pizza, always pizza), gala dinners, and any other excuse to have fun

**Inclusion and equal opportunity employment**  
  
ML arteka is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity and inclusion. We are pleased to consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veterans status, Aboriginal/Native American status, or any other legally-protected factors. Disability-related accommodation during the application process is available upon request.

* Prepare and present regular reports on service performance, projects, and operational trends to the Vice President, Information Technology and other agency leadership

**Required Qualifications:**

* High School Diploma or equivalent
* Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in IT support, service delivery, or IT operations, including at least three (3) years in a management or supervisory role leading IT staff
* Experience with IT service management (ticketing), remote support, endpoint management, and asset management platforms

The Project Manager coordinates the delivery of DMP software projects, including web applications, mobile apps, cloud services, and internal systems. Title: Technical Program Manager
Description:

We are a turnkey technology company providing Managed IT Services, VoIP, Cybersecurity, and high-speed Wireless Internet and fiber through Stimulus Broadband.

The role owns schedule, cost, scope, risk and project gates for this portfolio and coordinates with the fiber deployment organization where they two depend on each other. * Own the portfolio and master schedule for network and systems integration programs.
* Market network integration program: migrate each market onto the target architecture and standard platforms, including cutover planning, subscriber migration and retiring legacy systems.
* Run acquisition integration from diligence through cutover and decommissioning.
* Manage wireless projects (sector augments, backhaul upgrades, site remediation) from scope through delivery, using contractors and field crews.
* Track the NMS/OSS deployment roadmap by market and keep platform, network and operations sequenced.
* Own program budgets and forecasts with finance.
* Run project gates and coordinate release to production with Network Operations.
* Maintain the project's intake queue and prioritization.
* Hold vendors and contractors to scope, schedule, and quality.
* Own the risk register and drive escalations to closure.
* Coordinate dependencies with the fiber build organization.
* Report status to the CTO, CEO, and finance.
* Travel to markets as business needs require.

Success Profile
  
  

* Organized leader with can do attitude and able to work across a wide variety of functions
* Holds vendors and internal teams to dates and scope.
* Systems thinking and technical enough to challenge engineers and contractors.
* Writes status an executive can act on quickly.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 8+ years in technical program management on network, systems or infrastructure programs, preferably at an ISP, carrier or MSP.
* Experience running migrations and cutovers on live networks with active subscribers.
* Scheduling, critical path, program controls, forecasting, and change control.
* Stage-gate governance and vendor and contractor management.
* Working knowledge of fixed wireless, IP networking, NMS/OSS/BSS platforms, and fiber access.
* ISP business knowledge: take rate, churn, cost per subscriber and payback.
* Preferred: acquisition integration at an ISP or carrier; NMS/OSS platform deployments; wireless capital programs; hands-on engineering background.
* Must reside in Nevada, California, Oregon, Missouri or New Mexico. Adjacent states may be considered for the right candidate.

Physical Requirements
  
  

* Extended periods working at a computer.
* Regular travel among markets for cutovers, project reviews and contractor oversight.
* Occasional lifting of equipment or materials up to 25 pounds.
* Site visits to data centers, tower sites and active project sites.

**Requirements**

* Stimulus Technologies conducts pre-employment and random background checks, along with drug, alcohol, and cannabis testing. Candidates must pass all required screenings.
* A valid driver's license and an acceptable driving record are required.

Alignment with Core Values

* Driven to Grow – Continuously seeks to develop professionally, stays current with industry practices, and pushes to improve processes and outcomes.

The successful candidate will drive cross-functional hardware and software programs from concept through production, coordinating engineering, firmware, software, validation, manufacturing, supply chain, quality, and customer-facing teams. This role requires strong technical program management expertise, experience managing complex product releases, and a solid understanding of optical networking technologies.
  
  
**Essential Duties And Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain integrated program plans, schedules, milestones, budgets, and resource allocations.
* Drive alignment across cross-functional teams including optics, electrical, mechanical, firmware, software, validation, operations, quality, and supply chain.
* Manage program risks, dependencies, and critical path activities while ensuring timely delivery of key milestones.
* Provide executive-level status reporting, program reviews, and escalation management.
* Establish and drive program governance processes, metrics, and best practices.

**Hardware & Software Product Release Management**

* Manage end-to-end hardware and software product release cycles for optical transceiver products.
* Coordinate release readiness activities across engineering, validation, manufacturing, operations, and customer support teams.
* Track feature readiness, bug resolution, firmware/software releases, qualification status, interoperability testing, and customer commitments.
* Drive release schedules and ensure alignment between hardware milestones and software/firmware deliverables.
* Lead release reviews and develop go-to-market and deployment readiness plans.
* Ensure product releases meet quality, reliability, performance, and customer requirements.

+ 800G OSFP DR8, 2xDR4, FR4, and LR4 modules
+ 1.6T OSFP and OSFP-XD optical transceivers
+ PAM4-based high-speed optical interconnect solutions

This role requires a manager who can oversee existing managers and staff while becoming directly involved when needed. Experience with FIS Horizon and related banking applications is strongly preferred.

**Key Responsibilities**

Title: Director, IT Operations
Description:
**About Ascent**
Ascent Developer Solutions is a leading private lending platform, serving real estate developers nationwide in the acquisition, renovation, and construction of residential real estate. Founded by a leadership team with a deep understanding and personal experience in virtually every facet of real estate development, Ascent is uniquely positioned to create custom, innovative lending solutions for a variety of real estate development business strategies.
  
  
**The Role**
Ascent Developer Solutions is seeking an experienced Director of IT Operations to lead and mature our cloud-first, Microsoft-based technology environment. Reporting to the SVP, Technology, this role owns the reliability, security, and performance of all IT systems and services across the organization — infrastructure, endpoints, identity, collaboration, and end-user support. The Director leads a small internal IT operations team and directs our Managed Service Provider (MSP), owns the IT operations budget and roadmap, and partners with information security, HR, and business leaders to keep systems available, compliant, and cost-effective as the company scales.
  
  
**The Work**

* Own the reliability, performance, and security of the company's technology environment — network, endpoints, servers, cloud and hybrid workloads, and collaboration systems.
* Lead planned network infrastructure modernization, including a firewall and switch refresh.
* Administer the Microsoft 365 environment, including tenant configuration, licensing, mail flow, and security baselines.
* Direct endpoint management and device lifecycle — provisioning, Microsoft Intune (MDM), patching, imaging, and refresh — across an on-site and hybrid workforce.
* Own the IT service desk and end-user experience, defining and meeting service-level agreements (SLAs) for response and resolution.
* Operate identity and access management within Microsoft Entra ID, including SSO, MFA, conditional access, and least-privilege/role-based access.
* Own the technology portion of user onboarding, offboarding, and role changes in close coordination with HR — account and license provisioning, equipment, role-based access, and timely deprovisioning (same-day for involuntary separations).
* Serve as the primary owner of the MSP relationship, directing scope and priorities, managing performance against SLAs, and defining the split between internal and MSP-delivered work.
* Direct IT hardware and software procurement, standardization, and asset and license inventory; manage carriers and technology vendors, including contracts, SLAs, performance reviews, and renewals.
* Continuously monitor IT systems for performance and reliability, proactively addressing issues to minimize downtime and maintain operational efficiency.
* Operate core security controls in partnership with information security leadership — vulnerability and patch management, endpoint protection, logging, and email security.
* Own business continuity and disaster recovery, including backups, recovery testing, and incident-response readiness.

**GENERAL DUTIES**

* Own the IT operations budget; forecast, track, and report spend, including cloud and SaaS cost optimization.
* Build and maintain the IT operations roadmap aligned to company growth, headcount, and facilities plans, such as office moves and new sites.
* Lead, coach, and develop the internal IT operations team.
* Develop, enforce, and update IT policies, standards, runbooks, and best practices to support a secure and efficient technology environment.
* Identify and implement automation and AI-assisted operations to improve efficiency, reliability, and self-service.
* Maintain detailed documentation of system configurations, vendor agreements, and IT processes.
* Lead IT projects from conception to completion — including risk management and mitigation.
* Support compliance and audit programs (e.g., SOC 2) by maintaining accurate IT and control documentation and remediating findings.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and vendor offerings to enhance IT capabilities and streamline operations, working with the MSP where appropriate.
* Provide regular updates and clear communication on IT initiatives, risks, and progress to executives and cross-functional teams.

**Your Skills and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 8+ years in IT operations or infrastructure, including 3+ years leading staff and/or managing an MSP and vendors, preferably in real estate finance or another regulated industry.
* Demonstrated ownership of enterprise infrastructure, identity, endpoint management, and Microsoft 365.
* Hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft Intune (MDM).
* Strong networking and security fundamentals — firewalls, VPN, segmentation, Zero Trust principles, and IAM.
* Cisco Meraki experience a plus.
* Experience running an IT service management (ITSM)/service-desk function and meeting defined SLAs, plus budget ownership and vendor/contract negotiation.
* Experience supporting compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2) and business continuity/disaster recovery.
* Relevant certifications preferred (e.g., ITIL, Microsoft M365/Azure, CISSP, or Security+).
* Excellent leadership, project management, communication, and problem-solving skills.

**The Pay**
Salary range is up to $180,000 per year, with a discretionary bonus of 15% per year
  
  
**The Work Environment**

* This role works on-site from Ascent's Encino office, Monday - Thursday (Fridays are work-from-home).

**Our Benefits**
We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and work-life balance. Our benefits include four health plans, two dental plans, health savings account with employer contribution, flexible spending accounts, vision coverage, a 401(k) plan, and other optional benefits from which to choose.
  
  
**Our Pledge**
We pledge to be fair and considerate in hiring and promoting individuals, ensuring everyone can contribute their fullest potential regardless of background, identity, or personal circumstances. By promoting equal opportunity, we not only enhance our workplace but also contribute to a more just and equitable society. At Ascent, we stand united in building a community where everyone is empowered to succeed. Thank you for joining us on our journey towards a more inclusive future.

Title: Director IT Operations
Description:
**Position:**
***Director, IT Operations***
Monogram Health is seeking an experienced
**Director, IT Operations**
to run the day-to-day operation of our enterprise IT environment end-to-end. Reporting to the VP of Cloud Engineering, this leader is the operational counterpart to the VP's architectural and platform mandate: where the VP defines how our cloud and platform foundations are designed, the Director is accountable for how they run — alongside endpoint, identity, collaboration, network, and service management.
  
  
This is a hands-on operational leadership role for someone who blends classic IT service management discipline with modern Site Reliability Engineering practices. The Director ensures that core IT services, infrastructure, and platforms are reliable, secure, cost-effective, and demonstrably improving over time, measured by service levels, employee experience, and operational maturity, not just uptime.
  
  
This role partners closely with Cloud Engineering, Security, Applications, Data, and Business leaders, and is expected to operate as a peer-level technical leader who can push back constructively when operational realities require it. This position reports to the Vice President, Cloud Engineering.
  
  
**The Director, IT Operations Owns The Operation Of**

* Microsoft Azure environments (IaaS, PaaS, and supporting services) — operating to the architectural standards and platform patterns set by Cloud Engineering
* Enterprise networking — operating cloud networks, VPN, firewalls, and connectivity between on-premises, cloud, and remote users
* Identity & access — Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, RBAC, and identity lifecycle
* Microsoft 365 services — Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive
* Endpoint and user productivity platforms — device lifecycle, patching, and support
* IT service management — incident, problem, change, release, and request management
* Service monitoring, observability, and operational tooling across the IT estate

**Responsibilities**

* Run end-to-end IT operations across cloud, network, identity, endpoint, and collaboration platforms
* Establish and operate Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and error budgets alongside traditional SLAs; use them to drive prioritization between reliability work and change velocity
* Lead incident response and major incident command for IT services; drive post-incident reviews and ensure systemic remediation
* Operate mature ITSM practices (incident, problem, change, release) and continuously evolve them — moving routine change toward automated, pipeline-driven flow while preserving controls
* Operate resilient compute, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery in Microsoft Azure to the standards set by Cloud Engineering
* Run cloud networking, VPN, firewall operations, and secure connectivity between on-premises, cloud, and remote users
* Own operational readiness for new systems, applications, and platform changes — including go/no-go authority for production cutover
* Operate Microsoft Entra ID, conditional access, and RBAC in partnership with Security; own identity hygiene and lifecycle execution
* Ensure reliable, performant delivery of Microsoft 365 services across the enterprise
* Improve the employee IT experience through automation, self-service, and modern workplace tooling; measure it with experience-level metrics (XLAs), not just ticket SLAs
* Ensure reliable IT connectivity and service delivery for corporate and clinical operations
* Promote and operationalize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management in alignment with Cloud Engineering's standards
* Drive automation for provisioning, monitoring, patching, and routine operational tasks; measure and reduce manual toil
* Selectively adopt emerging automation and AI-assisted tooling where it materially improves reliability, response time, or employee experience
* Standardize platforms, reduce technical debt, and improve operational maturity over time
* Partner with Security to operationalize security controls, vulnerability management, and incident response
* Ensure IT operations meet HIPAA, HITRUST, and internal risk management requirements through evidenced, auditable practices
* Own operational evidence for audits — logging, access reviews, change records, and configuration baselines
* Drive FinOps practices across cloud and infrastructure platforms in partnership with Cloud Engineering
* Own the IT operations budget, forecasting, and vendor spend optimization
* Manage vendor and managed service provider relationships, including Microsoft
* Build, lead, and develop high-performing IT operations teams and managers; set career paths for operations engineers, SREs, and service managers
* Foster strong working relationships with Security, Applications, Data, and Business leadership
* Translate clinical and business needs into reliable, secure, well-operated IT services

**Position Requirements**

* Minimum of seven (7) years in enterprise IT infrastructure and operations, including a minimum of three (3) years in an IT leadership role with production accountability
* Demonstrated experience operating Microsoft-centric environments at scale (Azure and Microsoft 365)
* Working knowledge of modern operational practices — SLOs, error budgets, postmortems, observability — layered onto a foundation of mature ITSM
* Track record of partnering with cloud architecture and platform engineering leaders
* Experience driving automation and reducing manual toil through IaC and operational tooling
* Proficiency with FinOps, vendor management, and managed service provider experience
* Prior experience in healthcare or other regulated environments (HIPAA/HITRUST a plus)
* Relevant Microsoft and/or ITSM certifications a plus

**Compensation**
The base salary range for this role is $135,000 to $175,000 and reflects the range of experience and qualifications we may consider. Final compensation will be determined based on geographic location and job-related factors such as experience, skills, education, certifications, and internal compensation considerations. While a larger range is posted, most offers will typically fall within a narrower band based on these factors.
  
  
In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for additional compensation, including bonus opportunities and a comprehensive benefits package.
  
  
**Benefits**

* Comprehensive Benefits - Medical, dental, and vision insurance, employee assistance program, employer-paid and voluntary life insurance, disability insurance, plus health and flexible spending accounts
* Financial & Retirement Support – Competitive compensation, 401k with employer match, and financial wellness resources
* Time Off & Leave – 20 PTO days, 7 paid holidays, and 1 floating day to make your own, and paid parental leave
* Wellness & Growth – Work life assistance resources, physical wellness perks, mental health support, employee referral program, and BenefitHub for employee discounts

**About Monogram Health**
Monogram Health is a leading multispecialty provider of in-home, evidence-based care for the most complex of patients who have multiple chronic conditions. Monogram health takes a comprehensive and personalized approach to a person’s health, treating not only a disease, but all of the chronic conditions that are present - such as diabetes, hypertension, chronic kidney disease, heart failure, depression, COPD, and other metabolic disorders.
  
  
Monogram Health employs a robust clinical team, leveraging specialists across multiple disciplines including nephrology, cardiology, endocrinology, pulmonology, behavioral health, and palliative care to diagnose and treat health issues; review and prescribe medication; provide guidance, education, and counselling on a patient’s healthcare options; as well as assist with daily needs such as access to food, eating healthy, transportation, financial assistance, and more. Monogram Health is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and on holidays, to support and treat patients in their home.
  
  
Monogram Health’s personalized and innovative treatment model is proven to dramatically improve patient outcomes and quality of life while reducing medical costs across the health care continuum.

Title: Head of Applied Science and AI Delivery
Description:
This is your opportunity to join AXIS Capital – a trusted global provider of specialty lines insurance and reinsurance. We stand apart for our outstanding client service, intelligent risk taking and superior risk adjusted returns for our shareholders. We also proudly maintain an entrepreneurial, disciplined and ethical corporate culture. As a member of AXIS, you join a team that is among the best in the industry.

At AXIS, we believe that we are only as strong as our people. We strive to create an inclusive and welcoming culture where employees of all backgrounds and from all walks of life feel comfortable and empowered to be themselves. This means that we bring our whole selves to work.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic, including age, color, disability, ethnicity, gender identity, marital status, national origin, pregnancy, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any basis prohibited by the laws that govern its operations.

**How does this role contribute to our collective success?**  
Data, analytics and AI are critical to AXIS’s ability to make confident decisions, identify opportunities, improve efficiency and create sustainable competitive advantage. The Head of Applied Science & AI Delivery leads the development, management and evolution of AXIS’s portfolio of reusable applied science and AI capabilities.  
Rather than owning delivery for individual business initiatives, this role provides the shared services, models, frameworks, engineering patterns and specialist expertise that enable and support delivery of high-quality business solutions rapidly, safely and consistently. The role is accountable for creating scalable, governed capabilities that can be adopted across multiple value streams, reducing duplication and accelerating value from analytics and AI.

**What will you do in this role?**

* Set the platform vision and roadmap: Define and communicate the strategy, architecture and investment roadmap for reusable data science and AI capabilities, aligned with AXIS’s business priorities, enterprise technology strategy and Data & Analytics operating model.
* Build reusable capabilities: Lead the design and development of shared AI services, analytical models, accelerators, agent frameworks, evaluation frameworks, experimentation environments and common solution components that can be adopted across multiple business-aligned solutions.
* Enable business-aligned delivery: Partner closely with the Head of Insights & Analytics and value-stream teams to understand recurring needs, translate them into platform priorities and ensure capabilities are practical, discoverable, well documented and easy to adopt.
* Lead experimentation and innovation: Create a controlled environment for exploration of emerging analytics, machine learning, generative AI and agentic capabilities. Convert successful experimentation into supported, repeatable enterprise components where there is clear value.
* Establish product and platform management: Manage analytics and AI capabilities as products through their full lifecycle, with clear ownership, roadmaps, service expectations, adoption measures, technical health indicators and plans for continuous improvement or retirement.
* Lead technical standards and engineering excellence: Establish consistent patterns for development, testing, deployment, integration, monitoring, observability, version control, documentation and reuse. Ensure capabilities are robust, maintainable and designed for enterprise scale.
* Drive responsible and governed AI: Partner with Data & AI Governance, Information Risk Management, Legal, Compliance and Technology teams to embed responsible AI, model risk management, security, privacy and regulatory requirements into platform capabilities by design.
* Own evaluation and monitoring frameworks: Ensure reusable approaches are in place to evaluate model and agent quality, performance, reliability, safety and value, and to monitor deployed capabilities throughout their lifecycle.
* Advance the technology ecosystem: Work closely with Data Platforms & Engineering and Business Technology Solutions to shape and implement the analytics and AI technology stack, integration patterns and deployment pathways across Azure and Databricks.
* Build and lead a high-performing specialist team: Lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, applied scientists and AI engineers. Set a high bar for technical and academic rigour while fostering collaboration, inclusion, curiosity and pragmatic delivery.
* Manage demand, capacity and investment: Prioritise the platform backlog based on enterprise value, reuse potential, risk reduction and strategic fit. Manage resources, budgets, suppliers and delivery commitments transparently.
* Champion adoption and reuse: Promote awareness and effective use of shared capabilities, provide technical enablement to delivery teams and actively identify opportunities to consolidate duplicated solutions or patterns

**How this role works with Insights & Analytics**

The Insights & Analytics teams are aligned to business value streams and are accountable for identifying opportunities, defining priorities, designing solutions for each business need, delivering business-aligned solutions and driving adoption and measurable value. The Analytics & AI Platforms team is accountable for the reusable technical capabilities, frameworks, standards and specialist expertise that enable those teams to deliver at greater speed, quality and scale.

Both teams share accountability for successful end-to-end outcomes. The platform team does not become a central delivery queue for every use case, and business-aligned teams should reuse enterprise capabilities wherever practical rather than creating parallel solutions.

**Success Measures / Key Outcomes**

* Reuse and adoption: Shared analytics and AI capabilities are adopted across multiple value streams, with evidence that reuse is reducing duplicated effort and accelerating delivery.
* Speed and scalability: Business-aligned teams can move from opportunity to production more quickly because common services, patterns and deployment pathways are available and reliable.
* Quality and reliability: Platform capabilities meet agreed standards for performance, availability, maintainability, documentation, monitoring and support.
* Responsible delivery: Analytics and AI capabilities operate within AXIS governance, security, privacy, model risk and responsible AI requirements, with effective controls embedded by design.
* Business enablement: Capability investments are demonstrably connected to priority business outcomes and enable solutions that are adopted and deliver measurable value.
* Technology modernisation: The portfolio evolves in a controlled way to take advantage of relevant advances in data science, machine learning, generative AI and agentic technology.
* Team performance: A highly engaged, inclusive and technically strong team with clear accountabilities, effective development pathways and a culture of collaboration and continuous improvement.
* Cost and portfolio discipline: Investment is focused on capabilities with enterprise value and reuse potential, with transparent management of cost, technical debt, suppliers and lifecycle decisions.

**About You**  
We encourage you to bring your own experience and expertise to the table. While there are qualifications and experiences we need you to have, we are open to discussing how your individual knowledge may help you fulfil this role and contribute to our goals.

**What you need to have**

* Platform and product leadership: Significant experience defining and delivering a platform, product or reusable capability strategy in a complex organisation, with accountability for roadmaps, prioritisation, adoption and lifecycle management.
* Technical leadership: Deep experience in data science, machine learning and AI, including generative AI, with the credibility to set technical direction, challenge design decisions and lead senior specialists.
* Insurance or financial services experience: Understanding of the data, analytical, regulatory and risk context of insurance or another highly regulated industry.
* Enterprise AI engineering: Strong understanding of how analytical models and AI services are developed, evaluated, deployed, monitored and operated at scale, including modern software engineering and MLOps or LLMOps practices.
* Cloud and data platforms: Strong knowledge of Azure AI services and Azure Databricks, together with practical understanding of enterprise data architectures, APIs, deployment pipelines and integration patterns.
* Responsible AI and risk: Experience embedding governance, security, privacy, controls and responsible AI practices into the design and operation of analytics and AI capabilities.
* Strategic and commercial judgement: Ability to balance innovation, speed, enterprise value, cost, risk and technical sustainability when making platform investment and prioritisation decisions.
* Collaborative operating style: Demonstrated success working across business-aligned analytics teams, engineering, architecture, technology, governance and senior stakeholders to deliver shared outcomes without relying solely on direct authority.
* People leadership: Proven ability to build, lead and develop multidisciplinary technical teams and create a high-performance, inclusive and learning-oriented culture.
* Communication and influence: Excellent communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical concepts, choices and risks clearly to executives, business leaders and delivery teams.
* Delivery leadership: Ability to operate in a fast-paced environment, manage multiple priorities and provide clear direction, resource planning, cost oversight and delivery transparency.

**What we prefer you to have**

* Relevant technical background: Advanced technical education or equivalent professional experience in data science, computer science, statistics, engineering or a related field.
* Enterprise implementation experience: A track record of building reusable analytics or AI platforms and taking generative AI or agentic capabilities from experimentation into governed enterprise use.
* Technical depth: Strong working knowledge of Python, Databricks, foundational models, evaluation techniques, retrieval patterns, agent architectures, deployment pipelines and monitoring approaches.

**Role Factors**

* Attend your local office in line with AXIS expectations to build relationships with colleagues and the wider business.
* Engage in company activities to grow your network and build a strong team culture.
* Travel internationally on occasion, as required by the role.

**What we offer**  
You will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid annual leave, and much more.

*For this position, we currently expect to offer a base salary in the range of $280,000.00 to $325,000.00. Your salary offer will be based on an assessment of a variety of factors including your specific experience and work location.*

*In addition, you will be offered competitive target incentive compensation, with awards based on overall corporate and individual performance. On top of this, you will be eligible for a comprehensive and competitive benefits package which includes medical plans for you and your family, health and wellness programs, retirement plans, tuition reimbursement, paid vacation, and much more.*

Title: Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager
Description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.
  
  
The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.
  
  
The role of a Silicon Alliances Ecosystem Development Manager at Canonical
  
  
Ubuntu is the fastest growing enterprise Linux, the leading platform for public cloud computing, and the engineer's favorite way to drive the future.
  
  
Our goal is to help the enterprise embrace open source from end to end, across every class of compute and every class of application, starting with the linux kernel itself, to infrastructure solutions like OpenStack and Kubernetes, all the way up to data, security, analytics and serverless capabilities.
  
  
The Silicon Alliances Team works with the leading semiconductor companies to combine open source adoption with innovative optimizations to get the most from each new chip. With our semiconductor partners, we develop joint product roadmaps, drive delivery, formulate go-to-market plans and conceptualize new business models, enabling differentiated hardware and robust product life-cycle support while still anchored to best-in-class Ubuntu. The end goal is a frictionless experience to deploy, maintain, and develop on any hardware from cloud to edge.
  
  
The successful candidate is someone who is passionate about both hardware and software technology with interest to grow into business development. We are hiring for positions across early career to senior roles, with scope ranging from small exploratory partnerships to managing our largest and most strategic partnerships.
  
  
If you are someone who can navigate complex new technical challenges, learn quickly, and architect solutions and strategies across global teams, this challenging role is for you.
  
  
**Location:**
We are hiring for remote roles in Americas. We will also consider applicants in EMEA who can accommodate a shifted schedule to support Silicon partners in Americas. Global travel to sprints, events, and partner meetings is part of the role.
  
  
What your day will look like
  
  

* Represent Canonical, its solutions and software to partners.
* Develop a deep understanding of silicon partner strategies, technologies and roadmaps and identify overlap with Canonical’s current and future products.
* Work cross-functionally with engineering, product, marketing and sales teams to facilitate new business, leading definition of joint products, solutions and complex programs relying heavily on your communicating and influencing skills.
* Ensure that robust project plans are created, tracked, and executed.
* Develop joint Go To Market strategy and campaigns with silicon partners, manage market messaging, collateral and launch plans across products.
* Negotiate successful contracts.

What we are looking for in you
  
  

* B.A / B.S / B.E degree in science, technology and/or engineering.
* Fundamental understanding of the semiconductor industry and ecosystem.
* Experience in software and system architecture is preferred.
* Customer-facing experience in business development, technology strategy or similar functions.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to grasp complex material and synthesize key points.
* Ability to think and work at both strategic and tactical levels
* Disciplined and self motivated for a remote-first workplace environment.

**Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring**

* Experience with open source software and open source business models is preferred.
* Team leadership or program management experience.

What we offer you
  
  
Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.
  
  
In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.
  
  

* Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

* Recognition rewards

* Parental Leave
* Employee Assistance Programme

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Title: Director, Customer Value
Description:
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands— everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences. We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with Customers across every screen.
  
  
We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours.
  
  
**The Challenge**
We are seeking a Director of Customer Value to act as a strategic partner to senior leadership within Adobe’s most important customers across the Middle East. The role drives measurable business outcomes from Adobe investments, with an emphasis on complex, customer facing enterprises where digital experience, loyalty and personalized engagement are central to growth.
  
  
Positioned at the intersection of sales, customer success and delivery, the Customer Value Director takes a long term, outcome led view of the customer journey. The director orchestrates cross functional alignment, establishes value governance, accelerates adoption and communicates business impact. The role is accountable for the value framework and executive narrative, rather than day to day project delivery or commercial ownership.
  
  
What you will do:
  
  
**Strategic alignment**

* Partner with customer executives to understand enterprise priorities, transformation ambitions, business challenges and investment criteria, including the ambitions of major Middle East organizations to scale digital services and customer experiences; define a shared vision for the outcomes Adobe can enable.
* Translate priorities into a joint value roadmap linking prioritized use cases, Adobe capabilities, business owners, dependencies, milestones and measurable success indicators. Tailor value hypotheses to customer economics, such as customer acquisition, loyalty, conversion, digital channel adoption, ancillary revenue and service experience.
* Work with the Adobe ecosystem to align engagement plans with strategic account priorities.

**Outcome orchestration**

* Bring together Adobe Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, technical specialists and partners around agreed value milestones and decision points.
* Proactively identify risks, misalignment, and barriers to value realization. Coordinate executive escalations when required, ensuring clear ownership, timely engagement from relevant stakeholders, and alignment on resolution plans that protect customer outcomes.
* Guide customers through business change considerations, operating model alignment and adoption priorities needed to realize value.

**Value governance and realization**

* Define value hypotheses, baseline measures, target KPIs and an evidence based approach to tracking business impact.
* Establish executive governance and business review cadences to validate progress, test assumptions, address gaps and evolve the value roadmap.
* Build compelling executive value narratives, scorecards and customer success stories that distinguish realized benefits from forecast or potential benefits.

**Executive partnership**

* Build trusted relationships with senior business and technology stakeholders including CEOs, CMOs, CDOs, CIOs, CFOs and relevant business unit leaders, navigating complex stakeholder structures and executive sponsorship models common in major regional enterprises.
* Lead strategic workshops, business reviews and executive conversations that connect customer priorities, industry dynamics and Adobe enabled outcomes; constructively challenge assumptions where appropriate. Adapt engagement to the diverse markets, languages, customer expectations and digital maturity levels across the Middle East.
* Advocate for the customer internally and position Adobe as a long term strategic transformation partner.
* Drive customer advocacy by identifying opportunities to showcase successful transformation outcomes through executive testimonials, customer success stories, industry events, speaking engagements and strategic forums.
* What you’ll need to succeed
* Extensive experience in customer success leadership, strategic customer engagement, digital transformation or comparable senior customer facing roles within enterprise SaaS and cloud technology organizations, with a proven ability to drive measurable business outcomes.
* Strong executive presence and demonstrated experience engaging, influencing and building trusted relationships with C-suite executives and senior business leaders, including the ability to navigate high pressure situations, manage sensitive executive escalations and lead challenging conversations with confidence.
* Proven ability to operate at both strategic and operational levels, translating executive priorities into actionable plans while orchestrating internal teams, partners and stakeholders to drive alignment, resolve challenges and accelerate customer outcomes.
* Strong commercial and business acumen, with the ability to understand customer business models, identify value opportunities and articulate how technology investments contribute to strategic priorities, operational improvements and measurable business impact.
* Solid understanding of enterprise SaaS and cloud technologies, digital transformation and customer experience strategies. Experience with marketing technology (MarTech) platforms and ecosystems, particularly in areas such as customer data, personalization and digital marketing, would be a strong advantage.
* Demonstrated experience managing complex enterprise customer relationships, ideally within large, matrixed organizations and across multiple business and technology stakeholders.
* Excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills, with the ability to develop compelling executive briefings, strategic value roadmaps, business reviews, customer success stories and narratives that communicate business impact to senior audiences.
* Strong collaboration and orchestration skills, with experience working across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services, Product, Engineering and partner ecosystems to align priorities, influence decisions and deliver customer outcomes without direct authority.
* An understanding of the Middle East business environment, including the dynamics of large regional enterprises, complex stakeholder structures and varying levels of digital maturity. Experience across customer centric industries such as travel and hospitality, retail etc. would be advantageous.

Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences.
