Title: BMW Program Manager
Description:
**Duties & Responsibilities**

**Client Partnership & Programme Governance**

* Act as direct support to the BMW ME Training Manager in planning, executing and controlling the Training Centre, its activities and resources.
* Act as GP Strategies' primary point of contact and escalation for BMW on the training programme.
* Develop and maintain programme and project plans, including milestones, owners, deliverables, budget, implementation timing and approval gateways, with a plan for each new learning initiative.
* Lead the start-up phase of new projects, including problem definition, concept development and vendor selection.
* Identify training and coaching opportunities that support BMW ME's business objectives, using requirements obtained from the market or the BMW Regional Office (RO). Evaluate the training strategy against changing market and importer needs, and recommend new learning and development initiatives to BMW.
* Lead the development of training and coaching programmes, with Trainer input, for BMW approval.
* Set up meetings, supported by the Training Co-ordinator, with the people responsible for each new project and for approving the proposed solution.
* Ensure each new programme is delivered on time, within budget and to BMW standards, including reporting and participant feedback.
* Set up and own the training materials repository, together with the Training Co-ordinator, tracking all existing material under version control so that there is a clean, current record of every update, replacement and enhancement; ensure materials developed for new programmes are provided to BMW and retained in the repository.
* Using the repository as the starting point for material reviews and overhauls, revisit existing training programmes so that they reflect the current product range and BMW's updated training methods; table update plans with BMW where needed, and execute them once approved.
* Receive the Sales & Product Trainers' proposals for improving sales training materials and methodologies, and decide which to take forward as part of programme reviews and overhauls.
* Review and approve the annual training plan and training calendar prepared by the Training Co-ordinator before submission to BMW.
* Support the training needs analysis.
* Support quarterly adjustments to the training plan.
* Support the planning of Focus Training and coaching.
* Manage programme risks, issues and changes, and communicate their impact on scope, timelines, resources and cost.
* Maintain programme documentation, decisions and action logs.
* Maintain a formal improvement tracker of all proposals tabled with BMW, together with BMW's responses.
* Record and track all new projects delivered by or via GP, and all value-added services.
* Lead GP's participation in audits, programme reviews and BMW governance activities.

**Client Meetings & Reporting**

* Run the weekly operations meeting with the team, covering priorities, delivery status and actions.
* Chair the monthly client meeting with BMW, covering performance, KPIs, SLA results and the forward plan.
* Lead the quarterly account meeting with BMW, including review of annual volumetrics, capacity assumptions and demand trends.
* Review all reports and the monthly KPI scoreboard before they are sent to BMW.
* Own and sign off the monthly SLA report, and chair the monthly joint review of the SLA exception register with BMW.
* Keep BMW and the BMW RO informed of successes and noteworthy stories, and maintain a success log with evidence.

**Financial Control**

* Prepare annual budget inputs, including training volumes, trainer mix and costs, for the Senior Director, who sets rates and agrees the budget with BMW.
* Control all programme financials against the approved budget, including spend, variance and BMW over- or under-spend, and escalate commercial risks.
* Prepare the monthly forward forecast of revenue, vendor cost and training volumes.
* Control GP revenue recovery: sign off monthly BMW invoicing so that all billable activity is recovered, and reconcile SLA credit deductions.
* Reconcile vendor costs against BMW invoicing every month.
* Support the maintenance of the training tracker and the monthly billing data.
* Liaise with GP Finance and the Senior Director on billing, forecasting and commercial matters.

**Service Quality, KPIs & SLA Compliance**

* Set, monitor and control KPIs for the entire team; act on deviations and identify improvement opportunities.
* Define, maintain and monitor service delivery quality standards for the Training Centre, and lead continuous-improvement reviews.
* Receive and review the Training Administrator's reports on the Operating Standards Manual and the adoption of agreed processes across the team, and act on any gaps.
* Submit Deviation Requests to BMW by the 14-day fill-rate measurement date.
* Submit Legitimate Cause claims with supporting evidence within the contractual timelines.
* Direct the Training Administrator's support in preparing Deviation Requests and Legitimate Cause claims.
* Dispute SLA results with evidence within 5 business days of notification.
* Issue Service Rectification Plans and corrective and preventive action plans when Non-Compliance Events occur.
* Hold accountability for the compliance register of vendor agreements, work permits, licences and sub-supplier documents maintained by the Training Administrator.

**Product Launches, Conferences & Events**

* Own all product launches, conferences and events end to end, as decision-maker and custodian of quality, budget, BMW CI and brand standards, approvals and execution, liaising with BMW so that decisions reflect its requirements.
* Review and approve launch event concepts developed by the Training Co-ordinator, together with BMW.
* Lead the briefing for each launch or event, and feed approved concepts and decisions through to the team and external event suppliers.
* Support the team in the operational delivery of launches and events, as briefed.

**Vendor Oversight**

* Approve training vendors and programmes together with BMW and the BMW regional office.
* Produce a briefing document for supplier tender, or for a selected supplier to GP, setting out the programme requirement, key success factors, budget and timing, and appoint the supplier.
* Hold an annual review with each supplier, including written feedback from importers, participants and BMW where possible.

**People & Resource Management**

* Lead the BMW ME team to achieve its KPIs and SLA obligations.
* Manage the performance of direct reports, including objectives, quarterly conversations, reviews and performance improvement plans.
* Manage time sheets and approve leave and sickness for all Training Centre staff, and handle team escalations.
* Act as the escalation point for internal operational matters handled day to day by the Training Co-ordinator.
* Manage grievances and employee issues together with GP Strategies management.
* Manage the performance of employed and vendor trainers against SLA quality and conduct requirements.
* Sit in on training regularly to ensure employed and vendor trainers maintain training standards consistently, and give them feedback.
* Recruit staff, including CV review, interviews and scoring.
* Maintain a recruitment pipeline and back-up resource plan, and fill replacement or additional roles within 3 months.
* Replace trainers within 5 business days when required by BMW, or put interim mitigation in place.
* Support trainer capacity planning and allocation.
* Onboard and certify new or replacement trainers.
* Support trainer calibration, train-the-trainer and professional development.
* Seek opportunities to reward and recognise the team and vendor trainers.

**Ad Hoc Duties**

* Undertake additional duties associated with the successful delivery of the BMW ME training programme, as reasonably required by the Senior Director.

**Key Performance Measures**

The Programme / Project Manager is measured on the performance of the programme as a whole, including the SLA requirements in the BMW contract addendum effective 1 January 2027:

* Course fill-rate of at least 95% (minimum 8 participants where applicable) and delivery of the agreed annual training volume.
* Participant satisfaction of at least 90% per course, per trainer and as a monthly average.
* Complete course content readiness before every delivery.
* Recruitment and replacement within contractual timelines.
* Full local, legal and financial compliance, with no Material Breach events.
* Programme financial performance against budget and forecast, including full revenue recovery.
* Minimal SLA service credits, with Rectification Plans and claims submitted on time.

**Professional Competence**

No day is the same, so it is important that you can prioritise, manage your time successfully, and work both proactively and reactively.

* Strong programme and project management capability across multiple workstreams, markets and stakeholders.
* Proven financial control: budgets, forecasting, revenue recovery, cost-to-invoice reconciliation and commercial risk management.
* Experience managing to contractual SLAs and KPIs, including evidence-based claims and corrective action planning.
* Strong governance, risk and issue management.
* Ability to translate business requirements into practical, measurable programme plans.
* Confident management of senior client stakeholders, including leading formal client and account meetings.
* People leadership: performance management, recruitment and team development.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; able to interpret training data and KPI reports.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Teams.
* Working knowledge of TMSi or another learning management system is advantageous.

**Personal Competence**

* Demonstrates accountability and ownership for results.
* Professional and confident with senior internal and external stakeholders.
* High emotional intelligence and cultural awareness across diverse markets.
* Commercially minded, with strong attention to detail.
* Proactive in identifying issues and opportunities rather than waiting for direction.
* Calm and decisive under pressure; manages competing priorities effectively.
* Builds trust and credibility with the client, the team and vendors.
* Positive, collaborative and solutions-focused.

Title: Director of IT Services
Description:
**Position Overview**

The
**Director of IT Services**
will lead and strengthen technology operations as the organization grows. Reporting to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO), this leader is accountable for reliable IT services, effective security practices, responsive employee support, and the performance of internal staff and external service providers across service desk operations, security, infrastructure, and business applications.

This role is primarily focused on leadership, with approximately 70% or more of the effort dedicated to directing staff and service providers. The Director must bring sufficient practical technical experience to evaluate technical recommendations, maintain vendor and team accountability, and contribute directly during critical incidents or situations requiring advanced technical support.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with Human Resources, Finance, Engineering, Marketing, Contracting and Program Management, Operations, and other business functions to align IT services with organizational needs.
* Assess systems, services, processes, staffing, and vendor capabilities to develop and execute a prioritized improvement roadmap in partnership with the CTO.
* Direct staffing, sourcing, technology, and investment decisions, maintaining fiscal responsibility for the IT budget across procurement, licensing, renewals, projects, and operating costs.
* Own the reliability, security, performance, and lifecycle management of IT infrastructure, cloud services, networks, connectivity, and endpoints.
* Establish internal monitoring capabilities for critical systems; define service availability targets, support commitments, and escalation procedures; and measure uptime and SLA attainment.
* Establish recovery time and data-loss objectives, maintaining and testing backup, restoration, and disaster recovery capabilities across SaaS, cloud, and internally operated systems.
* Collaborate with Engineering on production hosting, shared infrastructure, and local inference systems, establishing clear boundaries for operations, security, monitoring, and recovery.
* Direct IT security policies, risk management, compliance readiness, and protective controls, including EDR, ZTNA, identity security, and account lifecycle management.
* Lead improvements supporting applicable CMMC requirements and NIST standards, including documentation, evidence collection, remediation, and exception management.
* Oversee SIEM and SOC operations with the MSSP, and manage patching and vulnerability remediation workflows in coordination with the MSP.
* Maintain a standardized incident response plan, lead the computer security incident response team, conduct readiness exercises, and direct responses to critical incidents.
* Oversee the technical administration, integration, and lifecycle of business applications, websites, identity providers, single sign-on, and privileged access.
* Partner with operational leadership to align technology strategy, automation, and system integrations with cross-departmental workflows.
* Guide data classification and retention practices with business stakeholders and legal counsel, overseeing DLP, legal holds, and eDiscovery execution.
* Manage internal service desk operations, support ticketing, device depot fulfillment, provisioning, corporate and personally owned device management, and secure offboarding.
* Implement automation and AI-assisted tools with human oversight to enhance service delivery, and direct end-user security awareness and technology training.
* Manage MSP, MSSP, software, infrastructure, depot, and technology vendors against contracts and SLAs, ensuring the organization maintains administrative access, visibility, and continuity.
* Maintain hardware and software inventories, reconcile licensing entitlements, and produce regular operational reporting and executive summaries on service levels, security, compliance, and spending.
* Recruit, manage, mentor, and develop IT staff, establishing performance standards, cross-training plans, and team goals aligned with organizational priorities.

**Required Qualifications**

* 12+ years of IT experience, including substantial practical experience across infrastructure, enterprise services, and IT operations.
* 7+ years of experience leading technical teams, including responsibility for staff performance, service delivery, and external service providers.
* Demonstrated success improving an established IT function, with measurable results in service quality, reliability, security, team effectiveness, or vendor performance.
* Experience leading internal service desk operations and managing services delivered through MSPs, MSSPs, and other partners.
* Experience owning security policies, risk remediation, incident response readiness, and compliance or audit preparation.
* Experience establishing service expectations, measuring uptime and SLA attainment, evaluating vendor obligations, and reporting performance to leadership.
* Demonstrated financial discipline in budgeting, procurement, licensing, asset management, and vendor oversight.
* Strong communication, people leadership, and change management skills.
* Ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.
* United States citizenship.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 15+ years of IT experience, including substantial practical experience across infrastructure, enterprise services, and IT operations.
* 10+ years of experience leading technical teams, including responsibility for staff performance, service delivery, and external service providers.
* Experience leading the adoption and effective use of Microsoft 365 G5 services and GCC High environments.
* Broad technical depth across cloud services, networking, identity, endpoints, enterprise applications, monitoring, and security.
* Experience supporting government contracting organizations and CMMC or NIST-based security programs.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 security and information governance capabilities, including DLP, retention, legal holds, and eDiscovery.
* Experience improving IT operations and security maturity in a growing organization with a small internal staff and multiple outsourced partners.
* Experience with business application integration, HR-driven onboarding automation, depot services, and scalable device provisioning.
* Experience applying automation and AI-assisted capabilities to IT administration, service delivery, and employee support.
* Experience with Windows Server, Linux, cloud infrastructure, and network security.
* An active security clearance.

**Work Location, Schedule, and Travel**

* Employment Type: Full time.
* Location: Remote. Remote eligibility is limited to residents of the following states: AL, FL, IN, MI, MO, NM, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, WY.
* Travel: Up to six weeks per year based on business needs.
* Availability: This position is not assigned to a scheduled on-call rotation. Critical incidents may require availability outside standard business hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, to coordinate incident response and resolution.

**Compensation and Benefits**

* The organization maintains a geo-neutral approach to compensation within the United States, determining pay by job function and level rather than location.
* Health coverage, including medical, dental, and vision insurance.
* Retirement plan with employer matching.
* Paid time off, including vacation, paid sick and safe leave, and floating holidays.
* Life and AD&D insurance.
* Professional development allowance.

**Additional Information**

* The organization is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age (40 or older), disability, or genetic information.
* Reasonable accommodation is available for individuals with disabilities during the application and interview process upon request.

Headquarters located in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma, CFS BRANDS is a market-leading designer, manufacturer and distributor of commercial foodservice, healthcare, and industrial hygiene products.

Title: Senior Vice President, Global Services
Description:
****Responsibilities****
The
**Senior Vice President, Global Services**
owns the end-to-end delivery of Octave implementation, deployment, and migration services worldwide. Reporting to the Chief Revenue Officer, this role is accountable for the global portfolio of customer programs, from initial deployments to enterprise cloud consolidations and legacy migrations.
  
  
This role makes services a growth engine, not just a delivery function. You will lead regional delivery, project management, deployment engineering, solution architecture, training, and cutover teams across Americas, EMIA, and APAC while building one global delivery system. The outcome is shorter time-to-value, repeatable deployments, productized services, improved margin and predictability, and greater go-live confidence.
  
  
**Transform and Accelerate Global Services Execution**

* Build one global delivery system. Replace regional variation with a consistent global methodology for project governance, portfolio health, forecasting, risk, and escalation management.
* Stand up a global PMO and center of excellence. Create global delivery and technical implementation capabilities with flexible resourcing and follow-the-sun coverage.
* Shift the operating culture. Move from bespoke customer requirements toward a software-implementation mindset: configure rather than customize, and address product gaps through the roadmap rather than services hours.
* Align services to the revenue motion. Connect Services with Sales, Channel, and Customer Success through services attach, migration offers, clean handoffs, and consistent scoping and estimating.
* Hire, train, and shift talent globally. Bring in modern SaaS delivery expertise, re-skill tenured talent, develop regional successors, and reshape roles for the future operating model.
* Tighten the R&D-to-Services loop. Turn implementation friction into prioritized roadmap input and roadmap delivery into faster, cleaner, more repeatable deployments.

****What You'll Own****

* Global services P&L, utilization and portfolio performance. Own worldwide services revenue, margin, utilization, backlog, forecasting, services attach, conversion, and on-time/on-budget delivery.
* Mission-critical go-lives, worldwide. Own global playbooks, governance, escalation paths, follow-the-sun support, and executive intervention for at-risk deployments.
* Global cloud migration program. Lead migration of Octave's installed base to the cloud, including commercial offers, technical execution, customer change management, data residency, and migration tooling.
* Services transformation. Move from bespoke work toward productized offerings for deployments, cloud transitions, consolidations, and AI enablement, supported by reusable accelerators and reference architectures.
* Partner and delivery ecosystem. Expand and govern the global SI and reseller network with consistent certification, quality standards, and joint-delivery models.
* Regulatory and compliance-aware delivery. Meet applicable security, GDPR, data-sovereignty, and country-specific requirements without fragmenting the global operating model.
* Customer outcomes. Partner with Customer Success, Support, and Product to improve time-to-value, post-go-live stabilization, and customer reference-ability.
* Team. Lead and develop a global organization spanning delivery, program management, architecture, engineering, migration, training, and field readiness, with 1,000+ FTEs plus contractor, nearshore/offshore, and partner capacity.

****Education / Qualifications****

* A senior global services executive with 20+ years of enterprise software delivery experience, including at least 8 years leading services organizations at VP/SVP scale and direct accountability for a $100M+ multi-region services P&L. You have led services teams across at least two of the three major regions (Americas, EMEA, APAC) and understand what it takes to run one global operating model across different labor markets, procurement cultures, and regulatory environments.
* You've done this in a mission-critical, regulated, or 24/7-operations software category — public safety, healthcare, utilities, manufacturing quality, industrial asset management, financial services trading systems, air traffic, defense — somewhere downtime is not an option and customers are operationally dependent on your software the moment it goes live.
* You've led a services transformation at global scale, not just managed delivery. You've taken a custom-project organization and moved it meaningfully toward productized, repeatable, partner-leveraged delivery across multiple regions, and you can speak to the specific levers you pulled and the numbers that moved.
* You've owned a cloud migration program at scale — moving an installed base of on-prem customers to SaaS or managed cloud across multiple countries — and you understand the commercial, technical, change-management, and data-sovereignty mechanics of doing that without breaking customer trust.
* You know how to operate inside a revenue organization. You've partnered tightly with Sales and Channel on attach, packaging, and pricing of services; you treat the forecast as a shared commitment; and you can hold the line on delivery quality and margin while still moving at the speed the revenue engine demands.
* You lead in the field, globally. Customers on every continent expect to meet the executive who is accountable for their deployment. You're comfortable on-site at 2 a.m. during a cutover, in an executive briefing the next week, and in a board review the week after — and you build regional leaders who can carry that presence when you're not in the room.
* You make decisions with incomplete information, hold a clear line on quality and commitments across time zones and cultures, and have a track record of building global organizations people want to stay at.

**Nice to Have**

* Direct experience delivering mission-critical operational software (dispatch, quality management, EAM/APM, or comparable categories)
* Background as a customer-side operations or technology executive who later moved vendor-side
* Experience with Hexagon-heritage platforms or comparable enterprise software ecosystems
* Experience integrating an AI-assisted offering into an established services motion
* Experience operating in-country delivery entities, works-council environments, and public-sector or regulated-industry procurement outside North America

****About Octave****

Our products sit at the heart of our customers' operations: when they go live, downtime is not an option, and customers are operationally dependent on our software from day one.
  
  
Following Octave's spin-off from Hexagon, we are accelerating a global shift to cloud-delivered, AI-enabled solutions. Our installed base of on-premises customers — across dozens of countries, regulatory regimes, and industry standards — needs a confident, well-orchestrated path forward, and new customers on every continent expect faster, more predictable deployments than these industries have historically experienced. Sitting inside the revenue organization, this seat connects delivery excellence directly to growth. The next few years are when the services model for these industries gets rewritten globally, and the person in this seat gets to do the rewriting — on every continent Octave serves.
  
  
**Everyone is welcome**
At Octave, we believe that diverse and inclusive teams are critical to the success of our people and our business. Here, everyone is welcome. As an inclusive workplace, we don't discriminate. In fact, we embrace differences and are fully committed to creating equal opportunities, an inclusive environment, and fairness for all.

Full-time
  
  
**Description**
BNP Associates, Inc., a global leader in air transportation consulting and engineering, has an immediate need for a Senior Project Manager / Site Support Lead to serve as the primary client-facing leader for BNP's baggage handling systems (BHS) program at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ).
  
  
This is a dynamic, high-visibility role supporting a client that expects a consistently polished, expert presence and deep BHS subject-matter expertise. You will act as the primary liaison and Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the client and contractors, lead the on-site support team, and given the pace and demands of this account, remain willing to personally step into tactical, hands-on tasks alongside your team rather than delegate exclusively.
  
  
You will work closely with BNP's Designers, Project Engineers, Directors, and Executives, and will mentor less-experienced team members to build a durable, high-performing site support presence at YYZ.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary liaison and BHS Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the client and contractors, maintaining a polished, expert presence at all times.
* Lead and manage the on-site support team (including field/project engineering staff) for surveys, inspections, installations, functional assessments, and testing.
* Personally perform or directly support tactical, hands-on tasks as needed to meet client expectations and project pace, this is not a purely oversight-level role.
* Coordinate with Designers, Project Engineers, Directors, and Executives to assign staff and develop all required reports, specifications, drawing packages, and client submittals.
* Maintain project budgets and schedules to ensure timely, cost-effective completion.
* Review and respond to Requests for Information (RFIs); supervise punch list resolution and provide start-up assistance.
* Review functional assessments, technical reports, specifications, and drawing packages prepared by Project Engineers, and provide feedback to ensure quality and accuracy.
* Conduct and analyze system simulations for performance evaluation.
* Mentor and support Project Engineers and Designers, including managing workload and coverage across the site support team.
* Proactively manage the client relationship and expectations given the account's high-touch, service-intensive nature.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's or advanced degree in mechanical, electrical, or industrial engineering, or a related discipline (or equivalent field experience).
* 10+ years of project management experience, preferably within baggage handling systems (BHS), aviation, or large-scale airport infrastructure.
* Demonstrated leadership and team-building experience managing site support or field engineering teams.
* Exceptional client rapport, communication, and executive presence, this account requires a consistently polished, expert-level representative.
* Experience managing project logistics, timelines, and budgets.
* Demonstrated willingness and ability to perform tactical, hands-on tasks personally when the situation requires it, not solely delegate to junior staff.
* Based in, or able to relocate to, the Greater Toronto Area, with regular on-site presence at YYZ.
* Ability to pass criminal background checks and obtain/maintain airport security credentials (RAIC).

**Preferred**

* Civil or electrical engineering backgrounds, or other educational backgrounds with relevant knowledge/experience, will also be considered.
* Previous experience in conceptual and spatial coordination work with large-scale hub airports.
* PMP certification.

**Education**

* Advanced Engineering degree or equivalent field experience.
* PMP certification preferred but not required.

**Working Conditions**

* On-site support at Toronto Pearson International Airport (YYZ); client offices adjacent to the airport campus.
* Some remote work is possible when direct site activities are not required, though frequent on-site presence is expected given client expectations.
* Standard 40-hour work week with occasional additional time required to meet deadlines.

Candidates must be legally entitled to work in Canada by the start date. BNP Associates is not able to support a Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) or an employer-specific work permit for this role.

We are an equal opportunity employer. BNP offers an excellent benefits package and competitive salaries, along with professional advancement opportunities.

* Offer Phase:

+ Service Delivery Model Definition:

- Providing input for service related costing.

- Support the selection process, owned by Purchasing department, based on criteria such as capability, cost, quality, and reliability.

+ Backup Service Related Tasks:

- Interface Management for all service related aspects between onsite teams (Field Service) and remote teams (Care Center, Service Sales, Service Backbone Operation) during the buildup phase.
- Initiating back-to-back agreements with suppliers according to the defined service delivery model for each solution element.
- Establish delivery processes based on decided legal setup for Order Management, 3rd Party services, Training and adaptation services in cooperation with Service Backbone Operation, leveraging standard wherever possible.
- Assure optimized service inventories in cooperation with Service Backbone Operation

- Work closely with 3rd Party Service Product Manager, regional Subcontractor Manager, Legal and Purchasing department to ensure contracts are comprehensive and protect the interests of the organization.

+ Ramp-up of Service Employees:

- Oversee the recruitment and onboarding process for service team members.
- Ensure that service teams are appropriately staffed to meet project demands and timelines.

+ Trainings for Service Employees:

- Identify skill gaps and develop training programs to enhance the competencies of service employees (internal and external), leveraging the G+D Training Curriculum wherever possible.
- Coordinate and oversee the execution of training sessions, ensuring that all service employees are equipped with the necessary skills and knowledge.

+ Trainings for Customers:

- Identify training needs for customers.
- Coordinate and oversee the execution of training sessions, ensuring that the customer is trained for all relevant components. Leverage the G+D Training Curriculum and Global Training infrastructure wherever possible.

+ Coordination of Installation Related Tasks:

- Coordinate, plan and manage the installation of the G+D Solution in close alignment with the Solution Project Manager.
- Oversee the onsite service teams to ensure that installations are completed on time and meet all quality standards.

+ Site Acceptance Related Tasks:

- Ensure the successful transition from project to maintenance phase for all service related tasks. Manage the handover of responsibilities from the solution to the service team

+ Reporting and Documentation:

- Maintain comprehensive documentation of all service processes and adjustments made during implementation phase.
- Provide input to project reports on service status, challenges, and achievements.

+ Feedback and Improvement:

- Plan and conduct with reached SAT (Site Acceptance Test) the project closure process including the required lessons-learned activities.

* Warranty and after warranty phase

+ Service Initialization:

- Monitoring the closure of open items from project phase to completely hand-over the solution into a maintenance phase.
- Assist the Field Service, Support and Backbone Operation teams during Hyper Care phase.
- Implement continuous improvement initiatives to enhance service quality and customer satisfaction.

+ Performance Management:

- Coordination of all activities needed to deliver committed service scope with high performance.

+ Customer Management:

- Interface to the customer for technical discussions.
- Manage customer escalations and drive timely solution deliveries using the entire backup organization.

+ Single Point of Contact:

- Overall coordination of delivering committed scope with respective delivery units (Field Service, Support, Training, Repair, Order Management, Adaptation)

+ Contract Renewal:

- Support Service Sales during contract negotiation and renewal phase
- Setting Up and providing Service Fulfillment and commercial related Contract reporting based on committed scope

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, or a related field
* Certification in Project Management
* Ability to lead and manage teams, to administer relationships as well as influence and manage subcontractors and suppliers effectively

* Demonstrated ability to coordinate activities to deliver high service performance consistently
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills to interact with customers, team members, and other stakeholders
* Fluency in written and spoken English and French

Title: Operations Lead

Description:
**About the role**

We are hiring an Operations Lead to run our operations end to end and lead the operations team.

You will carry full responsibility for how the operation is run, from planning and process design to getting the work done when the team needs support.

We are looking for someone who is organized, decisive and dependable, who can manage several priorities at once and deliver to a high standard without close supervision.

**Delivery and service levels**

* Own day-to-day operations and make sure work is delivered accurately and on time.

* Review the team's work for accuracy, especially manual adjustments and other sensitive transactions.
* Work closely with the finance team on reconciliations, settlements and approvals.

**Processes, reporting and risk**

* Write and maintain the operating model and standard operating procedures, with clear owners.
* Keep live registers of issues, actions and operational risks, and report on them monthly.
* Own operational reporting and dashboards, and turn the data into insights and recommendations.

* Recommend improvements to processes, tools and the overall offering.
* Keep records ready for audit and support audits when needed.
* Support other activities as required by the business.

* Experience managing senior stakeholders and running regular review meetings.
* Experience working to service levels and delivering regular reports to deadlines.
* Experience writing standard operating procedures and improving processes.
* Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills, including building reports and dashboards from data.
* Well-organized and able to manage several priorities and deadlines at once.
* Takes ownership, makes decisions and follows through without being chased.
* Detail-oriented and holds the team to a high standard of accuracy.
* Calm under pressure and able to handle escalations professionally.
* Excellent spoken and written English, including clear and professional emails and presentations.

**Strongly preferred**

* Good spoken and written Arabic.
* Experience working with technology providers on system issues and changes.
* Experience in loyalty programs, rewards, payments, events, sports or other transaction-based businesses.

Title: Associate Project Director (Residential)
Description:
Mace combines construction expertise with consultancy to unlock potential in every person or project and redefine the boundaries of ambition. Our values shape the way we consult and define the people we want to join us on our journey.

**The project**

Mace is providing project management consultancy services on a major mixed-use development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

This is an opportunity to join an ambitious programme, supporting the delivery of a significant new-build residential development from design through construction and handover.

As Associate Project Director, you will provide senior project management leadership and control across the full project lifecycle, from concept and pre-contract stages through procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.

The successful candidate will bring strong front-end, design, and development experience alongside proven construction delivery capability.

You will work closely with the development and design functions, providing project management oversight, structure, and control during the critical early stages of the programme before leading the project through procurement and post-contract delivery.

**You'll be responsible for:**
  
• Overseeing the end-to-end project management and delivery of major new-build residential assets from concept design through pre-contract, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover.
  
• Establishing robust project governance, controls, reporting, and decision-making processes from the early design stages.
  
• Taking ownership of the overall project programme, with particular focus on establishing, controlling and maintaining the design programme.
  
• Providing early project management oversight across the development and design functions, ensuring development objectives are translated into clear and deliverable project requirements.
  
• Coordinating with the PMC design managers and architect, design consultants, specialist consultants and wider multidisciplinary project team to ensure design deliverables are achieved against key milestones.
  
• Challenging design progress, identifying programme risks and driving consultants and stakeholders toward timely decisions and resolution.
  
• Managing the integration of design, approvals, procurement and construction programmes to maintain a clear route to delivery. This is consistent with the Mace SPM responsibility for producing and integrating design and authorities programmes with procurement and delivery programmes.
  
• Supporting and coordinating the project's residential sales launch strategy, ensuring critical design and delivery milestones support the required commercial launch dates.
  
• Supervising the fast-track delivery of the sales center, managing interfaces between design, procurement, approvals and construction to achieve an accelerated programme and then the delivery of several high-end residential apartment buildings.
  
• Developing and maintaining the project execution plan, master programme, risk register, governance structure and project reporting requirements.
  
• Managing procurement strategy and contractor appointment activities, ensuring appropriate consideration of packaging, sequencing, programme and project risk.
  
• Transitioning the project effectively from pre-contract into construction and maintaining continuity of project leadership throughout delivery.
  
• Managing consultants, contractors and specialist suppliers while driving accountability against programme, cost, quality and contractual requirements.
  
• Monitoring project performance, identifying emerging risks and implementing recovery or mitigation measures where required.
  
• Providing clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders on programme, design, commercial matters, risks, decisions and delivery status.
  
• Maintaining stakeholder relationships and creating strong collaboration between development, design, commercial, procurement and construction teams.
  
• Maintaining strong project management discipline throughout delivery while ensuring Mace's safety, quality, and governance requirements are achieved.

**You’ll need to have:**
  
• Relevant project management and construction industry experience, with significant experience in senior project leadership positions.
  
• Demonstrable experience successfully delivering large-scale new-build residential developments of comparable size and complexity, ideally more than one major residential project.
  
• Strong evidence of managing residential projects across the complete lifecycle from early design/pre-contract through procurement, construction, and handover.
  
• Significant front-end and design management experience, with the ability to establish control of complex design programmes and drive multidisciplinary design teams against demanding milestones.
  
• Strong understanding of residential development requirements and the relationship between development strategy, design, sales and marketing milestones, procurement and physical delivery.
  
• Proven ability to manage and coordinate with architects, designers, engineering consultants, cost consultants, contractors and specialist stakeholders within complex project environments.
  
• Strong programme management skills with experience identifying programme risk, challenging consultant performance and implementing recovery strategies.
  
• Demonstrable procurement, contract, commercial, risk and change-management experience.
  
• Strong client-facing and senior stakeholder-management capability, including the confidence to operate effectively within a high-profile project subject to significant executive scrutiny.
  
• Experience delivering major projects within a PMC, client-side or development-management environment.
  
• A degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, project management or a related discipline.
  
• Professional membership such as RICS, CIOB, APM or equivalent would be advantageous, consistent with Mace's established SPM criteria.
  
• Previous experience delivering major residential developments in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East would be advantageous.

  

**Our values**

**Safety first - Going home safe and well:** We champion a safe, diverse and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of wellbeing in every team.

**Client focus - Deliver on our promise:** We own the quality of deliverables, strategic outcomes and build long term relationships with our clients.

**Integrity - Always do the right thing:** We influence positive outcomes within our industry, while always aligning with our compliance obligations.

**Create opportunity - For our people to excel**: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.

  

Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfil all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.

We are also open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.

Title: Manager, Care Operations
Description:
**Overview**
Tonal Care runs seven days a week across an in-house Toronto team and an outsourced partner operation. The Manager, Care Operations owns how that operation performs day to day.
  
  
You will own daily delivery across all tiers, the operational relationship with our outsourced partner, and the staffing and capacity plans that keep service levels intact. You will lead a Team Lead and a team of Customer Experience Specialists, each of whom owns one or two lines of business, and you will work the queue yourself when coverage requires it.
  
  
This is a hands-on, player/coach, operating role. You set the standard, work within it, and hold the operation to it.
  
  
What You Will Do
  
  
Daily Delivery
  
  

* Act as a player-coach during the initial phase, spending dedicated time working directly in the queue alongside specialists to model best practices, coach in real time, and establish baseline workflows
* Own daily delivery across all tiers, setting service levels, coverage models, and workflow standards that hold consistent delivery across phone, email, chat, and video.
* Own the daily, weekly, and monthly plans for SLA, CSAT, Average Handle Time, and First Contact Resolution, and be accountable for hitting them.
* Identify performance trends, operational risks, and root causes, and build the action plans that close the gap.
* Lead regular performance reviews and operational business reviews with internal stakeholders and partner leadership.
* Support incident and volume management during elevated contact periods, product issues, launches, and other business disruptions.
* Work the queue yourself when coverage requires it — absences, PTO, peak volume, or an uncovered line of business. You are the final backstop on coverage.
* Translate operational data into clear insights and recommendations for Care leadership.

Outsourced Partner Performance
  
  

* Serve as the day-to-day operational point of contact for Tonal’s outsourced partner, managing performance through their team leads and supervisors.
* Hold partner leadership accountable to agreed KPIs, SLAs, quality standards, staffing commitments, and Tonal’s brand voice.
* Run weekly performance reviews with partner teams.
* Report weekly to our Logistics, Field Operations, and Care Leadership team across all Care Operations metrics.
* Partner with their leadership on performance improvement plans, staffing strategies, coaching opportunities, and operational readiness.
* Monitor partner staffing, attrition, attendance, and utilization to catch capacity risk before it reaches Members.
* Make sure partner teams are aligned to Tonal policies, workflows, and operating standards, and are prepared for new programs, product changes, and launches.
* Escalate to the Senior Manager, Care Operations when partner performance issues cannot be resolved at the working level. Contract terms, rates, and renewals sit with the Director of Care Operations.

Staffing and Capacity
  
  

* Own workforce planning with partner Workforce Management and Tonal analytics, setting capacity and staffing models against forecast demand and adjusting intraday to protect service levels.
* Plan coverage across the full seven-day operating window, including weekends, holidays, and peak periods.
* Own the volume, staffing, and partner utilization assumptions that feed Care’s operating budget.
* Monitor forecast accuracy and adjust staffing assumptions based on actual contact volume, productivity, shrinkage, and service-level performance.
* Ensure schedules keep the teams at a sustainable working load rather than at full utilization, so there is room to absorb spikes and absences.

Team Leadership
  
  

* Lead and develop the team through the Team Lead and senior specialists, owning performance calibration, coaching, career development, and coverage planning.
* Make sure every line of business has a named owner, that the assignment is understood, and that owners are held to how their domain performs.
* Be accountable for the escalations programme. Specialists and the Team Lead resolve individual escalations; you own how the programme performs and where it needs to change.
* Sit in the health, safety, and legal escalation chain: Specialist → Team Lead → Manager, Care Operations → Senior Manager, Care Operations → Director, Care Operations.
* Ensure clear ownership and communication on sensitive, complex, or high-risk Member situations.
* Monitor escalation trends to surface recurring Member pain points, and work with the frontline to reduce avoidable escalations and lift first contact resolution.

Process and Partnership
  
  

* Translate the operating plan set with the Senior Manager, Care Operations into daily execution, and own that execution.
* Work with the Care Enablement team to identify knowledge gaps and roll out new troubleshooting SOPs, training, and tool updates to the front line.
* Coordinate with Logistics and Field Operations to deliver a seamless end-to-end experience for both specialists and Members.
* Simplify workflows to reduce Member effort, improve specialist efficiency, and remove unnecessary operational friction.
* Represent Care Operations in cross-functional initiatives and launches, and support the rollout and adoption of new tools, processes, and support programs.

Coverage and Schedule
  
  
Tonal Care operates seven days a week, 9:00 AM to 10:00 PM EST. This is a hands-on leadership role and the coverage expectations come with it:
  
  

* You and your team may be required to work weekends, holidays, and after hours as coverage requires. You and your team’s schedule will shift with the needs of the operation.
* Your team will carry on-call responsibility for incidents, outages, product issues, and elevated volume periods.
* Priorities change during the day. Peak season, launches, and product escalations will change what a day looks like.

Who You Are
  
  

* You have 5+ years of experience in Customer Care, Customer Support, or Contact Center Operations, including 2+ years leading teams, vendors, or outsourced operations.
* You are operationally minded and move comfortably between the operating plan and the queue. You set the standard, then hold the operation to it.
* You have managed operational KPIs and used data to find and fix performance problems. You don’t just report numbers — you understand the why behind them and change process, staffing, or enablement to move the trend.
* You are an empathetic coach who knows how to motivate a team and can turn complex data into feedback a specialist can act on.
* You have handled complex escalations and high-impact customer situations, and you are comfortable navigating gray areas and making quick, sound decisions when they arise.
* You have strong vendor and stakeholder management skills, and can influence partners who don’t report to you.
* You are technically savvy and proficient in CRM and support tooling, with an understanding of how backend systems shape the frontline experience.
* You prioritize influence over authority, earning the trust of your team and stakeholders to drive results through collaboration rather than mandate.
* You are comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with changing priorities and evolving processes.

Why You Will Love Working at Tonal
  
  

* You will own the operating model for a Care organization that is scaling across channels and lines of business
* Competitive compensation package, benefits, and Tonal product perks
* Collaborative, mission-driven team with a passion for redefining strength training

At Tonal, we believe that the unique and varied lived experiences of our teammates contribute to our overall strength. We don’t just appreciate differences, we celebrate them, and we always seek people that represent a wide variety of backgrounds. We’re dedicated to adding new perspectives to the team and designing employee experiences that contribute to your growth as much as you do to ours. If your experience aligns with what we’re looking for (even if you don’t check every single box), send us your application. We would love to hear from you!
  
  
Tonal is committed to meeting the diverse needs of people with disabilities in a timely manner that is consistent with the principles of independence, dignity, integration, and equality of opportunity. Should you have any accommodation requests, please reach out to us via our confidential email, accessibility@tonal.com. All requests will be addressed and responded to in accordance with Tonal’s Accessibility Policy and local legislation.
  
  
Compensation Range: CA$95K - CA$120K

Title: Director of IT
Description:

We challenge each other and ourselves to achieve at the highest level while contributing to the mission of the College and the betterment of Philadelphia. Join us and become a part of a community that has long been and will continue to be generators of generational chance in this city and beyond.
  
  
Community College of Philadelphia is an open-admission, associate-degree-granting institution which provides access to higher education for all who may benefit. Its programs of study in the liberal arts and sciences, career technologies, and basic academic skills provide a coherent foundation for college transfer, employment and lifelong learning. The College serves Philadelphia by preparing its students to be informed and concerned citizens, active participants in the cultural life of the city, and enabled to meet the changing needs of business, industry and the professions. To help address broad economic, cultural and political concerns in the city and beyond, the College draws together students from a wide range of ages and backgrounds and seeks to provide the programs and support they need to achieve their goals.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Director, Information Technology Support, provides strategic and operational leadership for the planning, delivery, and continuous improvement of the College's technology infrastructure, support services, telecommunications and enterprise technology operations. In partnership with the Associate Vice President of Information Technology Services and other College leaders, the Director advances institutional goals through effective technology planning, cybersecurity governance, compliance, business continuity, vendor management and the implementation of innovative technology services and solutions. The Director leads and develops technical support staff, manages operational and capital resources, and promotes culture of collaboration, accountability, and exceptional customer service. By aligning technology services with the College's academic and administrative priorities, the Director ensures secure, reliable, and cost effective technology solutions that support student success, employee productivity, institutional effectiveness.
  
  
**Essential Responsibilities**

* Responsible for providing day-to-day planning, management, and administration of the College's Information Technology Support solutions; this includes research and development of proposed campus solutions, technical delivery, contract compliance, and effective resource management.
* Monitor and support institutional cybersecurity initiatives including risk management, vulnerability remediation, endpoint protection, access management, security awareness training, incident response and business continuity coordination efforts, and compliance with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Provide strategic oversight of cloud-based technologies, enterprise applications, collaboration platforms, and software-as-a-service solutions to ensure security, reliability, scalability, and operational effectiveness.
* Establish, monitor, and continuously improve IT service management processes, service level objectives, operational metrics, and customer experience initiatives utilizing industry best practices.
* Collaborate with institutional leadership to support compliance with applicable federal, state, and industry requirements including FERPA, GLBA, ADA accessibility standards, cybersecurity regulations, and College policies.
* Develop and monitor key performance indicators, operational dashboards, and service metrics t measure effectiveness, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.
* Evaluate emerging technologies including artificial intelligence, automation, analytics, and digital service innovations for their potential to improve institutional effectiveness, enhance IT services, and reduce operational costs.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, and College management, develop and review all RFPs for the procurement of hardware and software for technology initiatives College-wide; assist in implementing the initiatives contained in the Technology Plan specific to the Technical Support Services area to enhance institutional effectiveness and cost efficiencies.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS assists in developing and administering ITS division processes and procedures, and disaster recovery and business continuity plans.
* Provide leadership, coordination, planning, and integrative management of the College-wide voice and data communications systems, telecommunications administration and support, and network/database administration; ensure that the voice and data infrastructure meets reliability and availability standards as stated in the College’s Technology Plan.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, review, recommend, and implement policies, standards, and guidelines within the area of responsibility including classroom technology delivery and support.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop, review and monitor contracts, consultants and relationships with Technical Support Services related vendors within the ITS division.
* Manage projects assigned by AVP of ITS by providing advice, guidance and problem-solving; coordinate with division managers, and direct and monitor the work of project teams to ensure project deliverables and timelines are met.
* Direct operations for Technical Support Services by executing production tasks according to a documented schedule that meets or exceeds customer expectations.
* Convey technology options and solution recommendations to AVP of ITS in support of ITS planning and development.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS and the Director of ERP, develop customer service initiatives based upon analysis of end user feedback data. Make recommendations for continuous improvement.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, develop and manage operating and capital budget related to Technical Support services to support goals, functions, programs, and services.
* Coordinate with the College purchasing department on technology procurements; oversee lease replacement and maintenance schedules for asset management; monitor contracts, consultants, and relationships with vendors as related to Technical Support services.
* Provide strategic leadership, coaching, mentoring, accountability, and professional development opportunities for assigned staff while fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, customer service excellence, continuous improvement, and operational effectiveness.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, participate in the selection, evaluation and discipline of subordinate staff; establish and assign staff workload and projects, develop and monitor performance standards, conduct training and evaluate performance.
* In collaboration with the AVP of ITS, monitor new technologies and assess their potential for solving College-wide initiatives and/or delivery of new services.
* Deliver quality customer services to both internal and external constituents in a professional, helpful, and courteous manner.
* Participate in college-wide committees as directed by the AVP of ITS.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree required in Information Technology, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Business Administration, or related field. Master's degree preferred.
* Minimum seven (7) years of progressively responsible information technology leadership experience.
* Minimum five (5) years of supervisory or management experience leading technical teams.
* Experience in higher education, public sector, or similarly complex organizations preferred.
* Experience managing enterprise infrastructure, cloud technologies, cybersecurity programs, technology support, ITSM services, and vendor relationships preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge and experience in creating and monitoring formal project plans required.
* Required skills and certifications: Microsoft 365 Administrator Expert, CCNA or equivalent
* The ability to meet deadlines and manage multiple and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment is required.
* Demonstrated ability to exercise good judgment in evaluating situations and making assessments for required decisions.
* Strong orientation to planning, customer service, assertive decision-making, and reconciling conflicting needs is required.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills and the ability to manage a full scope of services in a unionized environment are required.
* Demonstrated experience in dealing with issues that affect operations, policy, funding, and budgets in a mid-to-large organization is required.

Title: Deputy Director of Communications
Description:
**About the Organization:**

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation (OCABR) is a state agency within the Executive Office of Economic Development and is responsible for protecting consumers through advocacy and education. The Office of Consumer Affairs works to ensure that the businesses our agencies regulate treat all Massachusetts consumers fairly. The Division of Banks ("DOB"), Division of Insurance ("DOI"), Division of Occupational Licensure ("DOL"), Division of Standards ("DOS"), and Department of Telecommunications and Cable ("DTC") all fall under the OCABR umbrella and help us to fulfill our critical mission of building better businesses and smarter consumers.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to creating and sustaining a work culture that is welcoming, inclusive, and mutually respectful to all its employees regardless of race, color, age, creed, religion, national origin, ethnicity, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, genetic information, veteran or disability status. We strive to reflect diversity in all facets and levels of our agency. The Office or Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation values inclusiveness and diversity within their employee and management teams. Within our community we strive to create and maintain working and learning environments that are inclusive, equitable, and welcoming.

The Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation is committed to ensuring a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel respected, valued, and empowered to maximize their skills and talents to serve our citizens.

**About the Role:**

The Deputy Director of Communications serves in a senior strategic communications and policy advisory capacity within the Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation, providing leadership in the formulation, development, evaluation, and implementation of agency-wide communications policies, strategic initiatives, and organizational priorities across OCABR and its five component agencies. Working in close collaboration with the Director of Communications, Undersecretary, Deputy Undersecretary, and agency leadership, the Deputy Director exercises substantial independent judgment and participates meaningfully in executive-level policy development and strategic decision-making to advance the mission and priorities of OCABR, the Executive Office, and the Governor's Office.

The Deputy Director participates substantially in the development and evaluation of agency policies, strategic goals, and major program initiatives, providing substantive analysis and recommendations that inform executive leadership decisions. The position independently evaluates proposed policies and initiatives, identifies communications implications, public engagement considerations, and potential policy concerns, and recommends modifications that support agency objectives and organizational priorities. The Deputy Director represents the communications function in executive-level policy discussions and serves as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on matters involving public policy, regulatory initiatives, consumer protection, licensing programs, legislative developments, and other issues affecting OCABR and its component agencies.

The Deputy Director develops and directs comprehensive communications strategies and initiatives, including media relations, digital communications, agency websites, social media, public information campaigns, executive messaging, visual communications, and performance evaluation. The position exercises independent judgment in establishing communications priorities, developing messaging strategies, and advising executive leadership on sensitive or high-profile matters. Responsibilities include directing the development and review of official agency communications, executive briefings, policy statements, speeches, talking points, press releases, consumer alerts, public guidance, and educational materials to ensure consistency with agency policies, strategic objectives, and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.

The position manages and coordinates communications efforts including the OCABR and agency websites, social media accounts, media inquiries, press outreach, educational content, videos, event presentations, and executive briefing materials.

The Deputy Director assists with the annual communications plan, supports leadership and agencies with consumer alerts, guidance, and policy briefs, and helps manage all internal and public communications related to policies, regulations, legislative matters, legal issues, consumer protection and licensing programs, visual communication, and branding.

The Deputy Director provides strategic oversight of media relations activities and coordinates responses to complex or sensitive press inquiries and public records requests in consultation with OCABR leadership, legal counsel, and designated records custodians. The position evaluates communications risks, recommends appropriate agency responses, and advises executive leadership on matters affecting public messaging and agency policy. In coordination with legal counsel and appropriate program personnel, the Deputy Director reviews sensitive information and provides recommendations concerning disclosure considerations and potential redactions, consistent with applicable public records laws and agency procedures.

The Deputy Director develops and directs strategic public engagement and outreach initiatives in collaboration with the Community Outreach Supervisor, Director of Communications, and agency leadership. The position participates in establishing outreach priorities, developing stakeholder engagement strategies, and directing communications activities associated with executive events, public forums, webinars, and other agency initiatives. The Deputy Director advises executive leadership on opportunities to advance agency policy objectives through public engagement and evaluates the effectiveness of outreach strategies to recommend improvements to agency-wide communications and engagement priorities.

The Deputy Director, working with Community Outreach Supervisor, additionally advises on community outreach planning and execution and the preparation of all materials used in community outreach activities; the Deputy Director will regularly attend community outreach events and coordinate participation of agencies comprising the Office.

The Deputy Director serves as the designated acting representative for the Director of Communications when assigned, assuming delegated strategic, operational, and decision-making responsibilities necessary to maintain continuity of the communications function. The position provides direction and oversight to communications co-ops and interns, including assigning work, establishing priorities, monitoring performance, and coordinating daily activities, consistent with delegated supervisory authority. In carrying out these responsibilities, the Deputy Director routinely handles sensitive, privileged, or otherwise protected information and exercises discretion in safeguarding such materials in accordance with applicable laws and agency policies.

The Deputy Director performs other related duties as assigned, consistent with the position's responsibilities and delegated authority.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* **Strategic Communications and Agency-Wide Policy Development:** Develop, establish, and direct agency-wide strategic communications policies, priorities, and initiatives for the Office of Consumer Affairs and Business Regulation. Exercise substantial independent judgment and decision-making authority in formulating communications strategies, determining messaging priorities, and establishing standards governing media relations, social media, website content and improvements, visual communications, and performance analytics. Direct the development and implementation of major communications initiatives to advance OCABR's mission, ensure consistency with agency policy objectives, and maintain compliance with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Serve as a strategic advisor to executive leadership on communications policy, emerging issues, reputational considerations, and public engagement priorities.
* **Executive Policy Development and Strategic Communications:** Participate substantially in the formulation, development, and establishment of agency-wide policies, strategic goals, and organizational objectives in collaboration with the Director of Communications, Undersecretary, and Deputy Undersecretary, ensuring alignment with the priorities and policy directives of the Executive Office and Governor's Office. Exercise independent judgment in evaluating policy initiatives, advising executive leadership on strategic communications considerations, and developing agency-wide communications strategies that advance established policy objectives. Direct and oversee the development of executive communications, including policy statements, speeches, remarks, talking points, video scripts, public outreach plans, press releases, and other official communications, ensuring consistency with agency priorities and applicable statutory and regulatory requirements. Represent the communications function in executive-level, programmatic, and legal policy discussions, providing substantive recommendations that influence agency policy development, implementation strategies, and public communications priorities.
* **Strategic Media Relations, Public Records, and Executive Advisory Responsibilities:** Develop, establish, and direct strategic media relations initiatives, policies, and protocols in coordination with OCABR executive leadership, agency leadership, and legal counsel. Exercise substantial independent judgment in evaluating and managing high-profile, sensitive, and complex media inquiries, determining appropriate communications strategies, and advising executive leadership on matters affecting agency policy, public messaging, and reputational considerations. Oversee the coordination and preparation of official media responses and public records requests (PRRs) originating from media organizations, collaborating with legal counsel and relevant program areas to ensure compliance with applicable public records laws, confidentiality requirements, and agency policies. Evaluate sensitive records and recommend appropriate disclosure and redaction considerations in consultation with legal counsel and designated records custodians. Establish media engagement priorities, direct proactive and responsive press activities, monitor emerging media issues, and provide strategic recommendations to executive leadership regarding communications risks, policy implications, and agency responses.
* **Strategic Public Engagement, Executive Events, and Outreach Policy:** Develop, establish, and direct strategic agency-wide public engagement, outreach, and executive event initiatives in collaboration with the Director of Communications, Community Outreach Supervisor, Undersecretary, Deputy Undersecretary, and Commissioners. Exercise substantial independent judgment in establishing event priorities, developing strategic outreach objectives, and determining communications approaches that advance OCABR's policy goals and organizational mission. Advise executive leadership on public engagement strategies, emerging policy issues, and opportunities to strengthen stakeholder relationships and advance agency initiatives. Direct the planning, development, and execution of high-profile in-person and virtual events, including executive briefings, public forums, webinars, and stakeholder engagement activities. Oversee the preparation of policy research, executive briefing materials, event messaging, promotional strategies, and logistical coordination to ensure alignment with agency-wide policy priorities. Collaborate with executive leadership and program administrators to evaluate outreach effectiveness and recommend strategic adjustments to agency engagement policies and priorities.
* **Agency Policy Formulation, Strategic Analysis, and Executive Decision Support:** Participate substantially in the formulation, evaluation, and development of agency-wide policies, strategic initiatives, and major programs, exercising independent judgment and providing substantive recommendations that influence executive-level policy decisions. Serve as a strategic communications advisor to OCABR executive leadership, contributing to the development and refinement of agency policies, organizational priorities, and major program initiatives to ensure alignment with the agency's mission and the policy objectives of the Executive Office and Governor's Office. Independently evaluate proposed policies, programs, and strategic initiatives; identify communications implications, potential policy concerns, and opportunities for improvement; and recommend substantive modifications that advance agency objectives and inform executive decision-making. Participate in high-level policy and strategic planning discussions, providing expert analysis and recommendations that contribute to the establishment and implementation of agency-wide priorities. Direct the development, review, and refinement of policy briefs, executive communications, public statements, and related materials to ensure consistency with established policy objectives, statutory and regulatory requirements, and executive priorities.

**Preferred Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Outstanding writing and editing skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to write under tight deadlines.
* Ability to analyze and interpret complex public policies, legislative developments, regulatory matters, and government programs and translate them into clear, accessible public communications.
