Title: Director of Service Desk Support
Description:
**Director of Service Desk**

**Location:**
Chandler, AZ (onsite, 5 days per week)

Our client, a company with a global footprint and multiple locations, is seeking a high-energy Director of Service Desk to lead end-user support across all of its locations and provide best-in-class employee support experience.

**The Opportunity**

This is a player-coach role for a strategic service desk/support leader who wants to build something. You will set the vision for service desk and end-user computing company-wide, lead a team of site Service Desk Managers, and partner closely with Infrastructure. Your signature initiative will be launching walk-up IT hot spots (tech bars) at every location so employees can get fast, in-person help. And when a site gets busy, you will be the leader who steps behind the counter and works tickets alongside the team.

**What You Will Do**

* Define and execute the strategy and roadmap for service desk and end-user computing across multiple sites.
* Lead, mentor and develop Service Desk Managers, driving consistent standards at every location.
* Design, launch and scale walk-up IT hot spots company-wide, including the service model, staffing and success metrics.
* Own ITSM processes aligned to ITIL, including incident, request, problem, change and knowledge management.
* Establish and report on SLAs, resolution times, first-contact resolution and employee satisfaction.
* Partner with Infrastructure, Networking and Security on cross-functional issues and projects.
* Stay hands-on: work tickets at any site when needed and serve as the senior escalation point, including executive support.
* Lead deployments, hardware refreshes, migrations and new site support; manage budget, vendors and assets for end-user computing.

**What You Bring**

* **10+ years in IT service desk or end-user support, including 5+ years managing service desk teams.**
* Proven experience leading service desk operations across multiple sites and locations, including managing managers.
* Strong working knowledge of ITSM and ITIL.
* A track record of improving service metrics and the end-user experience.
* Hands-on familiarity with Intune/MDM, Active Directory, Office 365, Exchange, Teams, PowerShell, and Windows and macOS.
* Enterprise ITSM platform experience; ServiceNow is a plus.
* Experience building or running walk-up tech bars is strongly preferred.
* Multi site location experience and global support would be a big plus here
* High energy, a strong service mindset and excellent communication skills from the help desk floor to the executive suite.

Work Environment

Onsite in Chandler, AZ five days per week, with periodic travel to other company locations. Occasional evening or weekend work may be required for maintenance and site projects.

Title: IT Support Director
Description:
The Director of IT Disaster Recovery and Support provides enterprise leadership for the resilience, compliance, and operational readiness of Medisys Health Network’s IT environment. Reporting to the CIO, this role sets the strategic direction for disaster recovery, emergency management, and business impact analysis, while leading Technical Support and Data Center operations to ensure continuity of critical services.

**Job Role and Responsibilities:**

**Disaster Recovery Planning**

Planning:

* Provides enterprise leadership for IT risk management, business continuity, and disaster recovery strategy to safeguard the integrity, availability, and security of organizational systems and data.
* Establishes disaster recovery and business resumption strategies for mission-critical processes and systems to sustain operations during significant disruptions.
* Ensures continuity plans are rigorously tested, documented, governed, and continuously improved to support timely response and recovery.
* Cultivates strategic relationships and external partnerships that strengthen disaster recovery capabilities and response readiness.

Recovery Operation:

* Directs the Command Center and Disaster Recovery team during incident response and recovery operations.
* Leads enterprise damage assessment efforts to inform response priorities and recovery planning.
* Identifies internal and external recovery contacts and contractors.
* Defines the scope of repair work.
* Develops site-specific repair plans and schedules.
* Oversees the restoration of critical operations in alignment with business priorities and recovery objectives.
* Implements mitigation measures.
* Drives post-incident review and integrates lessons learned into future recovery planning and organizational preparedness.

**Emergency Management**

* Provides strategic oversight for the design, implementation, and governance of enterprise emergency management programs and plans.
* Builds strong cross-functional partnerships to enable coordinated and effective organizational response during emergencies.
* Leads executive and stakeholder communications during unplanned IT/EHR downtime events, including after-hours incidents.

**IT Technical Support, including Desktop and Phone Support**

* Provides operational leadership for technical support services, ensuring performance against service levels, budget targets, and business expectations.
* Drives continuous improvement in customer support through performance oversight of ticketing, call volume, responsiveness, and service quality.
* Ensures physical inventory is monitored and replenished as needed.

**Data Center**

* Leads the Data Center function responsible for the performance, reliability, and maintenance of servers, network infrastructure, and critical hardware.
* Anticipates infrastructure growth requirements and implements scalable solutions to support long-term operational needs.

**Business Impact Analysis**

* Leads the ongoing review and refinement of the Business Impact Analysis to align recovery requirements with enterprise risk priorities.
* Documents issues and lessons learned from business disruptions and tracks progress on open items.
* Evaluates the operational impact of business process disruptions and informs the development of effective recovery strategies.
* Identifies potential loss scenarios during risk assessments.
* Identifies and evaluates the impact of disasters.
* Informs investment decisions related to recovery, prevention, and mitigation initiatives across the enterprise.

**Qualifications**

* Executive-level communication, documentation, and presentation skills, with the ability to develop clear reporting, dashboards, and supporting materials.
* Demonstrated leadership in guiding teams, influencing technical direction, and managing complex initiatives across multiple priorities.
* Deep understanding of backup and recovery strategies, including synchronous and asynchronous replication, SAN technologies, and database replication.
* Track record of advancing IT processes, tools, and service delivery capabilities.
* Experience administering Epic applications is a plus.
* Ability to coordinate internal and external documentation and installations.
* Ability to work independently and collaborate professionally and courteously with colleagues.
* Knowledge of HIPAA, ISO, and continuous quality improvement principles is strongly preferred.
* Willingness to take on new responsibilities as department needs evolve.
* Ability to respond outside standard business hours when needed.

**Work location**

Work arrangement: Hybrid, with three days onsite and two days remote each week. The first 90 days require full onsite presence.

Work site: This role is based in Garden City, NY, and Jamaica Hospital Medical Center.

Title: Director, Global End User Compute
Description:
Sandisk understands how people and businesses consume data and we relentlessly innovate to deliver solutions that enable today’s needs and tomorrow’s next big ideas. With a rich history of groundbreaking innovations in Flash and advanced memory technologies, our solutions have become the beating heart of the digital world we’re living in and that we have the power to shape.
  
  
Sandisk meets people and businesses at the intersection of their aspirations and the moment, enabling them to keep moving and pushing possibility forward. We do this through the balance of our powerhouse manufacturing capabilities and our industry-leading portfolio of products that are recognized globally for innovation, performance and quality.
  
  
Sandisk has two facilities recognized by the World Economic Forum as part of the Global Lighthouse Network for advanced 4IR innovations. These facilities were also recognized as Sustainability Lighthouses for breakthroughs in efficient operations. With our global reach, we ensure the global supply chain has access to the Flash memory it needs to keep our world moving forward.
  
  
**Description**
**Job Summary:**
The Director, Global End User Compute (EUC) is responsible for the strategy, architecture, delivery, security, and operational performance of end-user technology services across the global enterprise. Reporting within the CISO organization, this role provides leadership for the technologies and services that enable employees to securely and effectively access corporate systems, applications, collaboration platforms, and workplace technology.
  
  
The Director will lead a global End User Compute organization responsible for desktop and endpoint support, laptops and workstations, mobile devices, Microsoft Intune and endpoint management, software distribution, device lifecycle management, audiovisual and conference room technologies, executive technology support, and related employee-facing IT services.
  
  
This role requires a strong combination of technical depth, operational leadership, cybersecurity awareness, and people management. The Director will establish global standards while ensuring EUC services remain responsive to regional business requirements and deliver a consistent, secure, and high-quality employee experience.
  
  
Operating in a fast-paced global technology environment, the Director will partner closely with Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Network, Service Desk, Identity and Access Management, Enterprise Applications, Facilities, Human Resources, and business leaders to modernize the digital workplace and improve the overall end-user technology experience.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Global End User Compute Strategy & Leadership**

* Develop and execute the global End User Compute strategy, roadmap, operating model, and technology standards aligned with business, IT, and cybersecurity objectives.
* Provide global leadership for employee-facing technology services across corporate offices, remote workers, engineering environments, and other business locations.
* Establish consistent EUC standards, processes, service levels, performance metrics, and support models across geographic regions.
* Lead, develop, and mentor a geographically distributed team of managers, engineers, administrators, and support professionals.
* Balance operational stability with modernization, automation, security, and continuous improvement.
* Develop annual operating plans, budgets, resource requirements, technology roadmaps, and investment recommendations for EUC services.
* Establish measurable KPIs covering employee experience, device health, incident resolution, service availability, security compliance, and operational efficiency.

**Desktop & Endpoint Support**

* Own the global desktop and endpoint support model for Windows and macOS laptops, desktops, workstations, peripherals, and related employee technology.
* Establish standardized processes for device provisioning, configuration, deployment, support, replacement, refresh, and retirement.
* Drive improvements in first-contact resolution, mean time to resolution, endpoint reliability, and employee satisfaction.
* Define tiered escalation processes between Service Desk, desktop support, engineering, infrastructure, application, and cybersecurity teams.
* Establish specialized support models for executives, critical business functions, engineering teams, and other high-priority users where appropriate.
* Ensure endpoint support capabilities effectively support office-based, hybrid, and remote employees globally.

**Endpoint Engineering & Microsoft Intune**

* Provide technical and operational leadership for Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management across the enterprise.
* Own endpoint configuration standards, compliance policies, security baselines, application deployment, device enrollment, configuration profiles, and lifecycle management.
* Partner with Cybersecurity to implement and maintain endpoint security controls, hardening standards, encryption, endpoint detection and response, vulnerability remediation, and compliance requirements.
* Drive adoption of zero-touch and automated provisioning technologies, including Windows Autopilot and modern device enrollment capabilities.
* Oversee operating system deployment, patching, application packaging, software distribution, configuration management, and endpoint remediation.
* Develop an endpoint engineering roadmap that reduces manual administration and increases automation, self-service, security, and consistency.
* Maintain accurate endpoint inventory, ownership, configuration, compliance, and lifecycle

**Mobile Device Management**

* Own the global strategy and operational management of corporate and authorized personal mobile devices.
* Establish standards for iOS, Android, smartphones, tablets, and other mobile endpoints.
* Manage mobile device enrollment, application deployment, configuration, security policies, compliance, remote wipe, and device lifecycle through Intune and related platforms.
* Partner with Procurement and telecommunications providers on mobile device purchasing, carrier management, international services, and cost optimization.
* Define and maintain appropriate corporate-owned, BYOD, and mobile application management policies.
* Ensure mobile access to corporate information meets cybersecurity, privacy, legal, and regulatory requirements.

**Audiovisual & Conference Room Technology**

* Own the global standards and operational support model for conference rooms, meeting spaces, collaboration rooms, executive meeting rooms, and audiovisual technologies.
* Establish standards for Microsoft Teams Rooms and other approved conferencing and collaboration platforms.
* Oversee conference room displays, cameras, microphones, speakers, control systems, room scheduling technologies, and related infrastructure.
* Partner with Facilities and Network teams on new office construction, office expansions, relocations, and conference room deployments.
* Establish proactive monitoring and maintenance capabilities to identify and remediate conference room technology issues before they impact meetings.
* Maintain standardized room designs and technology configurations to provide a consistent employee experience across global offices.
* Develop lifecycle and refresh strategies for audiovisual and collaboration technologies.

**Employee Digital Experience**

* Champion the overall digital employee experience, ensuring technology is reliable, intuitive, secure, and easy to access.
* Establish mechanisms to measure employee satisfaction and identify recurring technology friction points.
* Use endpoint analytics, service management data, incident trends, employee feedback, and device telemetry to proactively improve EUC services.
* Expand employee self-service and automated remediation capabilities to reduce support dependency and improve resolution times.
* Identify opportunities to use automation, AI, analytics, and emerging technologies to improve support delivery and employee productivity.

**Security, Risk & Compliance**

* Partner closely with the CISO organization to ensure endpoint technologies comply with enterprise cybersecurity policies and standards.
* Ensure endpoints meet requirements for encryption, endpoint protection, patching, vulnerability management, privileged access, data protection, device compliance, and secure configuration.
* Support cybersecurity incident response activities involving employee endpoints and mobile devices.
* Maintain appropriate logging, asset records, configuration documentation, and evidence required for internal and external audits.
* Partner with Governance, Risk, and Compliance teams to remediate endpoint-related findings and control deficiencies.
* Ensure lost, stolen, compromised, or non-compliant devices can be quickly identified, contained, disabled, or remotely wiped.
* Participate in technology risk assessments and establish remediation plans for identified EUC risks.

**Device Lifecycle & Asset Management**

* Establish global standards for end-user hardware selection, procurement, deployment, refresh, recovery, and secure disposal.
* Partner with Procurement and Finance to optimize hardware purchasing, warranty management, licensing, inventory, and lifecycle costs.
* Maintain accurate inventories of laptops, desktops, mobile devices, peripherals, and other EUC assets.
* Develop global device refresh standards based on age, performance, security requirements, business need, and total cost of ownership.
* Ensure secure data removal and environmentally responsible disposal of retired technology.
* Support employee onboarding, transfers, relocations, leaves, and offboarding through standardized technology lifecycle processes.

**Operational Management & Service Delivery**

* Establish and manage SLAs, OLAs, KPIs, service dashboards, and operational reviews for EUC services.
* Monitor incident volumes, recurring problems, aging tickets, device health, endpoint compliance, conference room availability, and employee satisfaction.
* Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action for significant or recurring end-user technology incidents.
* Participate in major incident management when endpoint or workplace technologies materially affect business operations.
* Establish capacity, continuity, and recovery plans for critical EUC technologies and services.
* Maintain current technical documentation, standards, operating procedures, support playbooks, and escalation processes.
* Drive a culture of ownership, urgency, accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement.

**Vendor, Financial & Technology Management**

* Manage strategic relationships with hardware manufacturers, software providers, mobile carriers, audiovisual vendors, managed service providers, and other EUC partners.
* Participate in contract negotiations, licensing reviews, renewals, technology evaluations, and vendor performance reviews.
* Develop and manage EUC operating and capital budgets.
* Identify opportunities to consolidate technologies, eliminate redundant tools, reduce costs, and improve operational efficiency.
* Evaluate emerging endpoint, workplace, collaboration, automation, and employee experience technologies and make recommendations for adoption.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting a large global technology, semiconductor, manufacturing, or engineering organization.
* Experience operating within or closely aligned to a CISO or cybersecurity organization.
* Experience with Microsoft security and management technologies including Intune, Entra ID, Defender, Microsoft 365, and related endpoint security capabilities.
* Experience implementing modern workplace, zero-touch deployment, digital employee experience, and endpoint automation strategies.
* Familiarity with ITIL or other formal IT service management frameworks.
* Experience with ServiceNow or comparable enterprise IT service management and asset management platforms.
* Relevant Microsoft, ITIL, security, or technology management certifications are preferred.

**Requirements**

* Demonstrated experience leading End User Compute, Workplace Technology, Desktop Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, or similar enterprise functions.
* Strong technical knowledge of Microsoft Intune, endpoint management, Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, Microsoft 365, Entra ID, and modern endpoint provisioning.
* Experience with Windows Autopilot, application packaging and deployment, patch management, endpoint configuration, device compliance, and software distribution.
* Strong understanding of endpoint security technologies and practices, including EDR, encryption, vulnerability management, hardening, privileged access, and zero-trust principles.
* Experience managing enterprise mobile device and mobile application management environments.
* Experience supporting and standardizing Microsoft Teams Rooms, audiovisual systems, conference room technologies, and enterprise collaboration platforms.
* Strong understanding of IT service management principles, incident management, problem management, change management, asset management, and service-level management.
* Experience managing large-scale hardware refreshes, technology migrations, office deployments, or global endpoint transformation initiatives.
* Demonstrated ability to manage technology vendors, contracts, budgets, licensing, and service providers.
* Strong analytical capabilities with experience using operational metrics and technology data to identify trends and drive improvements.
* Ability to communicate complex technical concepts effectively to both technical teams and senior business executives.
* Demonstrated ability to lead through organizational and technology change in a fast-paced, global enterprise environment.
* Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* 10+ years of progressive IT experience, including significant experience supporting enterprise end-user computing environments.
* 7+ years of leadership experience managing technical teams, preferably across multiple geographic regions.

Wilson Sonsini is the premier legal advisor to technology, life sciences, and other growth enterprises worldwide. We represent companies at every stage of development, from entrepreneurial start-ups to multibillion-dollar global corporations, as well as the venture firms, private equity firms, and investment banks that finance and advise them. The firm has approximately 1,100 attorneys in 17 offices: 13 in the U.S., two in China, and two in Europe. Our broad spectrum of practices and entrepreneurial spirit allow exceptional opportunities for professional achievement and career growth.

The Director of Support Services owns end-user support services for the firm, with direct accountability for the outsourced Service Desk, deskside support technicians across the firm’s 17 offices, the Technical Training group, and technical communications. This role is directly responsible for day-to-day support for all firm attorneys and business professionals, from first contact through resolution.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on support services leader who prioritizes the end user experience and knows how to run a high volume, multi-location support operation with discipline. This person combines strong operational leadership with a customer first mindset and excels at bringing resources together to execute shared goals. This leader will maintain a customer focused delivery approach, operate with urgency, and prioritize responsiveness, quality, and consistency of support across every office.

This position is available as hybrid or fully virtual work schedule.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

**Service Desk & Deskside Support Operations**

* Own day to day performance of the outsourced Service Desk, holding the vendor accountable to contracted SLAs, quality standards, and cost targets.
* Directly manage deskside support technicians across the firm’s 17 offices, ensuring consistent coverage, response times, and service quality regardless of location.
* Standardize support processes, ticket handling, and escalation paths across the Service Desk and deskside teams so attorneys and business professionals receive the same quality of support in every office.
* Use ticket data, reporting, and analytics to identify trends, reduce recurring issues, and drive support performance improvements.
* Serve as the executive escalation point for support issues that are not resolved at first or second tier, driving them to resolution quickly.

**Customer & Stakeholder Experience**

* Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with attorneys, business professionals, and internal stakeholders, serving as a primary point of escalation and advocacy for support services.
* Ensure high satisfaction with support services across the firm through proactive engagement, structured communication, and effective issue resolution.
* Act as the voice of the end user internally, translating recurring support issues into concrete service gaps and improvement opportunities.
* Oversee onboarding and technology enablement for new attorneys and business professionals so they are productive quickly.

**Technical Training & Communications**

* Direct the Technical Training group, ensuring training content and outputs are high quality, professional, polished, and keep pace with the firm’s technology needs.
* Experience owning a technical training function, including curriculum development, content design, and delivery methods (in person, virtual, self service).
* Responsible for the development and execution of comprehensive communication strategies and tactics to engage employees in support of business initiatives.
* Provide oversight of technical communications, ensuring outages, deployments, technical changes, and known issues are communicated clearly and include the necessary related materials.
* Partner with the Technical Training group to build resources that help fill gaps identified by Service Desk ticket trends.
* Experience partnering with practice groups or firm leadership to identify training priorities tied to new technology rollouts.

**Support Operations Governance**

* Drive compliance with internal governance models and quality standards across all support teams.
* Engage as a key stakeholder in the incident management process for support related outages affecting end users.
* Set staffing, scheduling, and coverage models across offices and time zones to match support demand, including peak periods, offsite events and after-hour needs.
* Benchmark support operations against industry standards and implement best practices into the firm’s support model.
* Demonstrated accountability for a support services budget, including vendor contracts, staffing costs, and tooling expenses.

**People Leadership**

* Hire, coach, and develop high performing support resources, fostering accountability and a continuous growth mindset across all teams.
* Establish group expectations, workload balance, and coverage across offices that sustain team optimization and reliability.
* Support talent development, succession planning, and effective workforce utilization across the support organization.
* Identify and address knowledge and skill gaps within the teams.
* Track record of setting team goals, performance standards, and accountability measures that improve service outcomes.

**Requirements**
----------------

* Must be self-driven with a natural tendency to take ownership and independently execute work to completion.
* Must have a positive can-do attitude and proactively engage with leadership as an advocate for end users.
* Proven experience directly managing multiple technical groups to produce exceptional support services across multiple locations and time zones.
* Strong command of support operations fundamentals, including SLA management, ticketing systems, escalation models, and staffing/coverage planning.
* Demonstrated success managing outsourced support vendors, including holding vendors accountable to contracted performance.
* Experience identifying technical support and training gaps and implementing user-facing solutions.
* Familiarity with AI enabled support tooling and a track record of driving automation adoption within a support function.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with experience communicating support performance to senior stakeholders.
* Strong leadership skills, including hiring, coaching, and performance management of support personnel.

**Education & Experience**
--------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree in information technology, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in end user support leadership, including managed services and geographically dispersed support teams.
* Experience with ServiceNow or equivalent ITSM platform.
* Experience in a law firm or professional services environment preferred.
* Track record of leading organizational change within a support or service delivery function.
* Familiarity with legal industry applications preferred.
* Accustomed to providing “white glove” support experience as standard practice.
ITIL certification, Lean Six Sigma or related certifications a plus.  

The primary location for this job posting is in Palo Alto, but other locations may be listed. The actual base pay offered will depend upon a variety of factors, including but not limited to the selected candidate’s qualifications, years of relevant experience, level of education, professional certifications and licenses, and work location. The anticipated pay range for this position is as follows:

Palo Alto, New York, San Francisco: $208,250 – $281,750 per year.
  
Austin, Boston, Boulder, Century City, Delaware, Los Angeles, Salt Lake City, San Diego, Seattle, Washington, D.C., and all other locations: $187,850 – $254,150 per year.

The compensation for this position may include a discretionary year-end merit bonus based on performance. We offer a highly competitive salary and benefits package.

**Strategy, Executive Leadership, and CIO Partnership**

* Serve as the CIO's designated operational leader and strategic partner for enterprise technology governance, service delivery, information security operations, portfolio performance, and vendor management activities.

Title: Senior Manager, Professional Services (US)
Description:
#### **About Us**

In a fast-paced global environment procurement can provide a real strategic challenge. At Keelvar we work hard on optimization and game theory, applying it to strategic sourcing. Keelvar was founded in Europe's largest AI research lab by a team of computer scientists and engineers specialising in AI. Powered by unique artificial intelligence, designed by our category experts, our mission is to help procurement teams globally to scale sourcing excellence. Keelvar is an award-winning, category leading, global sourcing optimization and autonomous sourcing vendor, optimising over $200bn+ in spend annually.

#### **Role Overview**

As Senior Manager, Professional Services, you will lead our US consulting and support team who own the quality, pace and commercial performance of everything we deliver for North American customers. Our consultants run complex sourcing events in Keelvar, build and tune automation for Autonomous Sourcing, and act as the sourcing expertise behind our customers' biggest category decisions. You will set how that work is scoped, staffed and delivered, and you will stay close enough to the work to be credible in a design session with a customer's sourcing leadership.  
  
This is a player-coach role. You will lead and develop a team of five consultants, and you will personally lead a share of our most strategic engagements. You will partner closely with Customer Success, Sales and Engineering, and you will have real influence over how our services offering grows as the business scales in the US.  
  
The role is fully remote but candidate must be located in the following states.  
Preferred locations: Florida, Georgia, Pennsylvania  
Additional locations considered: Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, North Carolina, Ohio, Texas, Virginia, California or Colorado.

#### **What the work looks like**

* Lead, coach and grow the US Professional Services team, owning hiring, onboarding,

development plans and performance for your consultants.  

* Own delivery quality across US engagements, from sourcing event design and

optimization scenario strategy through to award recommendations that customers act on.  

* Personally lead a selection of strategic and complex engagements, particularly new logos,

large multi-round events and first deployments of Autonomous Sourcing.  

* Scope and price services engagements, write statements of work, and help manage

utilization, margin and delivery forecasts for the US team.  

* Build repeatable delivery playbooks, templates and accelerators so that what we learn on

one engagement raises the quality of every engagement after it.  

* Act as the senior escalation point for US customers, diagnosing issues early and

resolving them before they reach the customer's leadership team.  

* Partner with Sales as the services expert in pre-sales conversations, shaping the delivery

approach and services component of new opportunities.  

* Work with Customer Success, support and Engineering to close the loop between what

customers need in delivery and what we build in the product.  

* Bring the voice of delivery into product planning, with clear evidence from engagements

about where the product should go next.Own US customer support and helpdesk: make  
sure tickets are triaged, worked and resolved within SLA, set clear support objectives for  
the team, and contribute hands-on to the queue when it matters.  

* Lead internal initiatives to improve how the PS function runs, including better dashboards

and reporting on delivery and support performance, and more automation of the repetitive  
work in our consulting and support processes.  

* Design and roll out AI-powered automation and tooling that helps our consultants and

support team work faster and to a higher standard, from event preparation and bid  
analysis to ticket triage and knowledge retrieval.  

* Track and report support performance (SLA attainment, ticket volumes, resolution times,

customer satisfaction), and use what the data shows to fix recurring issues at the root,  
whether in our process, our documentation or the product.

#### **What we are looking for**

* 5 to 8 years' experience across strategic sourcing, procurement consulting, supply chain

or enterprise software delivery, with time on both the consulting and the practitioner side.  

* Experience leading others, whether as a line manager or as the senior person

accountable for a team's delivery quality. This may be your first formal management role,  
and we'll support you into it.  

* Exposure to the commercial side of delivery: scoping engagements, writing statements of

work, or working to utilization and margin targets.  

* Deep hands-on familiarity with sourcing events: multi-round bidding, lotting, bid sheet

design, constraints and scenario analysis. You can design an event, not only manage a  
plan to run one.  

* Experience with sourcing or source-to-contract software, either as a vendor, an

implementation partner or an advanced in-house user.  

* A sound foundation in data analysis and comfort with the commercial logic behind an

award recommendation. Strong Excel skills including formulae and pivot tables.  

* Experience applying AI tools to real delivery work, and the judgment to know where

automation helps and where it does not.  

* You are a strong communicator who is credible with a Director or VP of Procurement, and

you thrive in an environment of mutual respect, openness and collaboration.  

* You are comfortable in a small, growing team where leaders still do the work. You enjoy

getting things done at a quick pace.  

* Experience running or contributing to a customer support or helpdesk function, including

working to SLAs, managing a ticket queue and using a tool such as Zendesk, Jira Service  
Management or similar.  

* Experience applying AI tools to real delivery or support work, and the judgment to know

where automation helps and where it does not. Experience building dashboards or  
automating workflows (for example with BI tools, scripting, low-code platforms or AI  
agents) is a strong plus.  

* You are a creative problem solver and enjoy a technical challenge.
* Willingness to travel to customer sites in North America on occasion.
* A bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, engineering, data science or a related field

is preferred.

#### **What you can expect from us**

At Keelvar, we are proud to offer flexible working and great benefits, including:  

* Medical Insurance
* 401k
* Paid family related leave
* Up to 27 days of annual leave per annum.
* Additional day off for your birthday!
* Flexible working hours with a positive approach to work - life balance.
* An inclusive, collaborative, innovative culture.
* Generous leave offerings including 2 CSR days.
* A clear development path: Regular 1-1s with your manager and a defined career ladder

so you know what your learning and development looks like at Keelvar.  
  
If you really like the sound of the role but don't match every listed criteria exactly, we still want to hear from you. You could be the exact fit for this or any of our other roles.  
We are a diverse group and we intend to continue to attract and retain diverse talent in our  
organisation. We're committed to an inclusive and diverse Keelvar. We do not discriminate  
based on gender, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religion, civil or family status, age, disability, or race.

Title: Senior Program Manager, Redeployment, Global Fleet and Products
Description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

We are seeking a Sr. Program Manager to lead fleet expansion initiatives that enable Amazon's last-mile delivery network to scale efficiently and sustainably. This role requires a strategic operator who can own end-to-end expansion programs from concept through execution, balancing innovation with operational excellence. You will develop expansion strategies, manage pilot programs, build partnerships with external vendors, and coordinate across multiple internal teams to deliver vehicles and infrastructure that meet growing delivery demand. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to drive results in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Fleet Expansion Strategy & Execution  

* Own expansion strategy and execution for assigned fleet segments, including vehicle selection, vendor partnerships, and operational readiness
* Develop multi-year expansion roadmaps that align with business growth projections and strategic priorities
* Build business cases that evaluate market readiness, infrastructure requirements, financial impact, and customer experience
* Define success metrics for new programs and track performance against targets
* Identify and mitigate risks to program timelines, budgets, and outcomes

  
Pilot Program Management  

* Lead pilot programs to evaluate new vehicle types, operational models, and vendor partnerships
* Coordinate across product, operations, procurement, and Delivery Service Partner (DSP) teams to ensure successful launches
* Analyze pilot performance data to inform expansion decisions and scaling strategies
* Manage pilot timelines, budgets, and stakeholder expectations
* Document lessons learned and best practices for future programs

  
Cross-Functional Leadership  

* Partner with procurement teams on vehicle sourcing, vendor negotiations, and contract management
* Collaborate with operations teams to ensure fleet readiness and DSP enablement
* Work with safety and compliance teams to meet regulatory requirements and establish safety standards
* Coordinate with real estate teams on parking capacity and infrastructure needs
* Provide strategic guidance to leadership on expansion opportunities, risks, and trade-offs

  
Ecosystem Development  

* Identify infrastructure gaps that prevent fleet scaling and develop solutions to address them
* Build processes, systems, and tools that enable efficient fleet operations
* Partner with technology teams to automate manual processes and improve data visibility
* Establish standards and best practices that can scale across regions and vehicle types

  
Stakeholder Communication  

* Ensure leadership visibility into program status, risks, and opportunities through regular updates and business reviews
* Present business cases and recommendations to senior leadership for decision-making
* Manage stakeholder expectations and align cross-functional teams on priorities
* Document program details and decisions for organizational knowledge sharing

  
A day in the life  
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic planning, pilot program management, and cross-functional collaboration. You'll analyze expansion performance data, build business cases for new vehicle types or markets, and partner with operations and procurement teams to solve complex scaling challenges. From building a cohesive fleet strategy and evaluating pilot results to developing fleet ecosystem solutions that enable growth, you'll be the critical link ensuring Amazon's fleet expands efficiently to meet customer demand while advancing sustainability goals.  
  
About the team  
The Redeployment team keeps Amazon's last-mile delivery fleet moving by getting branded vehicles to where they're needed most. As part of Fleet Planning & Capacity, we manage each vehicle's path between Delivery Service Partners, including transport, repair, and reassignment, so every vehicle is road-ready and in use. We work with operations, finance, tech, and outside fleet management, repair and transport vendors to shorten cycle times, lower costs and cut waste. We take on unclear problems from start to finish, use data to make decisions and build processes that scale. We value curiosity, bold ideas and solving problems together.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
* 5+ years of supply chain management (e.g. logistics, inventory turn management, forecasting, operations) experience, or Bachelor's degree
* Experience building and scaling operational mechanisms (WBRs, dashboards, escalation frameworks)

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3+ years of demand planning and forecasting experience
* MBA, or Bachelor's degree in supply chain management, operations, engineering, analytics or related field
* Experience in fleet management, transportation, or last-mile logistics specifically
* Experience influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority in a matrixed organization
* Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (QuickSight, Tableau)

For more information about U.S. Customs and Border Protection, please visit https://www.cbp.gov/about.

  

**Duties**
----------

As Executive Director, Investigative Operations Directorate (IOD), in OPR, you will oversee a wide range of investigative functions and programs including: criminal, non-criminal, and special inquiry investigations related to employee integrity and misconduct; corruption detection and analysis; deployment of investigative resources to review critical and use of force incidents; counterintelligence; and a robust integrity awareness program.
  
  
You will be responsible for implementing a comprehensive integrity strategy designed to prevent, detect, and investigate all threats to the integrity of CBP and its workforce. You will be responsible for sustaining an integrity continuum, and reviewing IOD operations on an ongoing basis to ensure that incidents of corruption and misconduct are prevented, detected, and investigated in a comprehensive, thorough, and efficient manner. You will oversee the formulation of program requirements, the development and implementation of administrative policies and procedures, and the development of long-range programs.
  
  
You will be responsible for overseeing the development of policies, programs, and guidelines for the conduct and coordination of highly complex, difficult, and sensitive criminal, civil, and administrative investigations involving alleged misconduct, criminal activity, and/or corruption by CBP employees and related entities; development and dissemination of innovative techniques for handling all types of investigations; development of new program objectives and operational guidelines; delivery of technical support to IOD field operations; and development of resources and IOD budget requirements.
  
  
For an overview of the diverse responsibilities CBP carries out within the Government, visit our website at cbp.gov.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* Must be a U.S. Citizen.
* All pre-employment processes will be conducted in English.
* You may be required to pass a background investigation.
* CBP follows the DHS Drug-Free Workplace Plan for drug testing procedures.

Title: Customer Success Manager
Description:
**\*This role requires 4-days a week in office at the Denver, CO location\***

Say hello to opportunities.

If you’re looking to be part of what’s next in communication, you’re in the right place.

At RingCentral, we believe the best customer experiences happen when humans and AI work together. Our agentic voice AI portfolio—AIR, AVA, and ACE—brings together automation, assistance, and insights across the entire conversation lifecycle. The result? More seamless, intelligent experiences for businesses everywhere.

With $2.5B+ in ARR and $250M invested in R&D annually, we’re building the future of AI-powered business communications.

**This is where you and your skills come in. We’re currently looking for:** a Customer Success Manager focused on Mid Market serving as the direct support function to some of RingCentral’s most valued and high-profile customers. As a critical piece of our land and expand efforts, you will be a point person for our larger customers and will interface and orchestrate internal efforts with acquisition, implementation, technical support, etc. You will be positioned as a subject matter expert and all-around resource for servicing client’s needs. To succeed in this role, you must be a self-starter who can manage multiple customer engagements at once in a fast-paced environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**  
  
**Account Ownership & Relationship Management**

* Manage a post-sale customer portfolio, acting as the primary point of contact for RingCentral’s UCaaS, CCaaS, and Agentic AI platforms.
* Maintain a 9-box matrix detailing key stakeholders, decision-makers, champions, and detractors.
* Build VP and C-suite relationships to align RingCentral with customer strategic goals.
* Advocate for customer needs internally, collaborating across Sales, Product, Support, and Engineering to resolve issues.
* Drive retention and growth by facilitating renewals and identifying expansion opportunities.
* Execute structured engagements, including success plan kickoffs, cadence calls, and annual EBRs.
* Partner with account teams (Sales, SE, TAM) to track risk metrics and execute mitigation strategies.

**Account Oversight & Incident Management**

* Understand customer deployment details, including configurations, integrations, footprint, and change history.
* Drive product adoption across the RingCentral portfolio (CEB, ACE, AIR, RCX, CC) to maximize customer value.
* Monitor open support cases and partner with TAMs to ensure timely SLA adherence and resolution.
* Lead communication and provide executive updates during critical outages and incidents.
* Deliver Root Cause Analyses (RCAs) and lead discussions on incident mitigation.

**Qualifications:**

* 3–5+ years in Customer Success or Account Management in SaaS/UCaaS, managing Mid-Market or Enterprise accounts.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, communications, or equivalent practical experience.
* Proven experience engaging and managing relationships with VP and C-suite stakeholders.
* Strong ownership mindset as the primary liaison between customers and cross-functional teams.
* Excellent communication skills with experience preparing and delivering executive briefings and QBRs.
* Proactive self-starter capable of driving solutions independently.
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple high-value customer accounts simultaneously.
* Proficiency with Salesforce, customer success platforms, and AI-enabled productivity tools.

**What we offer:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, disability, life insurance
* Health Savings Account (HSA), Flexible Spending Account (FSAs) and Commuter benefits
* 401K match and ESPP
* Paid time off and paid sick leave
* Paid parental and pregnancy leave
* Family-forming benefits (IVF, Preservation, Adoption etc.)
* Emergency backup care (Child/Adult/Pets)
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with counseling sessions available 24/7
* Free legal services that provide legal advice, document creation and estate planning
* Employee bonus referral program
* Debt refinancing assistance
* Employee perks and discounts program

RingCentral’s work culture is the backbone of our success. And don’t just take our word for it: we are recognized as a Best Place to Work by BuiltIn, the Top Work Culture by Comparably and hold local BPTW awards in every major location. Bottom line: We are committed to hiring and retaining great people because we know you power our success.

**About RingCentral**

RingCentral is a global leader in agentic voice AI–powered business communications, delivering an integrated platform for business phone, SMS, contact center, workforce engagement management, video collaboration, and messaging. As the communications layer connecting businesses and customers, RingCentral is the front door of business communication and is in the advantageous position to apply AI at every phase of the conversation journey — before, during, and after each interaction. Our agentic AI portfolio includes autonomous voice-first AI agents that automate calls, assist in the moment, and analyze every interaction – enabling businesses to work smarter, respond faster, and connect more meaningfully with their customers. Visit ringcentral.com to learn more.

Description:
### **Experience Without Limits** **Come shape the future of brand experience.**

**At Jack Morton, we design and build**head-turning, smile-inducing, impact-driving brand experiences that redefine what experiential marketing can achieve. We help our clients **unlock the full value of experiences** by turning bold ideas into meaningful connections.

**That takes a team that's bold, curious, and acts as one.** We build on each other's ideas, challenge conventions, and show up for one another every day. Here, you'll do your best work, grow quickly, and partner across clients, disciplines, and global teams to bring new ideas to life.

This is a place where curiosity drives what's next, boldness raises the bar, and every win is shared. Where ownership is expected, egos are left at the door, and the work reflects the passion and talent of the people behind it.

Experience without limits—in your work, your growth, and your impact.

**\*\*Must be able to work onsite in Oakville, Monday through Friday\*\***

We create memorable, strategic experiences for both virtual and live events. We're looking for a **Senior Project Manager (Trade Shows, Events, Permanent Installations)** to help bring these moments to life. In this role, you'll be the operational backbone behind custom-built trade show exhibits, brand environments, and large-scale event activations. You'll own the details, drive the schedule, solve problems in real time, and collaborate across teams to deliver flawless results. You'll also play a key role in supporting our Global Estimating process.

If you love building, planning, problem-solving, and delivering exceptional client experiences, this role puts you at the center of it all.

**What You'll Do**

* Champion and uphold all internal processes and policies with accuracy and consistency.
* Use project management systems to keep communication clear and aligned across all operational teams.
* Partner closely with Account Services to ensure every deliverable is on track.
* Troubleshoot challenges proactively—whether client-facing or internal—keeping projects moving smoothly.
* Support Global Estimating by preparing precise, timely cost estimates.
* Manage projects of any size with confidence and minimal oversight.
* Apply production knowledge to guarantee accurate, high-quality outputs.
* Work with Design to select finishes, confirm availability, and secure approvals.
* Keep projects on or under budget through strong decision-making and oversight.
* Build and maintain work-back schedules; communicate changes quickly and clearly.
* Develop and steward Implementation Plans (IP) to keep all teams aligned.
* Source materials, manage vendor relationships, and handle purchase order requests.
* Coordinate and oversee subcontractor and supplier services.
* Reconcile all operational elements of a project thoroughly and on time.
* Participate in post-project reviews to help evolve processes and best practices.
* Mentor and guide Project Managers and Project Coordinators, helping grow the next generation of talent.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree (BA/BS) and 8+ years of project management experience in the exhibit or events industry—or equivalent experience.
* A strong grasp of structural mechanics and the ability to read/interpret CAD drawings.
* A passion for people, collaboration, and exceptional client service.
* A self-starter mindset—thriving in entrepreneurial, fast-paced, and independent environments.
* Flexibility, curiosity, and a solution-oriented approach to challenges.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong business sense and an ability to build meaningful client relationships.
* A talent for multitasking, meeting tight deadlines, and maintaining impeccable organization.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Familiarity with exhibit design rules, regulations, and production materials.
* Willingness to work extended hours when needed and travel for on-site project delivery.

Title: Manager, Transit Operations
Description:
**Position Type:**

Regular Full Time (RFT)

**Closing Date:**

November 13, 2026

**Salary/Wage Range:**

$114,971.00 - $143,713.00

**Working for the City of Burlington**

A great career is closer than you think. Come work for the City of Burlington, where you'll be joining an innovative and progressive workplace focused on building a 21st century city that respects the diversity of our residents, visitors and employees; and prioritizes continuous opportunities for you to learn and grow.

We don't just spend time attracting the best talent. We spend time and resources to keep the best talent. This may include: flexible working hours, mobile and hybrid working arrangements, a great pension and benefits package, as well as programs to foster innovation and leadership.

**Type of Vacancy**

Existing Vacancy

**Hours of Work**

35 hours per week

**Department**

Transit

**Location**

This position is required to work in person at Burlington Transit Headquarters. Work location is subject to change at the discretion of the City due to operational demands.

**Position Overview**

The Manager, Transit Operations is responsible for overseeing day-to-day operations and administrative duties for the Operations department. The Manager will ensure transit services, operations and programs are run safely, efficiently and, in a financially responsible manner.

The Manager leads a team of supervisory and training staff as well as union workforce and is responsible to ensure a high level of motivation and productivity.

The Manager will provide strategic planning and input into development of business plans and performance metrics to ensure achievement of business objectives.

**Responsibilities**

The primary responsibilities of this role include:

* Ensure operational staff meet goals and standards for safe/defensive operating, customer service, and schedule adherence
* Oversee the response to incidents, detours, construction, severe weather and emergencies.

* Manage Burlington Transit’s Commercial Vehicle Operator’s Registration (CVOR) compliance including the oversight of collision and incident reviews and corrective actions.
* Oversee the Transit Operator training program and working with the Transit Training Coordinator to develop driver training focused on prevention and risk mitigation.
* Develop and maintain operating procedures and business continuity plans.
* Set, monitor and report operational KPIs: on-time performance, service delivered versus scheduled, safety performance and ridership.
* Lead improvement initiatives, technology rollouts and service changes.
* Lead workforce planning, including attendance and overtime management

The Manager, Digital App & Loyalty, MBIB is responsible for managing the development, launch, and ongoing optimization of MBI Brands’ digital ordering and customer loyalty programs for Mary Brown’s Chicken and Fat Bastard Burrito. App Loyalty Program Strategy & Execution

* Develop loyalty strategies that drive guest acquisition, repeat purchase behaviour, retention, and customer lifetime value
* Partner with internal stakeholders to evolve and optimize the loyalty value proposition over time

Title: Director, Family Court Operations Division
Description:
**Summary**
-----------

The Director of the Family Court Operations Division is responsible for providing executive leadership, policy direction, and administrative oversight of all operations within the Division. The position directs the day-to-day management of family court case processing and related functions and exercises broad authority in the areas of process development, operational management, budget oversight, and human capital management within established statutory and court guidelines.

Learn more about this agency

  

**This job is open to**
-----------------------

### **The public**

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

### **Clarification from the agency**

United States Citizens or individuals lawfully admitted for permanent residency or authorized by the United States Citizenship and Immigration Service to work in the United States.

  

**Duties**
----------

The Director of the Family Court Operations Division works under the general supervision of the Clerk of the Court for the Superior Court of the District of Columbia.
  
  
**Brief Duties of the Position:**

* Responsible for the overall administration, management, and performance of the Division in alignment with applicable statutes, court rules, court orders, and the strategic goals of the Court. Serves as a principal advisor to court leadership on matters impacting division operations and performance.
* Provides executive leadership over Division operations, including case assignment, calendar management, courtroom support, case record management, and operational workflows; establishes priorities, allocates resources, and enforces accountability for performance outcomes.
* Ensure that Division matters are processed and resolved timely and efficiently by establishing and maintaining performance standards consistent with statutory and administrative requirements, including those related to time standards, age of pending caseloads, scheduling practices, and the accuracy and integrity of court records.
* Develops and directs the implementation of the Division's annual Management Action Plan (MAP), aligned with the Court's strategic plan.
* Directs the continuous evaluation of Division operations, programs, policies, and workflows to assess legal, procedural, and operational effectiveness.
* Directs the review, analysis, and interpretation of District of Columbia and federal laws, court rules, administrative orders, and applicable case law, including decisions of the United States Supreme Court and the District of Columbia Court of Appeals.
* Monitors proposed and enacted legislation affecting Division operations and court administration, provides related analysis and recommendations, and advises court leadership and judicial officers on legal interpretation, operational impact, risk, and the development of operational procedures and legal positions for complex or high-impact matters.
* Serves as a senior representative of the Court in interactions with external stakeholders, justice system partners, governmental agencies, attorneys, and the public.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

### **Conditions of employment**

* A background and security investigation is required.
* This position is an Excepted Service appointment.
* All eligible District of Columbia Courts Agency Employees refer to Personnel Policy 0200, 0310, and 0350.
  
  
  

### **Qualifications**

A bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in public or business administration, criminal justice, court management, or a closely related field; ten (10) years of progressively responsible professional experience in court administration, legal administration, public sector management, or a related field, including at least five (5) years in a senior leadership or supervisory role overseeing complex programs, operations, or organizational units.
  
  
To qualify you must provide evidence of progressively responsible leadership experience that is indicative of senior executive level leadership and management capability and directly related to the skills and abilities outlined under Court Executive Service Core Qualifications (CESCQ) listed below and the duties associated with this position. Typically, experience of this nature will have been gained at or above the GS/JS-15 grade level in the federal/DC Court service or its equivalent in the public/private sector. Candidates must possess senior-level executive leadership experience. Failure to meet the basic qualifications and address the CESCQ factors automatically disqualifies an applicant.
  
  
The incumbent should be an enthusiastic and engaged professional who enjoys working with a diverse group of Court personnel and customers and lives the DC Courts' values of Accountability, Excellence, Fairness, Integrity, Respect, and Transparency.

This position is classified within the Court Executive Services.

Candidates should be committed to improving the efficiency of the Federal government, passionate about the ideals of our American republic, and committed to upholding the rule of law and the United States Constitution.

Benefits
========

The District of Columbia Courts is an independent branch of the District of Columbia Government and is not under the authority of the City Mayor or the D. C. Council. DC Courts' appropriation comes directly from Congress. Annual Leave: Individuals occupying CES positions earn eight hours of annual leave each biweekly pay period, regardless of years of credited service and may carry over unused annual leave from year to year subject to a 480-hour ceiling.
  
  
Sick Leave is used for personal medical needs, care of a family member, or adoption related purposes. Full-time employees earn four(4)hours of sick leave every two weeks. This leave can be accrued without limit.
  
  
In addition to the federal health plans, the DC Courts offer employees supplemental vision and dental plans. The Director is eligible for on-site parking or commuter transit benefit subsidy, for a maximum of $150 a month. There are 26 pay periods in the year.
